bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs namatsho ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi ri khor 5)yug dang / khor yug chen po dang / ri rab lhun po dang / de ma yin pa'i rimachos)gzhan dang / lung pa dang / lung phran dang ske/ gcong rong dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo dang / tsher ma dang / rtswa 4dang ske/ shing ngan pa thams cad mi snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na ji tsam du ngan par gdags pa dug dang / byad stems dang / gcan gzan rin)ma rungs pa dang / ye 'drog podang / glo 7bur dang / rims nad dang /yul ngan nadang / nam rmus 9)pa dang / rdul dang bo/ dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba'i nyal nyil thams cad kyang zhi zhing med par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i sa gzhi yang lag mthil bzhin du mnyam zhing bkra shis pa rnam pa sna tshogs rang 'byung ba dang / rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / phul du 'gyur ba dang / dam par 'gyur ba dang / mtshan ma bzang po du mas yongs su brgyan par 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gal te ye shes kyi stobs gdul dka' 11ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na gnas pa'i bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas te thams cad 'jigs skrag nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/gal te glog gi 'od zer zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad 'jig rten pha rol gyi 'jigs pa dang bral zhing chos kyis spro bar 'gyur ro/ /65wa 268

de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/gal te mchog dam pa'i ro dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bsams pa bzhin du zas dang skom gyis tshim par 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/gal te mchog gi mdangs dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad gang yang lhag pa'i mthu stobs dang mi ldan pa med de 1)nad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gal te mchog dam pa'i yo byad ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na/ ༷ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad ci la mos pa bzhin du khri stan dang / gding ba dang / gos dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / ci tsam du 'tsho ba'i yo byad du gtogs pa de dag thams cad kyis brel zhing phongs pa med de rab tu mdzes pa shin tu yid du 'ong ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gal te rtsod pa med pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad lus dang / sems zo mdog bde zhing yang ba dang / dgra snang ba dang / 'ching ba thams cad dang bral ba dang /'dum zhing dga' ba dang / spro ba dang / sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang /65—269

bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sems mi 'khrug 17pa dang /shes rab yongs su rdzogs pa la dga' zhing mos par 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gal te phul du gyur pa'i spro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad khyad par can gyi rab tu dga' ba tshad med pa dang ldan par 'gyur 5ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/gal te da'ajig rten pa'i lam gyi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad thogs pa med pa'i ye shes thob cing rnam par dag pa'i las rnam pa sna tshogs sbyong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gal te rgyal ba'i rdo rje la shin tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad dbang po kun dang ldan zhing dbang po mi nyams pa dang / rtag tu yang dag par 'byung ba'i lam la mos shing sems rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gal te lhag pa'i rgyal mtshan rtog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bdag sdig pa mi dge ba'i 4chos la shin tu skyo 5zhing mi 'dod pa dang / thams cad kyang dge ba srung ba dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyis mtho ris kyi lhar skye 65—270

bar 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gal te byams pa dang / snying rjer ldan pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad byams pa'i sems dang / snying rje'i sems dang / gnod pa'am/ 'tshe ba med pa'i sems dang / kun la snyoms pa'i sems dang / gcig la gcig phan pa dang bde bar byed pa'i sems skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gal te bsod nams thams cad shin tu sdud pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na gnas pa'i sems can 1thams cad 'thab 2pa dang / rtsod pa dang / nad dang / mu ge dang yongs su bral te/ dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang ske/ char pa dang / kha ba dang / rtsub pa dang / tsha ba dang / sdug bsngal ba la sogs pa'i reg bya'i yul yid du mi 'ong ba thams cad yongs su zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar skyes bu chen po de gal te rgya mtsho glog 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag gi sa chen po thams cad rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las byas par 'gyur zhing nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dang yongs su bral te rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rin po che'i shing dang / gos kyi shing dang / snod kyi shing dang / rgyan gyi shing dang ske/ me tog gi shing 5dang / 'bras bu'i shing dang / rol mo sna tshogs kyi shing la sogs pa 'tsho ba'i yo byad dam pa tshad med pa snyed kyis yongs su brgyan par gyur to / /de bzhin du mdor na rigs kyi bu de ni sems can mang po 65—271

yongs su smin par 1bya ba'i phyir nyin re zhing snga dro'i dus su ting nge 'dzin gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug ste/ ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing kun na gdul ba'i sems can thams cad la ci dang cis 'dul ba bzhin du phan pa dang bde ba'i don de dang de dag gis yongs su smin par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni sngon bskal pa chen po tshad med dpag tu med pa'i bar du rnyog pa lnga'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mi bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sems can yongs su smin par byed do/ /phyi ma ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'jig rten gyi khams la lar gal te mtshon gyis 'jigs pa byung ste/ sems can dag yongs su gdungs55)par gyur pa na/ rigs kyi bu 'di 4de lta bu dag mthong nas snga dro'i dus kyi tshe ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi mthus mtshon gyis 'jigs pa de dag yongs su bcil nas sems can rnams gcig la gcig byams pa'i sems kyis snying brtse bar byed do/ /'jig rten gyi khams la lar nad kyis 'jigs pa byung ste/ sems can kha btag 5pa na rigs kyi bu 'dis de lta bu dag mthong nas snga dro'i dus kyi tshe ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi mthus nad kyis 'jigs pa yongs su bcil nas sems can rnams rab tu bde ba thob par byed do/ /'jig rten gyi khams la lar gal te mu ges 'jigs pa byung ste sems can kha btag 6pa na/ rigs kyi bu 'dis de lta bu dag mthong nas snga dro'i dus kyi tshe ting nge 'dzin 7gyi mthus mu ges 'jigs pa yongs su bcil te/ sems can rnams kha zas kyis yongs su tshim par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'dis de ltar ting nge 'dzin mang po'i shugs kyis de lta bu la sogs pa tshad med dpag tu med/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phan pa dang bde ba'i don 65—272

gyis sems can gyi dbugs 'byin to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di de ltar nan tan gyi khyad par tshad med grangs med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pas sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde bar byed pa'i don la rab tu brtson pa'o//sngon 'das pa'i dus na skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba dang yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad med grangs med pa gang gā'i 17klung gi bye ma snyed las zad mi shes pa'i yi dam chen po bcas te/ snying rje chen po dang mi 'phrogs pa'i brtson 'grus chen po rab tu bskyed do/ /de ltar snying rje chen po dang mi 'phrogs pa'i brtson 'grus bskyed de zad mi shes pa'i yi dam bcas pas gong nas gong du 'phags pa'i shugs kyis nyin zhag gcig gam/skad cig thang cig tsam gyis kyang so so'i skye bo tshad med pa bye ba khrag khrig btul te / sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs las bsgral nas thams cad ci dang ci 'dod pa de dang de dag gis re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang 'dod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sdug bsngal te/ 'dod pas yongs su gdungs par gyur pa dag sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing / dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na ci dang ci 'dod pa thams cad 'thob cing sdug bsngal dang bral te/ skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang bza' ba dang / btung bas phongs par gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas te mchod pa byas na ci dang ci 65—273

'dod pa thams cad 'thob cing bza' ba dang btung ba dang ldan te mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang bgo ba'am/ rin po che'i rgyan nam/ nad kyi rkyen sman nam/ gding ba'am/ khri stan nam/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis brel cing phongs par gyur pa 1dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas 2bste stang dang bcas pas rimachod pa byas na ci dang ci 'dod pa rnyed cing bgo 4ba dang /rin po che'i rgyan dang / nad kyi rkyen sman dang / gding ba dang / khri dang /'tsho sgruba'i yo byad thams cad 'byor cing skal ba ji lta ba bzhin mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang (tshodag na sems can gang dag byams sdug pa dang bral te/ dgra sdang bar gyur pa dang phrad par gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang 7ridang bcas te mchod pa byas na / byams sdug pa 9dang phrad cing dgra sdang ba dang bral te/ skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang dag lus dang sems nad dang sdug bsngal mang pos gzir bar gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang 1 bcas pas 11mchod pa byas na de kun lus dang sems bde zhing nad thams cad dang bral te skal ba 12ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 1 bar du 'thob 65—274

par 'gyur tsho1)ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can na/gang 'thab cing rtsod kyipar gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas 4brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na zhe 'gras pa'i sems dang bral te gcig la gcig dga' ba dang ske/ bzod pa dang / gcig la gcig byams pa'i sems kyis 'gyod cing chags par 'gyur 5te skal ba 6ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /7gnas gang dag na sems can gang btson48)du bzung ste/ btson rar bcug gam/ lcags dang / khong sgril dang / shing gi gdos kyis bcings sam/ yan lag bcings ti sdug bsngal bar gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/ de kun btson 9ra dang / lcags dang / khong sgril tshadang / lcags sgrog las thar te bag yangs 11su gyur nas dga' ba dang /skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang dag btson du bzung nas gzhu ba'am/ 'tshog pa'am/ nan la bor ba dang / gsod pa la thug pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas pas 1 mchod pa byas na/ de kun btson 1 du bzung ba dang / gzhu 'tshog 1 pa dang /nan la bor ba las thams cad thar te skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang 65—275

dag na sems can gang dag lus dang sems dub pa dang / mthu stobs dang mi ldan cing / nyams1chung ba dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na de kun lus dang sems yang dun)zhing bde ba dang mthu stobs bskyed dem cis 'dul ba bzhin du mtho la/ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can dbang po nyams pa dang ma tshang bar gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/ de kun dbang po ma tshang ba med cing dbang po dang ldan te skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang dag smyos shing sems 'khrugs sam/ 'byung po'i gdon gyis brlams pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas te mchod pa byas na/ de kun smyos shing sems 'khrugs pa dang bral te rab tu bde ba dang skal ba ji lta sgrub bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 6bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / khong khro ba dang /phrag dog dang / nga rgyal dang / ngan par lta ba dang / gnyid dang / bag med pa dang / the tsom la sogs pas lus dang sems gdungs te mi 'pho 7bar gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 65—276

sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas te mchod pa byas na/ de kun 'dod chags la sogs pa dang bral te lus dang sems rab tu hu)bde ba dang skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du ri'athob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang dag mes tshig par gyur pa'am/ chus khyer ba'am/ rlung gis khyer ba'am/rbab ( tu lhung ba'am/ shing cika'am/ khang thog nas lhung ste 5sems dngangs shing 'khums 6par gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/ de kun mi bde ba'i bgegs dang ske/ g.yang sa de dag thams cad las thar te skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang dag sbrul gdug pa'am/ gcan gzan 7gdug pas zin tam/ dug rnam pa sna tshogs kyis 8log par gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/de kun 'tshe zhing gnod pa thams cad dang bral te skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang 9'byung po'i gdon gyis 1 btab ste/ rtag pa'i rims dang / zhag gcig pa dang / zhag gnyis pa dang / zhag gsum pa dang ske/ zhag bzhi pa dang / smyos nas lus dang sems 'dar zhing 'khrugs te/dran pa nyams shing shes pa med par gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub 65—277

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/ de kun 'jigs pa las rnam par grol te lus dang sems rab tu bde ba dang skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang / grul 1)bum dang /mdangs za ba dang / de ma yin pa gzhan yang seng ge dang / stag dang /spyang ki la sogs pa gcan gzan nagadug pas nyen pa dang / sngags dang /byad dang / g.yul ngor lhags pa dang / gzhan yang 'jigs par gyur pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis dkris shing glags sate/ lus dang sems rab tu dngangs par gyur nas shi bas 'jigs shing 'tsho bar 'dod pa dang / bde ba tshol zhing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/ de kun 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral te lus dang srog la mi dma' ba dang skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang mang du thos 4par 'dod pa'am/ mos pa dag par 'dod pa'am / tshul khrims dag par 'dod pa'am/ bsam gtan bsgrub par 'dod pa'amal/ mngon par shes pa 'dod pa'am/ shes rab 'dod pa'am/ rnam par grol ba 'dod pa'am/ gzugs dam pa 'dod pa'am/ sgra snyan pa 'dod pa'am / dri zhim po 'dod pa'am/ ro zhim po 'dod pa'am/ reg bya mchog 65—278

'dod pa'am/ khe dang rnyed pa 'dod pa'am/ grags pa 'dod pa'am/bsod nams 'dod pa'am/ bzos 'tsho bar 'dod pa'am/ me tog dang 'bras bu 'dod pa'am/ skyed 1mos tshal 'dod pa'am/ khri stan 'dod pa'am/gding ba 'dod pa'am/ yul rgyu nabar 'dod pa'am/ nor dang 'bru 'dod pa'am / nad kyi rkyenas risman 'dod pa'am/ khang khyim 'dod pa'am/ bran 5khol 'dod pa'am/ tshon rtsi 'dod pa'am/ char pa 'dod pa'am/ chu 'dod pa'am / lo thog 6 'dod pa'am/ bsil 7yab 'dod pa'am/ rlung bsil ba 'dod pa'am/ me 'dod pa'am/ theg pa 'dod pa'am/ bu pho dang bu mo 'dod pa'am/ thabs mkhas par 'dod pa'aman/ bsod nams bya bar 'dod pa'am/ dro 9ribar 'dod pa'am/ bsil bar 'dod pa'am/1 yid gzhungs par 'dod pa'am/ de ma yin pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i don gyi dngos po rnam pa sna tshogs 'dod pa'i phyir nyon mongs shing sdug bsngal gyis 11gdungs par gyur pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bste stang dang bcas te mchod pa byas na/ rigs kyi bu de'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa'i yon tan dang / mthu dang gzi brjid kyi shugs kyis de dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyis gdungs pa 12dang bral te/ re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang dag zhing gshin pa'am/ zhing mi gshin pa la sa bon btab nas/ gal te nan tan byas kyang rung / nan tan ma byas kyang rung ste/ sems rtse gcig 2tu byang 65—279

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bsti stang dang bcas te mchod pa byas na/ rigs kyi bu de'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa'i yon tan dang / mthu dang / gzi brjid kyi shugs kyis de dag gi lo thog 1)thams cad legs shing 'bras bu smin cing legs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni sngon bskal chosapa chen po tshad med grangs med pa'i bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das tshad med grangs med pa dag la brtson 'grus chen po'i sbyor ba dang / brtan pa'i yi dam bcas pa'i smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir rtag tu sa chen po thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rtag tu sa bon gyi tshogs thams cad yongs su 'dzin cing rtag tu sems can thams cad kyis yid bzhin du spyod par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu de'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mthus sa chen po 'di las skye ba'i rtswa dang ske/ shing gi rtsa ba ri nodang / yal ga dang / myu gu dang / lo ma dang /sdong po dang / 'dab ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa thams cad rgyas par skye zhings / rtsi shing dang / lo tog la sogs pa'i me tog dang /'bras bu yang smin cing grung ba 5 dang / mngar 3)ba dang / snum pa dang / dri zhim par byed do/ /gnas gang dag na sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang /zhe sdang dang / gti mug la sogs pa drag la rno bas srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang ske/ ngag rtsub por smra ba dang / phra ma byed pa dang / tshig kyal par 7)smra ba dang ske/ 'dod chags can dang / zhe snang can 8)dang / log par lta ba dang /mi dge ba 9bcu'i las kyi lam mngon du spyod pa dag gis sems rtse gcig tu byang 65wa 280

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bsti stang dang bcas te mchod pa byas na nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi zhing mi dge ba bcu dang yongs su bral te dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan zhing sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rje ba tshodang / phan pa dang ske/ bde ba'i sems skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rigs kyi bu 'di na ni de lta bu'i yon tan dam pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mthu dang / gzi brjid kyi shugs dang / shin tu brtson pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis skad cig thang cig tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med grangs med par phyin cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de re rer yang skad cig thang cig gis sems can snod du gyur pa/ tshad med grangs med pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed sdug bsngal las bsgral nas bde ba thob par byas te skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rigs kyi bu de ni de lta bu'i yon tan dang / smon lam brtan pa dang / shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus bsam gyis 4mi khyab pa dang ldan te/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su kha cig la ni tshangs pa chen po'i rgyal po'i lus su ston te/ sems can rnams cis 'dul ba'i chos ston to/ /kha cig la ni dbang phyug chen po'i lha'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi gzhan 'phrul dbang byed gnam gyi lha'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni 'phrul dga' gnam gyi lha'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni dga' ldan gnam gyi lha'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni rab mtshe ma riganam gyi lha'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni sum cu 6rtsa gsum gnam gyi lha'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni 65—281

rgyal chen bzhi'i lha'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni sangs rgyas kyi skur ston to/ /kha cig la ni byang chub sems dpa'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni rang sangs rgyas kyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni nyan thos kyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni 'khor los sgyur 1ba'i rgyal po'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni rgyal rigs kyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni bram ze'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni dmangs rigs kyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni rje'u rigs kyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni skyes pa'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni bud med kyi lus su ston to / /kha cig la ni gzhon nu'i nalus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni bu mo'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni dri za'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni lha ma yin gyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni mi'am ci'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni sto 'phye chen po'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni klu'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni gnod sbyin gyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni srin po'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni grul bum gyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni sha za'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni yi dgas kyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni srul po'i lus su ston to / /kha cig la ni lus srul po'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni gnon po'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni seng ge'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni spos kyi ba lang gi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni rta'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni khyu mchog gi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni gcan gzan 4sna tshogs kyi lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni gshin rje'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni sems can dmyal ba'i srung rima'i lus su ston to/ /kha cig la ni sems can dmyal ba neba'i sems can gyi lus su ston to/ /de dag la sogs pa tshad med grangs med 65—282

pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs kyi lus ston cing skye bo mang po la skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston pas theg pa gsum las 1phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'dzud do/ /rigs kyi bu skyes bu chen po de ni de ltar de lta bu'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan gyi nakhyad par dang ldan te/ de ni yon tan mchog tu gyur pa phul du gyur pa'i gter yin no/ /rnam par grol ba rin po che thams cad 'byung ba'i 'byung gnas yin no / /byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i mig yongs su dag pa yin no/ /mya ngan las 'da' ba'i grong khyer chen por 'gro ba'i ded dpon yin no/ /de ltar ched du ma byas par gong du rgyas par bshad pa'i yon tan chen pos chos kyi 'khor lo chen po rab tu bskor ba yin no/ /'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu gal te 'ga' zhig gis byams pa'am/ 'jam dpal lam/ kun du spyan ras gzigs sam/kun du bzang po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gā'i klung gi bye rnam snyed la bskal pa brgya'i bar du sems rtse gcig tu skyabs su song nas de dag gi mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang / 'dod pa'i 4re ba'i phyir smon lam btab pa bas 'ga' zhig gis skad cig thang cig yud tsam sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing dmigs pas bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod pa dang phyag byas na re ba'i 5smon lam thams cad myur du 'grub cing rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po 'di sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir/ sems can rnams kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byed na dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gter 65—283

dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar skyes bu chen po 'di ni sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir yun ring po nas smon lam chen po 17shin tu brtan pa dang / snying rje chen po dang shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus bsgoms pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' kun bas 5)khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas khyed kyis bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod par bya'o/ /de nas phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / nyan thos dang / lha dang / mi dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za la sogs pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad 'dug pa las langs nas ci nus su so so nas gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi me tog dang / spos kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po la mchod pa'i phyir mngon par gtor to/ /de ma yin pa gzhan yang lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / nor bu dang / nor bu rin po che dang ske/ mu tig gi phreng ba dang / mu tig gi se mo do dang / gser dang /dngul dang / rin po che'i phreng ba dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /( gdugs la sogs pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po la mchod pa'i phyir phulam lo/ /gzhan yang tshad med pa'i lhas rdzas kyi rol mo snyan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa'i bstod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 6sa'i snying po la bste stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying pos rnam pa sna tshogs kyi lha rdzas kyi mchod pa'i yo byad de dag slar bcom ldan 'das la phul nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag 7)smras so/ /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin mi rnams dang / /phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i mchod pa 65—284

rnams / /yon tan chen po 'jig rten gtso latsha༅dbul/ /mchog gi mchod pa 'di dag bzhes〈bsu gsol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying pos tshigs su bcad pa de smras nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshalas ba dang / de la bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /brtan pa'i blo dang rnam dag sems bskyed nas / /sems can tshad med pa yi sdug bsngal bcil/ /rin chen dgas ltar bde ba 'byung bar mthong / /rdo rje bzhin du the tsom dra ba gcod/ /snying rje chen po'i blo can brtson 'grus kyis/ /mchod pa dam pa bcom ldan 'das la dbul / /rgya mtsho ye shes sems can sdug bsngal sgrol5/ /'jigs pa med pas srid pa'i pha rol phyin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po 'dug pa las langs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 0chu bo bzhi las sgrol ba'i bcom ldan 'das kyi nye gnas dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa dran pa 'phel ba dang / bsrung ba'i dran pa 'phel ba dang /'tsho ba 'phel ba dang / lus bde ba 'phel ba dang / nad ma mchis pa 'phel ba dang / gzugs dang stobs 'phel ba dang / grags pa 'phel ba dang /'tsho ba'i yo byad 'phel ba dang / gnyen bshes 7'phel ba dang / slob ma 'phel ba dang / tshul khrims 'phel ba dang / mang du thos pa 'phel ba dang /sbyin pa 'phel ba dang / ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba dang / bzod pa 'phel ba dang ske/ thabasatshan)mkhas pa 'phel ba dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dag dang /'phags pa'i bden pa 'phel ba dang / theg pa chen po'i yang dag pa'i lam la 65—285

gzhol ba'i 'phel ba dang / chos kyi sgron ma 'phel ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba 'phel ba dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po 'phel ba dang / rnam par dkar 11ba'i chos 'phel ba dang / khams gsum du grags pa 'phel ba dang / khams gsums du chos kyi char 'phel ba dang ske/ sa chen po thams cad kyi ro bro ba 'phel ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi mdangs dang dge ba'i las 'phel ba dang / chos kyi dga' ba dang dge ba spyod pa 'phel ba dang / shes rab kyi 'od la'aphel ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug 'phel ba dang / spyan lnga 'phel ba dang / dbang bskur ba 'thob pa dang / lhar 5skye ba dang / mya ngan las 'da' ba 'phel ba la sogs pa thob par byed pa nas/ 'di lta ste/ me dang chur ldan pa dang / bkra shis kyi 'od snang ba dang / thos pa 'dzin pa'i rig sngags chen po dang / gzungs kyi tshig 'di bdag 6gis 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chu klung gang gā'i bye ma snyed la bsnyen bkur bgyis nas gzungs 'di thos te/ gzungs 'dis ni rnam par dkar ba'i chos thams cad 'phel zhing skye ba dang / sa bon gyi tshogs dang /rtsa 7ba dang / myu gu dang / yal ga dang / sdong po dang / lo ma dang /'dab ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / rtsi shing dang / lo thog 8gi bro ba dang / bsung 9'phel zhing skye ba dang / char chu dang ldan pa dang /phan par 'gyur ba'i sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung 'phel zhing skye ba dang ske/ dga' ba dang / bde ba 'phel zhing skye ba dang / rin po che dang nor rdzas 'phel zhing skye ba dang / mthu stobs 'phel zhing skye ba dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad thams cad 'phel zhing skye bar 'gyur ro/ /yang gzungs 'dis ni shes rab 65—286

skye bas nyon mongs pa'i dgra yang yongs su bcom par 'gyur ba'i sngags la 'di lta ste/ tshim bho latshim bho/ tsim tshim bho/ ā kā ṣa tshim bho/ ba ka ra tshim bho/a ma bar tshim bho/ bar tshim bho/ ba tsir tshim bho/ a ro ga tshim snyo/ dharma tshim bho/ sa te ②ba tshim sgoni/ sa te ④ni ha la tshim bho/ bi ba ro ka (5)sha ba tshim bho/ u pa ⑥sha ma tshim bho/ na stiyan tshim bho/ pradz+nyā (shes ma mo ne rat+na 6)tshim bho/ k+ṣa ṇa tshim bho/ bi ṣe ma ba ri yā ⑩tshim bho/ shā sī ḍo/7ta la ma ba tshim bho/ bi 8a dra so ta ma he le/ dam be ya ma be/ tsakrā se/ tsakrā ba si le/k+ṣi le phi le ka ra bha/ bā ra ba rī te/8 ha se re pra rā tsobe/ pa tsore tsa rā bhan dā ne/ a ra dā ne/ shān ⑩ra/ tsa 7tsa tsa tsa/ hi 8le mi len)/ a kha ta thā ge khe/ tha ga khri lo/ bhā re bhā bu re/ mi le ma dhe/ nan te ku le mi le sang 2lhaku tsi ta te/ ā ri gyi dure/ ba ra gyi re/tso ku ta sha ma dz+wa stem le/ ton gye ton gye/ ton gyu phyile/ hu rū hū phyar+sha hu rū/ ku lo sto mi le/ me ḍa meri to/ me ( rnyeri te/ bhan 0dha ta0 / ha ra kha ma re ma/ hu ru hu ru/ srid pa'i dri ma sbyong ba dge bar gsungs/ /'thab 0rtsod bskal mapa zhi ba'ang dge bar gsungs/ /mi dge bsam pa sbyong dub dge bar gsungs④/ /'byung ba chen po sbyong ba'ang dge bar gsungs/ /ngan par 'gro ba sbyong ba dge bar gsungs/ /sdig pa'i bag chags sbyong ba'ang dge bar gsungasabu/ /re ba rdzogs par byed pa dge bar gsungs / /lo thog busmin par byed pa'ang dge bar gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 0dge bar gsungs pa 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /dge bar gsungs 'dis byang chub sems dpa'i 2)rnams/ /byin gyis rlob mdzad gyurjes su yi rang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das de ltar me dang chu dang 65—287

ldan pa dang / bkra shis kyi 'od snang ba dang / thos pa 'dzin pa'i rig sngags chen po gzungs kyi tshig 'di ni bdag gis 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chu klung gang gā'i bye ma snyed la bsnyen bkur bgyis pas thos so/ /gzungs 'di ni rnam par dkaramatsho1)ba'i chos thams cad 'phel zhing skye bar bgyid pa nas de bzhin du rgyas pa'i (5)longs spyod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyi bar du 'phel zhing skye bar bgyid do/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gzungs 'dis ni chu bo bzhi las sgrol bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nye gnas su gyur pa dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma la sogs pa'i gdamigs pa 'phel bar bgyid pa nas/ de bzhin du rgyas par 'tsho ba'i54 yo byad thams cad kyi bar du 'phel zhing skye bar bgyid do/ /gzungs 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis55 'phags pa'i gsung rab bdud rtsi lta bu yongs su rgyas pa dang ske/ yun du gnas shing khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du 6'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying pos thos pa 'dzin pa'i rigs 7)sngags chen po dang / gzung sa kyi tshig 'di smras pa na/ ri kha la te yas skarab tu g.yos nas lha'i rol mo bye ba khrag khrig kyang ma dkrolasto9)bar rang 'khrol te/ lha'i spos dang / me tog dang /rin po che tshad med pa rnam pa sna tshogs char bzhin du babs nas de'i tshe 'khor mang po de dag thams cad kyang ngo mtshar rmad du gyur to/ /de'i tshe na 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de na lha mo bkra shis 7chen mo dang / dpal 31ldan lha mo chen mo dang ske/ mchod dbyangs lha mo chen mo dang / brtan pasanyu2lha mo chen mospyo dang /chu can lha mo chen mo dang / 'od chen lha mo chen mo la sogs pa lha mo 'byung ba 65wa 288

chen po bzhi la dbang du gyur pa stong phrag bcwa 1brgyad 'dug pa las langs nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs nal spyi bos phyag 'tshal 5te thal mo sbyar nas bste stang dang bcas pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar che'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag gis 'byung ba chen po bzhi dag la dbang sgyur camod kyi 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i thog ma dang / bar ma dang / tha ma'i skye ba dang / 'gag pa dang / 'thun 5pa dang / mi 'thun pa'i phyogs mi 'tshal te/ skyes bu chen po 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa phra ba shin tu zab tshomo thob nas 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i thog ma dang / bar ma dang / tha ma'i mtshan nyid dang / skye ba dang /'gag pa dang / 'thun pa dang / mi 'thun pa'i phyogs la shin tu mkhas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/rigs kyi bu 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa phra ba shin tu zab mo thob pas 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i thog ma dang / bar ma dang / tha ma'i mtshan nyid skye ba dang ske/ 'gags7)pa dang / 'thun pa dang / mi 'thun pa'i phyogs la shin tu mkhas so/ /lha mo 'di ltar shes par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ni yon tan mang po dang ldan pas rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs char bzhin du 'bab ste/ sems can mang po la sbyin pa byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di yang de bzhin du byang chub kyi yan lag gi rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs char bzhin du 'bebs te sems can la sbyin pa byed do/ /'di lta ste/ rin po che'i gling ltar rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'di yang byang chub kyi yan lag gi 8rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan no/ /65wa 289

'di lta ste/ lha rdzas kyi shing pa ri tsi tra 1tshol bsung dang me tog gis mdzes pa bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi chos rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rab tu mdzes so/ /'di lta ste/ seng ge'i rgyal po ni ri dgas thams cad kyi nazil gyis mi non cing mi skrag pa bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'di yang sems can thams cad kyis bag tsha ba'am zil gyis non pa med do/ /'di lta ste/ ji ltar nyi ma gsal bas 'jig rten gyi mun pa thams cad yongs su sel ba bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'di yang sems can thams cad kyi ngan par lta 4ba'i ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad sel ba'o/ /'di lta ste/ nam thang ba'i zla ba ni mtshan mo'i dus su lam stor 5ba'i sems can thams cad la bde neriba'i lam ston te/ gar 'gro bar dga' ba bzhin du phyin par 'gyur ba ltar/ rigs kyi bu 'di yang ma rig pa'i mtshan mor theg pa gsum las 'brog bslad de 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon par 'khyam pa'i sems can thams cad la theg pa gsum gyis yang dag pa'i lam ston cing skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du thabs kyis yang dag par 'byung ba'i lam la 'god par byed do/ /'di lta ste/ sa chen po la ni sa bon gyi tshogs thams cad dang ske/ rtsi shing dang / lo thog 7dang / sa'i khams su gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba ltar/ rigs kyi bu 'di la yang byang chub kyi yan lag khyad par can gyi chos thams cad ston pa'i gnas so/ /'di lta ste/rin capo che chen po'i ri rab ri'i rgyal po ni shin tu brtan zhing 8ma god nyam nyams pa bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'di yang sangs rgyas kyi 1 ma 'dres pa'i chos thams cad la shin tu gnas shing sems can thams cad mi gtong ba'i phyir mi nyams pa dang /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 11la gtong ba'i phyir ma god pa'o12/ /'di lta ste/65wa 290

nam mkha' la 1)sems can thams cad spyod pa bzhin du/ rigs kyi bu 'di yang sems can thams cad de la longs spyod do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni de ltar yon tan tshad med dpag tu med pa dang ldan no/ /de'i tshe 'khor mang po rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po'i yon tan tshad med pa dang ldan pa bstod pa thos nas ngo mtshar rmadamanadu gyur te/ bkur ste dang rim gro byas nas rab tu dga' bas sems rtse gcig tu byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po la mig mi 'dzums par lta'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don de dag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de cabaka' stsal pa/ skyes bu yang dag sa yi snying po ni/ /yon tan mang po phun sum tshogs par ldan/ /dge sbyong cha lugs 'dzin cing ston byed pa/ /ston pa chen po la ni phyag 'tshal lhags//sems can kun la bde ba rab tu byin/ /srid pa gsum 5gyi sdug bsngal kun la tshosgrol / /tshad med rnam pa sna tshogs char phab nas/ /ston pa chen po la ni mchod pa byed/ /brgya byin dri ma med par skyes pa des/ /phyogs bzhi kun du bltas shing brtags nas su/ /thal mo sbyar nas bsti stang rab bcas te/ /ston pa chen po la ni bsngags shing bstod/ /bdag gis 7bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor mthong ba/ /nor bu rin po che yi na'od zer ltar/ /sangs rgyas mang po'i zhing kun snang byas te/ /thams cad gsal 9bar ma gyur gang yang med/ /mngon shes drug gis 'jig rten snang bar byed/ /deng 'dir 'dus shing lhags par 'gyur ba 7ni/ /shin tu dpa' ba sa yi 1 snying po ste/ /rab tu byung ba'i spyod lam mngon 12par ston/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun 15'byung ba'i gter yin te/ /'jigs pa med pa'i sangs rgyas nga ro dbyangs1 / /byang chub sems dpa' mang 65wa 291

po'i rgyal mtshan te/ /sems can mang po 'dren pa'i gtso bo'o/ /rnam par grol ba'i rin chen 'byung khung ste3/ /brtson 'grus brtanams)pa'i bsod nams rgya mtsho yin/ /byams pa'i blo gros snying rje brtse la mos/ /sdug bsngal ba yi rin sems can mang po sgrol/ /'jigs pa srung ba'i 'obs dang mkhar yin te/ /nam mkha' dang ba'i zla bzhinaman)lam yang ston/ /sa ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad skyed/ /rdo rje ltar ni the tsom yongs su gcod/ /rnam par grol ba'i rin chen kun la gtor5/ /chu ltar sgrib pa thams cad 'dags6)par byed/ /nyon mongs tsha bas gdungs pa'i gdugs su 'gyur/ /sman pa ltar ni nad kun 'tsho bar byed/ /zhag gcig sa yis7/snying po'i ming brjod pa'i/ /grags pa chen po'i bsod nams thob pa ni/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig bar du yang / /blo can gzhan gyi ming nas brjod pas lhagan /so so'i skye bo grol bar byed pa ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad rnam par 'ching byed pa'o/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin mthar phyin cing / /ting 'dzin gzhan dag gi yang pha rol phyin/ /rkyen mang bcu gsum po yang rnam dag pas/ /mang po kun la ye shes nam mkha' bzhin / /dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams kyi/ /skye bo mang po'i mun pa'i tshogs kyang bcom/ /zhing rnams ji bzhin ting 'dzin der 'jug cing / /bsam gtan bzhi po la yang rgyun du 'jug9) /ting nge 'dzin du zhugs nas sems can gyi/ /nyon mongs pa yi gdung ba rab tu sel/ /so so'i skye bo sngon gyi sdig pa'i las/ /mtshon dang nad dang mu ges 'jigs pa dang / /rnam pa mang pos 'tshe zhing gsod gyur pa/ /de dag kun nas rnam par grol bar byed/ /sems can nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga/ /sdug bsngal mang pos 'tshe zhing 65—292

gdungs gyur pa/ / sa yi 17snying po de la skyabs gsol na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /sems can sdug bsngal 'khor lo narab bskor te/ /gcig gis gcig la 'tshe zhing gnod gyur pa/ / sa yi 5snying po de la skyabs gsol na ri/ /bzod cing byams pa'i sems la gnas par 'gyur/ /bcu gsum rkyen gyis rab 'jigs skrag byed cing / /tshol ba mi rnyed rkyen gyis sdug pa dag /sa yi snying po de mu la skyabs gsol na/ /'jigs pa med la bde bar56)gnas par 'gyur/ /bsod nams byed la 7mos shing dran pa dang / /tshul khrims mang thos shes rab 'dod pa dag /sa yi snying po de la skyabs gsol na / /re ba bzhin du thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur/ /yon tan so sor smos pa'i bzod rtsal dang na / /sman dang sa bon tshogs la mos pa dag / sa yi 9snying po de la skyabs gsol na/ /re ba kun dang ldan zhing rdzogs par 'gyur/ /lo thog4rtsi shing legs par 'dod pa dang / /khye'u dang bu mo gos dang bran khol phyir / /sa yi snying po de la skyabs gsol na/ / re ba 11bzhin du thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur/ /yon tan mang po kun dang ldan pas na12/ /sa chen 'di yang mi gtong rab tu 'dzin/ /de yi rkyen gyis sman dang lo thog rnams/ /snum zhing 'jam la ro dang ldan par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs mang pos bsgribs 1 par gyur nas su/ /mi dge bcu yi salas la mos pa dag /sa tshayi snying po de la skyabs gsol na/ /mi dge nyon mongs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /rnam pa sna tshogs kun gyi lus ston cing / /skye bo mang po dag la chos kyang ston/ /sbyin pa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs pas ni/ /sems can kun la snying brtse bde bar gyur / /gal te bskal pa mang po brgya yi bar/ /de yi yon tan bsngags 65—293

shing rab bstod de/ /mthar phyin rdzogs par 'gyur ba shin tu dka'(1)/ /de bas kun gyis bste stang bcas pas mchod/ /'dus pa chen po las byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo bcu pa zhes bya ba las glengasngo gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //bam po gnyis pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po stan las langs te bla gos phyogs gcig tu byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /yon tan tshad rmed rgya mtsho can/ /bcom ldan 'das la zhu gsol ba/ /the tsom nem nur ci mchis pa/ /bdag la rgyas par bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skyes bu yang dag pa khyod ni chos thams cad ye shes kyis mthong ba la thogs pa med do/ /'on kyang sems can la phan pa dang bde bar 'dod pa'i phyir khyod de bzhin gshegs pa la ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis dris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying pos tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ bdag sngon bskal pa bcu gsum du/ /spyod pa dka' ba shin du spyad / /so so'i skye bo kun don du/ /'jigs pa gsum dang rtog lnga bsal / /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig la/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i mchod bgyis 5 pas/ /bsam pa dag pa'i 'khor 'di dang / /tshogs chen 'dus pa'ang sngon mthong ngo / /blo can brtson 'grus rtsol ba dag /thams cad 'dus 65—294

shing tshogs 'dir lhags/ /shin tu skyon med 'khor 'di dag /mthong bar gyur pa ngo mtshar rmad 1)/ /ci slad sangs rgyas zhing 'di kun/ /sdig pas dge ba nyams bgyis shing / /blo can dag gis spangs pa yi/ /ngan par spyod kun lhan cig gnas/ /mtshams med sdig pa bgyid pa dang / /yang dag dam pa'i chos la skur/ /'phags la smod cing log lta bas/ /rtag dang chad pa'i 3gtsug lag 'chad(5ci/ /sdig pa bcu yi sa)las bgyid cing / /'jig rten phyi mas mi 'jigs pa/ /theg pa rnam gsum ring spangs shing / /sdig can dag la ngan 'gror gzhol/ /ma rig pas ni bsgribs pa'i mig /'dod chags phrag dog sgyus ri 'tsho ba/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab bskor te/ /sems can 'di dag sgrol bar mdzad/ /ji ltar nying mtshams 6sbyor ba yi/ /nyon mongs rdo rje lta bus bcad97)/ /ji lta bur na nagazungs dag 'thob/ /de bzhin bzod pa'ang nges par 'gyur/ /bdag gis 'dren pa tshogs chen dag /mthong bar gyur pa ngo mtshar che/ /'di 'dra'i yon tan kun tshogs pa/ /phyogs gzhan dag na ma mthong ngo / /yon tan mang po kun ldan zhing / /byang chub lam la rab brtson pas / /ji ltar byis pa'i 'khor dag la/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lo bskor ba mdzad / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sngon 'das pa'i dus na yang chu klung gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas dag gi zhing na rnyog pa lnga'i tshe/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chu klung gang gā'i bye ma snyed la sngon 'di lta bu'i don dag zhu ba zhus so/ /khyod kyis dris pa'i don 'di dag la sngon yang nan tan shin tu byas pas shin tu rtogs shing khong du chud do/ /spyod pa mang po phun sum tshogs pa pha rol tu phyin pas shin tu 65wa 295

thabs mkhas pa'i shes rab dang ldan te/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i don thobatupar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad thabs mkhas pas 'phags pa'i spyod pa'i gter sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i spyod pa'i khyad par dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yon tan rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po spyod pa mi dge ba la gnas pa thams cad ngan song gsum las bzlog cing mi ltung bar bya ba dang / zhing 'dir dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung shin tu rgyas shing yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir 'di lta bu'i don dris pa legs so/ /shin tu legs par nyon la yid la zungamadu shig dang /ngas bstan par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar bgyi'o zhes gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das la slar nyan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni sngon gyi smon lam gyi shugs kyis sangs rgyas kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu dang ldan te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnyog pa lnga can gyi sems can thams cad rnam par dkar ba'i chos thams cad las phyir ldog pa dang /'phags pa'i nor rin po che bdun gyis brel ba dang / mkhas pa dag dang ri ring du gyur pa chad pa dang / rtag 4pa'i dra bas kun nas glags 7pa dang /ngan 6song du 'gro ba'i shing rta la spro zhing dga' ba dang / skye ba phyi ma'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs par mi lta ba dang / ma rig pa'i mun nag thibs po la gnas pa la dad pa dang / mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rdzogs par byed pa dang /65—296

mtshams med pa lnga byed pa dang / dam pa'i chos la skur cing 'phags pa la dbang za ba0)/ dge ba'i chos thams cad ring du spong zhing mi dge ba'i chos rdzogs par byed pa'i miganas na bzhugs so/ /de lta bu'i sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i zhing na bzhugs kyang rab tu bde bar bzhugs te/ bag tsha ba med pa dang / 'jigs skrag pa med pas drang srong chen po'i gnas su phyin te / sangs rgyas kyi 'khor lo bskor nas lha dang bdud du bcas pa'i mu stegs can log par ②smra ba thams cad btul nas/ so so'i skye bo thams cad kyi rigs la nyon mongs pa shin tu sra ba rdo rje lta bu dag bsal nas ci la mos pa bzhin du so sor bkod do/ /mthu dang ldan pa'i sems can dag ni theg pa gsum las phyir mi ldog paramasayang mdzad do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ yul kha cig tu srid med par 'gyur ba na de na gnas pa'i mi thams cad bdag gi dmag dang / gzhan gyi dmag gis yongs su gtses shing nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal bar gyur te5/ de na gnas pa'i mi mang po yang mis6 bde bas 'thab pa dang ske/ rtsod pa dngas / gcig la gcig smod pa 58tshad med pa snyed 9'byung ste/brdzun du smra ba dang / g.yo sgyu dang / tshig rtsub por 7smra ba dang / skur klang 11'debs shing 'khrug sna pa dang / dmus long dang / ling tog can du 'gyur ba dang / nad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gzir ba dang / grang ba dang / tsha ba'i nad ma rungs pa dang / rims 1 rnam pa mang po dang / smyo ba dang / skem byed dang / kha zas mi 'ju ba tshadang / sems 'khrug cing myos pa dang /dbang po ma tshang zhing yan lag dang 7nying lag nyams pa dang / bgo tshab dang /bza' ba dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis phongs shing brel te/65—297

bdog pa thams cad yid du mi 'ong ba dang / skye bo thams cad mu stegs can dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi lha la skyabs su song zhing lta ba ngan pa dang / bsam pa ngan pa dang / mos pa ngan pa yongs su rgyas te/ yang dag pa'i lam stor nas ngan song du ltung bar 'gyur ba na/ de'i tshe yul de na gnas pa'i rgan po blo dang ldan zhing yid gzhungs 1pa/ mang du thos pa/ drang dkan tsho sache bas5)'dus nas gros su bgros 4te/ yul dang grong mi kun bsdus nas thams cad kyis 'thun 5par rgyal bu gcig btus pa ni sngon sbyin (6)pa rab tu byas pa/ tshul khrims shin tu bsrungs pa/ brtson 'grus la brtun pa/ shin tu dka' ba5mespyod pa dang ldan pa/ mchog tu gyur pa'i bsod nams kyi mtshan dang ldan pa/dbang po yongs su rdzogs shing yan lag ma nyams pa/ lus byad che chung ran pa/mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa/ phul du gyur pa'i mdog dam pa dang ldan pa/ thams cad kyis bkur sti dang rim gro byed pa/ yul de na gnas pa'i mi thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing lta 'dod pa/ rang bzhin gyis drang zhing brtan pa/ byams pa dang snying rjer ldan pa/ mang du thos pa/ rtsal thams cad dang ldan pa dang 8/ des pa'i bzod pas sems rab tu brgyan pa/btsun mo dam pa'i sras thu bor gyur pa/ spos dam pa rnam pa sna tshogs rnam par dag pa'i chus lus bkrus nas/ rin po ches brgyan pa'i gos dam pa spos kyis bdugs pa rnam pa sna tshogs gyon zhing / nor bu rin po che spyi bo'i gtsug phud la btags pa/ rin po che'i me tog gi 1 phreng bas brgyan pa'i gser gyi cod pan mgo la thogs pa/ rab tu yang la 'jam pa'i dar gyis bcings pa/ gzhan yang nor bu 1rin po che dang / mu tig dang / gser dang / dngul la sogs 65wa 298

pa rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las 1byas pa'i rna cha dang / se mo do dang /dpung rgyan dang / gdu bu la sogs pa thogs pa/ rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las byas pa'i lham gyis rkang pa bteg pa/ rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs las byas pa'i gdugs kyis steng gi bla res na bres pa/ sngon lha dang drang srong thams cad kyis bsrung zhing 'dzin pa'i khri bshams pa/ brgya byin la sogs pa thams cad kyis bsrung 5zhing skyob pa/ bzo shin tu mkhas pas las su byas pa'i gzhal med khang chen por sngon rgyal po snga ma 'dug 'dug pa'i khri la bzhag nas rgyal por bcug go/ /rgyal sar ci zhugs nas lha'i dbang po dang / klu'i dbang po dang /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang / grul bum gyi dbang pos bsrung 5zhing 'dzin pa'i dril bu dang / rnga chen po brdungs nas de'i sgras yul khams kun du grags par gyur te/ rgyal rigs la sogs pa rigs chen po bzhi la gtogs pa'i mi tshad med pa snyed lus yang dag par bkrus nas gos gtsang ma gyon te/ lag na rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rin po che'i gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / nor bu rin po che dang / mu tig dang /gser dang / dngul dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi dziru dang /be+e drur+ya 7la sogs pa tshad med pa snyed thogs te rgyal po de la phul lo/ /gzhan yang rigs mtho zhing btsun pa tshangs par spyod pa/ thos pa dang ldan zhing shes pa che ba'i bram ze thams cad kyis kyang tshigs su bcad pas bstod pa dang / glu dang dbyangs dam pa tshad med pa snyed kyis rgyal po de la bstod pa byas so/ /legs par 'gyur ba rnam pa sna tshogs thob par gyur cig ces smon lam yang 8btab bo/ /bkra shis pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis rgyal po'i spyi bor gtor to/ /65—299

rgyal po snga ma'i blon po'i rigs la gtogs pa thos pa dang ldan zhing shes pa che ba/drang ba/ g.yo med pa/ mdzangs 1)pa dag kyang ci rigs su blon por rim par phye ste bcug nas/ rgyal po'i las byed pas sngon yul de na bdag dang gzhan gyi dmag thams cad kyis gtse bar 'gyur ba dang / phyir rgol ba dang grogs po ngan pa thams cad med par byas nas phasar kyirgol ba'i dgra dang / gnod pa byed pa thams cad zhi bar gyur nas/ nag po'i phyogs thams cad byang zhing rnam par dkar ba'i phyogs thams cad skyes te 'phel bar gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po de lta bu'i 'khor lo gcig dang ldan na/ 'khor lo de'i dbang gis bdag0gi rgyal srid rab tu che zhing phas rgol ba'i dgra thams cad shin tu thul ba las tshe yang ring bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du rnyog pa lnga'i 'jigs5)rten gyi khams mi mjed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi sems kyi bag la nyal ba'i nyon mongs pas yongs 6 su bcings nas nang gi dgra dang / phyi 7)rol gyi dgras rnam par gtses te / kun nas nyon mongs pas nyon mongs nas gti mug gis ldongs 8)te/ mi bde bar gyur pas rtag pa dang chad pa la rnam par zhen cing chags pa tshad med pa bskyed 9tshonas phan tshun rtsod cing 'gal bar byed de/ gcig la gcig dbang za zhing smod pas 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug bskyed 7de g.yo dang sgyu'i tshul du smra zhing mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rdzogs par byed pa dang /rnam par zhen cing chags pa'i skye bo dag nyon mongs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir rnam pa sna tshogs kyi nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis gzir ba dang ldan pas yang 65—300

dag pa'i chos kyi mig ldongs te/ zhe sdang dang khong khro bas gdungs shing (1)'khrugs kyang yang dag pa bden pa'i chos cung zad kyang yid la mi byed des/yang dag pa'i chos kyi ro yongs su btangamo nas dge ba byed pa la dbang za zhing smod do/ /de sngar )bde zhing skyidapha pas ni brel cing phongs par 'gyur gyi rtag tu nyon mongs pa'i dra ba rnam pa mang pos dkris shing glags56)nas mu stegs can gyi ston pa rnam pa drug po la skyabs su song ste/ 'phags pa'i lam las phyir log cing ngan song gsum las gzhol bar gyur 7)to/ /de'i tshe zhing de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sngon sangs rgyas tshad med pa snyed la mchod cing bsnyen bkur byas pa/ sangs rgyas kyilogayon tan gyi rgya mtshor zhugs pa/snga ma 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul la gnas pa thams cad 'dus shing tshogs nas nga'i spyan sngar lhags te tshig 'thun par 'di skad zer ro/ /khyod sngon 'das pa'i dus na sbyin pa tshad med pa la nan tan byas pa dang / tshul khrims rab tu bsrungs pa dang / shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis shin tu spyad dka' ba spyad de(9)/ thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms so/ /de lta bu'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang / shes rab dang / thabs mkhas pa dang / snying rje chen po la sogs pas yongs su brgyan pas yon tan chen po'i gter du gyur pa/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang gzungs rnams 1 las rab tu bzod pa/ sa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgya mtshor gyur pa'o/ /g.yo dang sgyu med cing lus byad (11shin tu ring la mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum tshogs par gyur pa dang des pa'i bzod pa dang ldan zhing shin tu mdzes par gyur pal/ gzhan gyi dring la mi 'brang bas byang chub kyi lam bsgom par ye shes kyi rgya 65wa 301

mtsho thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa/ phul du gyur pa'i mdog mchog dam pa dang ldan 15par gyur pa2/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ston pa chen por gyur pa/ 'khor bas 'jigs skrag pa'i sems can thams cad kyi dpung gnyen du gyur pa/ byams pa dang snying rje chen po la sogs pa yon tan tshad med pas yongs su brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das log par dad sel dang /gser thub dang / 'od srung la sogs pa'i sras yang dag pa bskal pa bzang po 'dir mngon par 'tshang rgya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi nang na gtso bor gyur pa/ yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi spos can/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi chu yongs su dag pas khrus byas pa/ khrel ba dang 'dzem pa'i gos gyon pa/ rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings gtsug gi nor bur thogs pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul rgya chen po'i me tog gi phreng ba'i cod pan thogs pa/ rnam par grol ba'i srad bus bcings pa/ gzhan yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / mi skye ba'i bzod pa la sogs pa yon tan gyi rin po ches 4yongs su brgyan pa/ byams pa chen po dang / snying rje dang ske/ dga' ba dang / btang snyoms kyi lham rin po che gyon pa/ khams gsum yongs su khebs pa'i spyod pa rnam gsum gyis 'phags pa'i rgyu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i gdugs kyis bkab pa/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang / lha dang ske/ drang srong gis yongs su bzung ba'i rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gdan bshams pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bkur sti dang bcas te yongs su bzung ba'i dran pa nye bar gzhag 5pa bzhi la bzhugs pa/sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bting 6ba'i gdan la bzhugs nas bla na med 65—302

pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su gyur pa dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi gcad 1/pa'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tol/ /chos kyi rnga rab tu brdungs nas khams gsum kun du chos kyi sgra bsgrags te/lha dang / klu dang /na gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' 5lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / grul bum dang ske/ 'byung po dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po dang /mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa thams cad ca'aphags pa'i bden pa bzhis grol bar byas so/ /yan lag bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gang 'jig rten du bcas pa dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / lha dang / bdud dang /tshangs pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa gang gis kyang ma bskor ba de/'jig rten du bcas pa lha dang mi tshad med pa dag la phan pa dang bde ba'i don chen po mchog dam pa thob par bya ba'i phyir sngon gang gis kyang ma bskor ba de rnam pa gsum du rab tu bskor to/ /rigs kyi bu nga de lta bu'i risangs rgyas kyi 'khor lo gcig pa de dang ldan te/ 'khor lo de'i dbang gis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten phyi ma dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mngon sum du mkhyen pas 'jigs pa med pa thob ste/ bde bar gnas shing lha dang bdud du bcas pa'i mu stegs can log par smra ba thams cad shin tu btul nas tshangs pa chen po'i 'khor lo bskor te/ tshangs pa chen po'i spyad 6pa shin tu grub pas nga ni rtog pa lnga'i sdig pa can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du seng ge'i sgra yang dag par bsgrags te/ sems can thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga'i las zhi bar byas so/ /de bzhin du mi dge 65wa 303

ba'i rtsa bar gtogs pa thams cad bsalam 1)nas skye bo thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i rgyun rdo rje ltar sra ba dag kyang zhi bar byed do/ /zag pa thams cad yongs su zad pa rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu dam pa la rnam par bzhag dunanonas ci dang ci la mos pa bzhin du thams cad bde bar 'jog pa dang / mthu dang ldan pa'i sems can dag ni theg pa gsum la bzhag ste phyir mi ldog par yang mdzad do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po thog ma rgyal sar zhugs nas rgyal po'i srid bzung ma thag tu 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi rgyal po thams cad kyis0)chos dang khrims la shin tu lta zhing rtog go/ /de ltar rgyal po kun gyi las kyi 'khor lo shin tu rtogs nas rgyu dang 'bras bu smin pa yang shes te/ ci dang cir ldan pa bzhin de dang de lta bu'i 4thabs byin te las su bcug pas/ yul de na gnas pa'i mdzangs rangan las las 6)kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum byed du bcug go/ /las kyi 'khor lo de'i dbang gis de na 7gnas pa'i sems can thams cad yun ring por 8'tsho ba'i yo byad yid du 'ong ba rnam pa sna tshogs la longs spyod pa dang / bde skyid 'phel zhing skye ba dang / pas rgol ba'i dgra thams cad kyang thul bar gyur torka/ /las kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rgyal po srid kyi las 95kyi 'khor lo rnam par bzhag 1 ripas gang dgra thabs mkhas par bslabasate/stoshing rtsal sbyangs te/ phas 12rgol ba'i dgra 'dul zhing mi mang po srung bar byed pa dang / zhing dang gnas byed pa'i las kyi 'khor lo tu rnam par bzhagatshadapas gang khang khyim brtsigs 7pa dang zhing gi las lag byad sakyis phyin par byed du 'jug cing bde bar byas pas bza' ba dang btung bas mi brel bar byed pa dang /65wa 304

nor rin po che tshol ba'i las kyi 'khor lo rnam par bzhag 1)pas gang tshong spogs dang ske/ bzo rnam pa sna tshogs slob tu gzhugs5)cing 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs yid bzhinas /du spyad du yod la bde zhing skyid pa 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po rgyal po'i ca'akhor lo gsum ri kyipo 'di dang ldan na 'khor lo 'di'i dbang gis bdag gi 6)yul rab tu bde zhing skyid pa dang / phas rgol ba'i dgra dang grogs po ngan pa btul zhing lus srung ba'i nan tan la mkhas pas tshe yang ring bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i yang 7thog ma mngon par sangs rgyas te nabla na med pa'i ye shes thob nas 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi mig la shin tu rtog gol/ /de ltar shin tu brtags pas las dang chos rnams kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu rab tu mkhyen te/ 'dul bar 'gyur ba'i sems can thams cad la las kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum rnam par gzhag 9go/ /las kyi 'khor lo de'i dbang gis dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung dang / chos kyi mig yun ring du gnas pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag pa'i chos rgya cher kun du khyab pa dang / skye bo thams cad rtag tu mtho ris kyi 1 lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar du shin tu bde ba thob pa dang / mu stegs can log par smra ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs shing yang dag 11pa'i chos kyi mig gis phas rgol ba thams cad chos bzhin du thul 12bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rigs kyi bu las kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i las kyi 'khor lo rnam par gzhag 1 pa dang /kha don ngagoms par bya ba'i las kyi 'khor lo rnam par gzhag dpa dang / bsod 65—305

nams bya ba'i las kyi 'khor lo rnam par gzhag 1)pa dang gsum mo/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i las kyi 'khor lo gang zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin rnam pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa'i lus 'di la brtags na yul drug dang / bdag dang bdag gir zhen cing chags pa'i rgyu dang / las kyi zhing dang / ma rig pas bsgribs pa dang / sred pa'i chus brlan pa'i dbang med par gzhan nagyi dbang gis yod par gyur pas rkyen rimang po la rag las pa'oglu/ /las dang nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyun rnam pa gsum po dgag pa'i phyir de ltar brtag go/ /las kyi rgyun gang zhe na/ gang sems can rnams ji snyed kyi 'du byed mngon du spyod pa de ma rig pa dang / sred pa'i rgyu las srid pa skye bas nyon mongs pa'i rgyun ces bya'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis rnam par shes pa'i rgyu dang rkyen mang po 'dus pa las ming dang gzugs skye'o / /ming dang gzugs kyi rgyu dang rkyen mang po 'dus pa las skye mched drug skye'o/ /skye mched drug gi rgyu dang rkyen mang po 'dus pa las reg pa dang / tshor ba dang /srid pa phyi ma'i skye ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba la sogs pa rim gyis 'byung ba ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyun ces bya'o/ /de ltar rgyun gsum po 'di ni las kyi zhing la ma rig pa'i rgyu dang / sred pa'i brlan 5gyis skye bar gyur to/ /'di ltar las kyi zhing la tshim rig pa'i rgyu dang / sred pa'i brlan gyis 8rnam pa gsum po bskam 9pa'i phyir nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang ske/ bdag med pa dang / bems po dang / g.yo ba med pa dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu ba lta bu dang / chu'i zla ba lta bu dang / rmi lam lta bu stong 65—306

pa ci yang med pa/ mtshan ma med pa/ smon pa med pa/ byas pa med pa/ ma byung ba/ ma skyes pa/ gzugs med pa/ zhi ba dang / dben pa dang /1)byung ba dang / skye ba'i gnas med par rtogs so/ /de ltar nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la shin tu brtags pas stong pa nyid dang rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pa dang ske/ mtshan ma med pa'i rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pa la phyogs so/ /yang nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la rjes su brtag par bya ba'i phyir gzhan yang thabs mkhas pas dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba la rtog ste nang du rgyu ba dang / phyir rgyu ba'i dran pa goms par byed done/ /de la ji ltar na dran pa'i dbang gis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba la rtog ce na/ yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du bgrang ba dang ske/ rjes su 'brang ba dang / zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong dang / 'jug pa dang / yongs su dag pa 2la rtog go/ /de la bgrang bas ni las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ rten du gyur pas rnam par rtog pa dang /rnam par dpyod pa rnams thul ba dang / dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin par nus pa'o/ /rjes su 'brang bas kyang las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ yang dag par 'byung ba la rten cing rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa dang bral ba dang / dbugs phyi nang 8du rgyu ba'i 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid la mkhas par gyur pa'o/ /zhi gnas kyis kyang las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba bri bar mngon du ston pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi mchog la gnas par nus pa'o/ /lhag mthong gis kyang las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/65—307

dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba zad par mngon du ston pa dang / sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos so sor 1rtogs pa la gnas pa'o/ /'jug pas kyang las kyi dngos po rnam pa gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ nye bar len pa'i phung po spong ba'i sbyor tshonab la mkhas pa dang / 'phags pa'i sar 'jug pa la sbyor ba'o/ /yongs su dag pas kyang bya ba'i las kyi dngos po gnyis byed par 'gyur te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa spong ba dang / lta ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /de ltar sbyor ba rnam pa drug gis dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba la rtog pa bsgoms pas nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga rtogs pa dang rjes su 'thun par 'jug go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ji ltar dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba'i rang bzhin ni gzugs nye bar len pa'i phung po'ol/ /dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba len cing myong bar byed pa ni tshor ba nye bar len pa'i phung po'o/ /dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba'i mtshan nyid len pa ni 'du shes nye bar len pa'i phung po'o/ /dbugs phyi nang du rgyu bte namangon du byed pa ni 'du byed nye bar len pa'i phung po'o/ /dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba bye brag tu 'byed pa ni rnam par shes pa nye bar len pa'i phung po ste/ de ltar nye bar len pa'i phung po rnam pa caskulnga bshad pa ni so so ba/ tha dad pa mi 'dra ba/ gsar ma yin pa / rnying ma yin pa/ gnas med pa/ spungs pa med pa ma yin pa/ brjod du med pa'o5/ /de ltar nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga shin tu rtogs pas 'du byed rnam pa gsum yongs su spong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te de ltar 'du byed rnam pa gsum yongs su zad 6 par rjes su brtags pa'i mthar phyin na rnam par shes pa dang bcas pa'i lus dang / yul drug rjes su rtogs pa'i mthar phyin par 'gyur rol/ /bdag dang bdag gir zhen pa dang / las dang / ma rig pa dang /65—308

srid pa'i rgyu dang / zhing dang / kun nas 'gebs pa'i rlanas1pa yang thams cad zad par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag tshon/pa bzhi bsgom pa yang yongs su rdzogs pa nas 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i bar du yangs bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa 3)brgyad kyi bar du yang bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang / mi skye ba'i chos kyi bzod pa dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i bar du bsgom pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du 'gro ba dang 5lta'ong ba rjes su dran pas gzung bar bsam gtan dag la zhugs pa ni yang dag pa'i chos don7dam pa la gnas pa'i sems can zhes bya'o/ /bsam gtan yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsgomatshunapa zhes bya'o/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la yang dag par mchod 8pa zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs las byung ba'i sras thams cad kyi gsung las skyes pa/ chos kyis grub pa/9chos kyisatshamabatul ba zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' la las de ltar bsgoms 11pa las bags kyis phyir nur na yang zag pa zad pa'i dgra bcom par gyur pa nas mngon par shes pa drug dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' la la de ltar bsgoms pas gong nas gong du 'phar kyi ba ni yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen por gyur pa nas sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa 1 brgyad dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 65—309

ngas rnam pa de snyed kyi las dang / chos dang / tshor ba dang / rgyu dang /'bras bu dang / rnam par smin pa la ye shes kyis dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi chos la brtags na sems can dag ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i las kyi 'khor lo bcu rnam par bzhag 1la sgom du 'dzud do/ /rigs kyi bu de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom na pa'i las kyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i kha ton goms pa'i las kyi 'khor lo zhe na / gang dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dge ba'i rtsa ba chung zhing srab pa dang / kun rdzob kyi bden pa la gnas pa dbang po yongs su ma smin pa dag la ngas kha ton goms dpar bya ba la btsud de/ srod dang tho rangs la le lo med par shin tu brtson la'agrus rtsom pa 5dang / sems can gang bla na med pa'i ye shes tshol ba dag ni ngas rnam par dkar ba'i theg pa chen po la btsud de/bdag nyid klog pa dang / pha rol po gzhan klog tu 'jug pa dang / bdag nyid 'don pa dang / pha rol po gzhan 'don du 'jug pa dang / bdag nyid 'chang ba 6dang / pha rol po gzhan 'chang 7)du 'jug pa dang / theg pa chen po la bdag goms par bya ba dang / pha rol po gzhan goms par byed du 'jug pa dang ske/ bdag dang gzhan gyi kun nas nyon mongs pa bsal 8ba dang / bla na med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar bya ba dang / 'jigs pa med pa'i grong khyer chen por bzhugs 9pa'i phyir rtsol lo/ /sems can gang 1 rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa 'dod pa dag ni ngas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i chos la btsud 65—310

nas kha ton goms par byed du bcug go/ /sems can gang nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dod pa dag la ni ngas gzhung tshigs su bcad pa stong phrag brgya pa dang /'dul ba tshigs su bcad pa stong phrag brgya pa dang / chos mngon pa dang mngon par smra ba tshigs su bcad pa stong phrag brgya nya)pa la sogs pa kha ton goms par byed du bcug pa de ni rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i kha ton goms par bya ba'i las kyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i las kyi 'khor lo zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can gang dbang po rtul bge/ dge ba'i rtsa chib ma bskyedam pa/ shes rab zhan pa dang ske/ le lo dang bcas pa/ dran pa nyams pa 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnam pa kun la zhen cing chags pa/ dge ba'i bshes riganyen yongs su spong ba dag ni ngas bsod nams bya ba'i las la btsud do/ /'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang ske/ dge 'dun la bya ba byed pa dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon la bya ba byed pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams sgrub pa'i las kyi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar na phyini sangs rgyas kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa 'di dang ldan te/ 'khor lo de'i dbang gis bla na med pa'i dus gsum gyi las kyi ye shes kyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi las dang / chos dang / tshor ba dang / rgyu dang / 'bras bu yongs su smin pa mkhyen te/ cis 'dul ba bzhin du las kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum rnam par bzhag )rinas snod du gyur pa'i sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don dang / 'jigs pa med pa la bde bar 8bkod do/ /'jigs pa med pas lha dang bdud du bcas pa'i mu stegs can log par smra ba thams cad 65—311

btul nas tshangs pa chen po'i 'khor lo bskor zhing / tshangs pa rten po'i spyad pa yongs su grub pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can gyi rgyu dang 'bras bu kun mngon par mkhyen to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po ni thabs mkhas pa'i blo dang ldan pas dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang ske/ dmangs 1 rigs la sogs pa yon tan rnam padzan/sna tshogs dang / mang du thos pa dang / dpa' bo dadang / bzo borabadang / rtsal che ba dang /sems can gang phyug cing yon tan dang ldan pa/ thabs mkhas pa'i blo dang ldan pa / dpa' zhing rtul phod pa/ brtan pa/ phyir mi ldog pa/ bsod nams rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su brgyan pa de dag la rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen pos de dag ci dang ldan pa bzhin ci 'os ci rigs su rin po che dang / nor gyi dbyig57dang / zhing 'brog dang / khang khyim dang / bran dang / las byed pa'i mi la sogs pa ci rigs su sbyin par byed do/ /yul de na gnas pa'i mi yon tan dang shes pa zhan pa/ las byas pa chung ba dag la ni rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen pos de dag la yang ci 'os ci rigs su shasam6)kyis sbyin par byed do/ /yul de na gnas pa bsod nams med cing brtson 'grus chung ba/ le lo che ba/ bag med pa/dran pa nyams pa/ snying rje'i sems med pa/ byas pa mi gzos ba/ 'jig rten phyi ma'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs par mi lta ba/ khyim gyi 'dam du bying ba/sdig pa mang po byed pa de dag la ni rgyal po chen pos ci rigs ci 'os su chad pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gcod de/ kha cig la ni tshig na bsaman/spyos shingamathurabargyad 65—312

pa dag byed do/ /kha cig la ni rin po che dang nor rdzas la sogs pa 'phrog go/ /kha cig la ni 'tsho ba'i yo byad dag kyang 'phrog go/ /kha cig la ni lcag 1gis gzhu〈ba dang btson55)rar bcug go/ /kha cig la ni yan lag dang nying lag gcod do/ /kha cig la ni mgo dang lus kyang gcod de de dag la sogs pa chad pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis chad pa gcod do/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po rgyal po'i 'khor lo gsum pa 'di dang ldan te/ 'khor lo de'i dbang gis bdag gi yul rab tu bde zhing skyid pas pas margol ba'i dgra thams cad dang / grogs po ngan pa btul cing lus srung ba'i nan tan mkhas pas tshe yang ring bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin dusngon)de bzhin gshegs pa yangs56)dbang po la shin tu mkhas pa'i ye shes dang ldan pas 'khor gang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang / thabs dang shes rab las ring du gyur pa/ sbyin pa dang / dul ba dang / zhi ba yongs su spangs te dran pa nyams nas sems 'khrugs par gyur pa dag nga gang na ba der 'ongs te nga la skyabs su 'ongs nas de dag gi dbang po dang / dad pa dang /bag la nyal ba dang / mos pa shin tu mkhyen pas ci dang cis 'dul ba bzhin du chad pas gcad pa'i thabs 'dul ba la sogs pa'i chos ston to/ /sems can gang nga rgyal gyi dbang du gyur te/ bslab pa mang po gzungs su mi 'dzin pa dag la ni ngas bstan pa'i 7)dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir dngos po 'di dag byed du gzhug gon// /la lar ni dran par bya ba'i dam bca' bas chad pas gcod59)do/ /la lar ni tshig na bas bsdigs pa dang / gshe ba dang ske/ spyo bas gcodam do/ /la lar ni skad cig dgar zhing sma dbab pas 65—313

gcod 1do/ /la lar ni phyag 'tshal ba dang / mi smra ba dang / rnyed pa lhan cig tu mi spyod pas gcod 2do/ /la lar ni rtsa dgram pa lta bu dang / la lar ni bskrad pa la sogs pa'i chad pas bcadam pa ste/ de ltar gang zag de dag gi dbang po dang / dad pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang / mos pa kun mkhyen pas ci rigs ci 'os su chad pas gcod 5)do/ /de yang don med pa'i mun pa'i tshogs bsags pa gzhom pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i chu bo bskam pa dang /mtho ris kyi lhar skye ba nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bde ba thob pa'i phyir mi dge ba spyod pa'i gang zag 'dul ba'i phyir ci dang ci rigs su chad pas gcad pa'i chos bstan to/ /mdo sde mang po las kyang mi dge ba spyod pa chad pas gcad pa'i chos ci dang ci rigs 6pa de dang de'i chos rgya 7)cher bshad do/ /ngas mchog dam pa'i ye shes kyis sems can gang lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / dad pa dang /mos pa yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa yang shin tu mkhyen pas ci dang cis 'dul ba bzhin du dge ba'i phyogs kyi khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs bstan te/ bslab cing goms su bcug pa nas dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi bar du yongs su rdzogs shing 'jigs pa med pa'i grong khyer chen por btsud 8do/ /rigs kyi bu nga ni de ltar sangs rgyas kyi 9'khor lo gsum po 'di dang ldan te 'khor lo 'di'i dbang gis sems can thams cad kyi dbang po rnam pa sna tshogs dang / dad pa dang /bag la nyal ba dang / mos pa dang / bsam pa dang / las dang / myong ba'i chos kun mkhyen pas ci dang cis 'dul ba bzhin du phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyis 'jigs pa med pa la bde bar bkod do/ /'jigs pa med pas nga ni drang srong chen po'i gnas su dam bca' zhing sangs rgyas kyi 'khor lo rab tu 65—314

bskor nas lha dang bdud du bcas pa'i mu stegs can log par smra ba thams cad btul te 'khor mang po'i dkyil 'khor du seng ge'i sgra sgrogs 1)so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po ni bdag gi yul na gang zag ji snyed cig 'jig rten gyi lha dang mu stegs can rnam pa sna tshogs la skyabs su song zhing log pa la dad pa dang / log par lta ba dang ske/ log pa la slob pa dang / log pa'i brtul zhugs la mngon par zhen te/log pa'i 9 ltas bzang ngan la chags nas don med pa'i sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis 45)sdug bsngal bar gyur pa dag rgyal po chen po des shes nas rtag tu yang dang yang bsdus te/ rgyal po snga ma'i dam pa'i chos lugs kyis rgyas par bstan nas log par lta ba dang / log par dad pa spongs ca la/ rgyal po snga ma'i chos lugs bslab pa la nan tan du spyod cig par bkas btags 5te/yul de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad 'jug pa gcig /phyogs pa gcig/bsam pa gcig /'dod pa gcig par 6thams cad 'thun par rgyal po snga ma'i dam pa'i chos bzhin du gnas pa 7dang / bka' bzhin du nyan cing rjes su spyod pas de na gnas pa thams cad 'thun par gang bya bar rigs pa rnams byed do/ /rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po yang rtag tu blon po rnams dang 'dus nas ston mo byed cing longs spyod de/dga' bas rol cing gshegs pas gros 'thun pas rgyal po'i las byed do/ /rigs kyi bu rgyal rigs rgyal thabs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal po chen po de ltar rgyal po'i 'khor lo bzhi po na'adi dang ldan te/ 'khor lo de'i dbang gis bdag gi yul rab 9tu bde zhing skyid pa dang / phas rgol ba'i dgra 1 thams cad 65—315

dang ske/ grogs po ngan pa btul zhing lus srung ba'i nan tan la mkhas pas tshe yang ring bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa yang shin tu thabs mkhas pa'i mos pas1)mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pas 'jig rten na log pa la phyogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / log par lta ba dang /log pa'i bsam pa dang / log pa'i chos la mos pa dang / log pa'i las spyod pa de'i rgyu de'i rkyen gyis sdug bsngal tshad med pa myong bar de bzhin gshegs pas mkhyen cing gzigs nas rtag tu yang dang yang 'khor mang po bsdus te snga ma 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung bsab pa'i rgyu dang / 'bras bu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / rnal 'byor pa'i rgyu dang / sdom pa gsum la sogs pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos rgyas par phye ste mngon par bstan nas 'khor mang po rnams rnam par grol bar byed do/ /phyin ci log tu lta ba rnams yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / dge bsngon bcu'i yang dag pa'i las kyi lam la rnam par 'jug go/ /sems can rnams ni rtag tu 'thun par chos la 'jug /chos la spyod par thabs kyis drang zhing sgom du 'dzud pas rgyu dang 'bras bu rgyun mi 'chad par byed do/ /sems can rnams 'khor rnam bzhi dang 'thun par dge ba spyod pa'i khyad par la nan tan byed du bcug nas dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes ston pa dang / lam gyi yan lag la spro chibazhin du rtse'o/ /'phags pa'i bstan pa yun du gnas par bya ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba'i phyir yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag 65—316
