dpa' chen pos phra ma yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor lo lnga pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na nyan thos kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung yongs su 'phel ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i nye gnas chos kyi snod dam/chos kyi snod ma yin pa yang rung / chung ngu na chos gos kyi tshal bu gyon zhing skra dang kha spu bregs pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur1/ theg pa chen po'i chos la gong nas gong du 'phar zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rno ba'i shes rab dang /bsod nams kyi khyad par rtag tu skye zhing 'phel ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /gzungs nanodang / bzod pa dang / sa rnams thams cad la dbang du 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad cing de'i rjes su 'gro ba dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi nye gnas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / chos thos pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge 'dun /mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur 4)byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshol ba la brtson pas sems mi ngoms pa dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa dang / smon lam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sems mi ngoms par 'gyur te/ 'bras bu gzhan 'thob 5pa yang ji skad bshad pa bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems 65—513

dpa' chen po gang nam 'tsho'i 1bar du zhe gcod pa'i tshig thams cad yongs su spangs na sems can thams cad kyis bkur zhing bla mar byed pa dang / tshig tu smra ba kun la pha rol po kun dga' zhing nyan pas dogs pa med par 'gyur te/de'i dbang gis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thog ma med pa'i mtha' nas rgyud lngar 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'bying ba yang zhe gcod pa'i tshig gi dbang gis lus dang / ngag dang / yid mi dge ba'i las bdag kyang byed la/ gzhan yang byed du 'dzud cing mthong ba dang thos pa'i rjes su yi rang ba las byung ba nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / sems can gyi sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang / shin tu dul ba la sgrib napas bsgribs par gyur to/ /'di ltar zhe gcod pa'i tshig yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor los lhag ma ma lus par yongs su bcom pa'i dbang gis rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yongs su mi len te/ lus 'di nyid la yang lha dang mi la sogs pa kun dga' bas dogs pa mi skye ba dang / lus dang sems rab tu bde ba dang / tshig tu smra ba thams cad pha rol gyi yid du 'ong ba dang snyan par 'gyur ro/ /nam 'chi 'pho ba'i dus byed pa na yang lus dang sems la sdug bsngal gyis /mi gdung zhing nyon mi mongs pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i bu dang chung ma dang 'khor thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bas 'chi 'pho ba'i dus byed par 'gyur gyi shin tu 'jigs pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/ tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de lus dang sems rab tu dga' ba dang /de la bkur sti dang bcas pas shin tu dad pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'phos nas la65—514

kyang phyir mi'i nang du skyes na yang dbang po yongs su rdzogs shing yan lag dang ldan pa dang / gang nas gang du skyes par tshig 'jam por smra ba ga1dang / byad gzugs bzang ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / rab tu bde zhing skyid pa dang ske/ phyir yang yid du 'ong ba'i nadage ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/tshul khrims dang / yon tan du ldan pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de de'i rjes su slob pa dang / zhe gcod pa'i tshig yongs su spong ba dang ske/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su gcod pa dang / dge ba'i chos khyad par can thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad tshol ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa thams cad rim gyis gzhol zhing shin tu yangs 5)pa'i ye shes kyims)rgya mtsho la 'jug pa nas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du 'thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing na yid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra thams cad dang bral te/ yid du 'ong ba'i sgra dbyangs snyan pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / chos kyi sgras zhing de yongs su gang ba dang / dran pa dang blo gros su ldan pa/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs can/ shin tu dul ba'i sems can dag zhing der skye ba dang / rtag tu tshig 'jam pos gcig la gcig skul sgrubar byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshe'i 'tshad kyang dpag tu med de/ sems can dag cis 'dul ba bzhin du chos ston pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas zhing /sems can tshad med pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhe gcod pa'i tshig yongs su spangs pa'i na'akhor lo drug pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 65—515

'khor lo 'di dang ldan pas nyan thos kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro6)/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur / theg pa chen po'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung yongs su 'phel ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i nye gnas chos kyi snod dam/ chos kyi snod ma yin pa yang rung chung ngu na chos gos kyi tshal bu gyon cing skra dang kha spu bregs pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i chos la gong nas gong du 'phar ga zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rno ba'i shes rab dang / bsod nams kyi khyad par rtag tu skye zhing 'phel ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa dang /sa rnams thams cad la dbang du 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad cing rjes su 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi nye gnas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / chos thos pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshol ba la brtson pas sems mi ngoms pa dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa dang smon lam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sems mi ngoms par 'gyur te/ 'bras bu gzhan dag thob pa yang ji skad bshad pa bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang nam 'tsho'i ribar du tshig kyal pa yongs su spangs pas sems can thams cad 65—516

kyis bkur zhing bla mar byed pa dang / tshig tu smra ba thams cad don du 'gyur zhing tshig thos pa rnams nyan cing gus pas dogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de'i dbang gis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thog ma med pa'i mtha' nas rgyud lngar 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying7ba yang tshig kyalasngo pa smra ba'i dbang gis lus dang / ngag dang / yid mi dge ba'i las bdag kyang byed la/ gzhan yang byed du 'dzud cing mthong ba dang thos pa'i rjes su tsho yismos)rang ba las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / sems canamaragyi sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang / don du smra ba la sgrib pas bsgribasamachi par gyur to/ /'di ltar tshig kyal pa yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor los lhag ma ma lus par yongs su bcom pas rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu mi len par byed do/ /lus 'di nyid la lha dang mi la sogs pa kun dga' zhing yid du 'ong bas dogs pa med par 'gyur ba dang / lus dang sems rab tu bde ba dang / tshig tu smra ba thams cad don du 'gyur 7)ba dang / 'chi 'pho 8ba'i dus byed pa na yang lus dang sems la sdug bsngal gyis mi gdung zhing yid du 'ong ba'i bu dang /chung ma dang / 'khor gyis yongs su bskor bas 'chi 'pho ba'i dus byed par 'gyur gyi shin tu 'jigs pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/ tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de lus dang sems rab tu dga' ba dang / de 9la bkur sti dang bcas shing shin tu dad pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'phos nas kyang phyir mi'i nang du skye zhing dbang po yongs su rdzogs pa yan lag dang ldan pa dang / gang nas gang du skyes par phan pa dang /65—517

don du 'gyur ba'i tshig smra ba dang / byad gzugs bzang ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / rab tu bde zhing skyid pa dang / phyir yang yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/ tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de1)/ de'i rjes su slob pa dang /tshig kyal par smra ba yongs su spong ba dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su gcod pa dang / dge ba'i chos khyad par can thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad tshol ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa thams cad la rim gyis gzhol zhing shin tu yangs pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa nas bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing don med pa'i tshig thams cad dang bral te/ byang chub sems dpa'i 0sde snod du gtogs pa'i chos chen po'i sgra mchog dam pa rnam pa mang pos zhing de yongs su khyab pa dang / dpags tu med pa'i smon lam dang / ye shes dam pa phun sum tshogs pas chos kyi don rnam pa sna tshogs 'chad pa la mkhas pa'i sems can de lta bu dag zhing der skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshe'i tshad kyang dpag tu med de/sems can dag cis 'dul ba bzhin du dam pa'i chos ston to/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing sems can tshad med pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshig kyal pa yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor lo bdun pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor lo 'di dang ldan pas nyan thos kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ nyan thos 65—518

kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur(1)/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/theg pa chen po'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung yongs su 'phel ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i nye gnas chos kyi snod dam/ chos kyi snod ma yin pa yang rung chung ngu na chos gos kyi tshal bu gyon cing skra dang kha spu bregs pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i 5chos la gong nas gong du 'phar zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rno ba'i shes rab dang / bsod nams kyi khyad par rtag tu skye zhing 'phel ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa dang /sa rnams thamasam cad la dbang du 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad cing de'i rjes su 'gro ba dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos kyi nye gnas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / chos thos pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshol ba la brtson pas sems mi ngoms pa dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa dang smon 4tsholam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis sems mi ngoms par 'gyur te/ 'bras bu gzhan thob pa yang ji skad bshad pa bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang nam 'tsho'imasarabar du chags sems yongs su spangs na sems can thams cad kyis bkur zhing btsun par byed pa dang / sems rnam par dag cing rnyog pa 65—519

dang bral te/ de'i dbang gis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thog ma med pa'i mtha' nas rgyud lngar0)'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'bying ba yang chags sems kyi dbang gis lus dang / ngag dang / yidasasdig pa mi dge ba'i las bdag kyang byed la gzhan yang byed du 'dzud cing mthong ba dang thos pa'i rjes su yi rang ba las byung ba ( nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang /sems can gyi sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang / 'dod sems med pa la sgrib pas bsgribs ri par 'gyur ro/ /'dod sems yongs su spongasnyiba'i 'khor los lhag ma ma lus par yongs su bcom pas rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yongs su mi len te/ lus 'di nyid la yang lha dang mi la sogs pa kun dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba dang / dogs pa med par 'gyur ba dang / lus dang sems rab tu bde ba dang / sems rnam par dag cing rnyog pa dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi 'pho ba'i dus byed pa na yang lus dang sems la sdug bsngal gyis mi gdung ba dang ske/ yid du 'ong ba'i bu dang / chung ma dang / 'khor gyis yongs su bskor ri nibs 'chi 'pho 7ba'i dus byed par 'gyur gyi/ shin tu'u'ajigs pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/ tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/ bsod nams —kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de lus dang sems rab tu dga' ba dang / de la bkur sti dang bcas pas shin tu dad pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'phos nas kyang phyir mi'i nang du skye zhing dbang po yongs su rdzogs pa/ yan lag dang ldan pa/gang nas gang du skyes par sems rnam par dag cing rtog pa med pa dang / byad gzugs bzang ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / rab tu bde zhing skyid pa 65—520

dang / phyir yang yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de/ de'i rjes su slob pa dang / chags sems yongs su spong 3)ba dang /mi dge ba'i chos yongs su gcad ②pa dang / dge ba'i chos khyad par can thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad tshol ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa thams cad la rim gyis gzhol zhing shin tu yangs pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa nas bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing lag mthil bzhin du mnyam la〈kyerin po che rnam pa mang pos yongs su gang ba dang /rin po che'i shing rnam pa sna tshogs dkrigs pa dang / rin po che'i gos dang /rin po che'i rgyan gyi yo byad dang / rin po che'i rgyalarkamatshan dang / ba dan dang ske/ gdugs dang / gser dang / dngul dang / mu tig gi dra ba dang /shing la sogs pas yongs su gang ba dang / shin tu yid du 'ong zhing blta na sdug pal/ nga rgyal yongs su spangs pa/ byad gzugs shin tu mdzes pa dang /dbang po ma nyams pa/ sems mnyam pa'i sems can dag zhing der skye bar 'gyur te/ chags sems med pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pas brgyan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshe'i tshad kyang dpag tu med de⑥/ sems can dag cis 'dul ba bzhin du dam pa'i chos ston to/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing sems can tshad med pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chags sems yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor lo 65—521

brgyad pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na nyan thos kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung yongs su 'phel ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i nye gnas chos kyi snod dam/ chos kyi snod ma yin pa yang rung chung ngu na chos gos kyi tshal 1 bu gyon cing skra dang kha spu bregs pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po'i chos la gong nas gong du 'phar zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rno ba'i shes rab dang / bsod nams kyi khyad par rtag tu skye zhing 'phel ba dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa dang / sa rnams thams cad la dbang du 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad cing de'i narjes su 'thun par 'gyur ba dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos kyi nye gnas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / chos thos pa dang mi 'bral ba dang ske/ dge 'dun la mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang ske/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshol ba la brtson pasang mi ngoms pa(nga)/ byang chub kyi spyod pa dang smon lam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis tshesems mi ngoms par 'gyur te / 'bras bu gzhan dag thob pa yang ji skad bshad pa bzhin no// /9)bam po dgu pa/ rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems 65—522

dpa' chen po gang nam 'tsho'i 511bar du gnod sems yongs su spangs na/sems can thams cad kyis bkur zhing bla mar byed pa dang / sems rnam par dag pa dang / dri ma dang bral bar 'gyur te/ de'i dbang gis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thog ma med pa'i mtha' nas rgyud lngar 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'bying ba yang gnod sems kyi dbang gis lus dang / ngag dang / yid rin)sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bdag kyang byed la gzhan yang byed du 'dzud cing mthong ba dang thos pa'i rjes su yi ( rang ba las byung ba nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / sems can gyi sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang / gnod sems byedas44)pa la sgrib pas bsgribs57par gyur to/ /'di ltar gnod sems yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor los lhag ma ma lus par yongs su bcom pas rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yongs su mi len te/ lus 'di nyid la yang lha dang mi la sogs pa kun dga' 55)zhing yid du 'ong ba dang /dogs par mi 'gyur ba dang / sems rnam par dag pa dang / dri ma dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi 'pho ba'i dus byed pa na yang lus dang sems la sdug bsngal gyis mi gdung zhing yid du 'ong ba'i bu dang / chung ma dang / 'khor thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bas 'chi 'pho ba'i dus byed par 'gyur gyi/shin tu 'jigs pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'im shebashes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/ tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de lus dang sems rab tu dga' ba dang / de la bkur sti dang bcas pas shin tu dad pa skye bar 'gyur rol/ /tshe 'phos nas kyang phyir mi'i nang du skye zhing dbang po yongs su rdzogs pa 65—523

dang ske/ yan lag dang ldan pa dang / gang nas gang du skyes par sems rnam par dag cing dri ma dang bral ba dang / byad gzugs bzang ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / rab tu bde zhing skyid pa dang / phyir yang yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/ tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de de'i rjes su 'thun par slob pa dang ske/ gnod sems yongs su spong ba dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su gcod pa dang / dge ba'i chos 4khyad par can thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad tshol ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa thams cad rim gyis gzhol zhing shin tu yangs pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa nas bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnyog pa dang / ste7ba dang /sprin dang / khug rlangs dang / rdul dang / dri ma dang / mi sdug pa dang /mi mdzes pa thams cad dang bral te/ rin po che mang pos shin tu brgyan pa yid du 'ong ba dang / nga rgyal dang bral ba/ gzugs mdzes shing sdug pa/ dbang po ma nyams pa/ sems rtag nyu zhi ba'i sems can dag zhing der skye ste/byams pa dang / snying rje dang / yon tan phun sum tshogs pas brgyan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i che'i tshad kyang dpag tu med de/ sems can dag cis 'dul ba bzhin du dam pa'i chos ston to/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas zhing〈sems can tshad med pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gnod sems yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor lo 65—524

dgu pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na nyan thos kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gang zag lamanyu)'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung yongs su 'phel ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i nye gnas chos kyi snod dam/ chos kyi snod ma yin pa yang rung chung ngu na chos gos kyi tshal bu gyon cing skra dang kha spu bregs pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po'i chos la gong nas gong du 'phar zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rno ba'i shes rab dang / bsod nams kyi khyad par rtag tu skye zhing 'phel ba dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / bzod pa dang / sa rnams thams cad la dbang du 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad cing de'i rjes su slob pa dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos kyi nye miganas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / chos thos pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshol ba la brtson pas sems mi ngoms pa dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa dang / smon lam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gsems mi ngoms par 'gyur te / 'bras bu gzhan dag thob pa yang ji skad bstan pa bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang nam 'tsho'idza zhibar 65—525

du log par lta 1)ba yongs su spangs na sems can thams cad kyis bkur zhing bla mar byed pa dang / sems rnam par dag cing log par rtog pa dang bral bar 'gyur te/ de'i dbang gis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thog ma med pa'i mtha' nas rgyud lngar 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'bying ba yang log par lta 5)ba'i dbang gis lus dang / ngag dang /yid kyi 5sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bdag kyang byed la gzhan yang byed du 'dzudalo8)cing mthong ba dang thos pa'i rjes su yi rigarang ba las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / sems can ne gyi sgrib pa dang / chos kyi sgrib pa dang / yang dag par lta ba la sgrib pas bsgribs par gyur to/ /'di ltar log par lta ba yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor los lhag ma ma lus par bcom pas rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yongs su mi len te/ lus 'di nyid la yang lha dang mi la sogs pa kun dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba dang / dogs pa med par 'gyur ba dang /lus dang sems rab tu bde ba dang / sems rnam par dag cing log par lta ba dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi 'pho ba'i dus byed pa na yang lus dang sems la sdug bsngal gyis mi gdung zhing yid du 'ong ba'i bu dang / chung ma dang /'khor thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bas 'chi 'pho ba'i dus byed par 'gyur gyi / shin tu 'jigs pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de lus dang sems rab tu dga' ba dang / bkur ste dang bcas pas shin tu dad pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe 'phos nas kyang phyir mi'i nang du skye zhing dbang po yongs su rdzogs pa ridzo)yan 65—526

lag dang ldan pa dngashe/ gang nas gang du skyes par sems rnam par dag cing log par lta ba dang bral ba dang / byad gzugs bzang ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / rab tu bde zhing skyid pa dang / phyir yang yid du 'ong ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyis dul ba/ tshul khrims dang yon tan du ldan pa/bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa dang phrad de de'i rjes su 'thun par slob pa dang ske/ log par lta〈ba'i chos yongs su spong ba dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su gcod pa dang / dge ba'i chos khyad par can thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad tshol ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang spyod pa thams cad rim gyis gzhol zhing shin tu yangs pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho la 'jug pa nas bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang bral ba dang / lha'i bdud kyi 'khor thams cad dang bral ba dang / mu stegs can gyi 'khor thams cad dang bral ba dang /rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing shin tu mdzes pa dang / yang dag par lta ba dang ldan zhing ngo mtshar dang / bkra shis dang / tshul ngan pa'i lta ba sna tshogs dang / rtag par lta ba dang / chad par lta ba dang / bdag dang bdag gir lta ba thams cad yongs su spangs pa'i sems can dag zhing der skye ste / shin tu tshe ring ba dang / theg pa chen po'i ro gcig la longs spyod par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshe'i tshad kyang dpag tu med de ri/sems can dag cis 'dul ba bzhin du chos ston pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing / sems can tshad 65—527

med pa la phan pa dang / bde ba'i don du ro gcig pa'i chos bstan pa la rtsodashepa med pas yongs su rgyas par byed cing bgegs dang bar chad med par 'gyur rol/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pobalog par lta ba yongs su spangs pa'i 'khor lo bcu pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor lo rnam pa bcu po 'di dang ldan pas nyan thos kyi theg pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa lasa'akhrul pa med par 'gyur/rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur/ theg pa chen po'i gang zag la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ro/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung yongs su 'phel ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i nye gnas chos kyi snod dam/chos kyi snod ma yin pa la 4yang rung chung ngu na chos gos kyi tshal bu gyon cing skra dang kha spu bregs pa la 'khrul pa med par 'gyur ba dang / theg pa chen po'i chos la gong nas gong du 'phar zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rno ba'i shes rab dang /bsod nams kyi khyad par rtag tu skye zhing 'phel ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /gzungs dang / bzod pa dang / sa rnams thams cad la dbang du 'gyur zhing phyir mi ldog pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad cing rjes su slob pa dang / rtag tu sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos kyi banye gnas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang ske/ chos thos pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa dang /bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tshol ba 65—528

la brtson pas sems mi ngoms 1)pa dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa dang / smon lam dang ske/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sems mi ngoms par 'gyur te/ 'bras bu gzhan 'thob lapa yang ji skad bshad pa bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo rnam pa bcu po de dag kyedang ldan na myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ snga ma 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mi dge ba bcu'i las yongs su spangs57nas thams cad kyis dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyi 'bras bu bsngags shing bstod de/ sems can thams cad la bde ba dang phan pa'i don dang / byang chub kyi lam skye zhing 'phel bar bya ba dang /sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal lhag ma mtsha45)lus par bsal ⑥bar bya ba dang / ngan song gsum bskam 4)par bya ba dang /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung bsab par bya ba dang / khams gsum gyi srid pa yongs su gcad par bya ba dang / phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched gcad par bya ba dang / thams cad myur du 'jigs pa med pa'i mya ngan las 'da' ba'i grong khyer du gzud pa'isko2)phyir ji skad bshad pa bzhin du mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi 'bras bu yongs su spong ngo / /de bas na rigs kyi bu gal te yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam 'di ma bsgrubs par mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'am/ chung ngu na yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam 'ga' tsam yang mi srung bar nga ni theg pa chen po yang dag par spyod pa'o zhe'am/ nga ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrubartso97pa'o 65—529

zhes zer na/ gang zag de ni shin tu brdzun par smra ba ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'jig rten slu ba dang / 'dzem pa dang ske/ ngo tsha ba med pa yang 1stong par smra zhing chad par lta ba/ glen pa mi shes pa slu ba can yin te/ de na tshe 'phos nas ngan song du lhung bar shes par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang tshig tu brjod pa tsam 'amatsha mnyan pa tsam gyis chog ste/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam bsgoms pa'am/ nan tanam4)bya mi dgos par byang chub dang ske/ mya ngan las 'das par thob tu zin na ni bskal pa gcig 45)la yud tsam thang cig gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi sa'i khams kyi rdul phra mo snyed kyi sems can thams cad byang chub mngon parapo)'tshang rgya ste/ mya ngan las 'da' bar 7'gyur ba zhig na53)de ni de lta bu'i gnas med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam ni theg pa chen po'i rtsa ba yin te/ byang chub kyi rgyu dang mya ngan las 'da' ba'i them skas lta bu'o/ /rigs kyi bu gal te sems bskyed 9pa tsam 'am 1 smon lam btab pa tsam gyis chog ste/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam goms par nan tan bya mi dgos par byang chub dang /yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba 'thob 11tu zin na ni bskal pa gcig 3nyel yud tsam thang cig gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sa'i khams kyi rdul phra mo snyed kyi sems can dag yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon tsho par 'tshang rgya zhing mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba zhig na de ni de lta bu'i gnas med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'da' ba'i 'bras bu'i khyad par dang yon tan gyi rgyur 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gal te dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la nan tan du ma 65—530

byas na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul phra mo snyed kyi bskal par bdag ni theg pa chen po pa'oma'o)zhes zer te/ 'chad dam/ nyan tam/sems bskyed dam/ smon lam btab kyang byang chub dang / mya ngan las 'da' ba 'thob par mi 'gyur la gzhan yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las 'don mi nus so / /rigs kyi bu dge ba bcu'i las kyi lamasdomil nan tan byas pas 'jig rten na rgyal rigs dang / bram ze la sogs pa rigs chen po dang / rgyal chen ris bzhi'i ga0lha nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched stengs kyi cibar du yod pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar du yang yod par 'gyur te / de dag kun kyang (5tshodage ba bcu'i las kyi lam la shin tu nan tan byed pa'i khyad par dang bye brag las gyur to/ /de bas na rigs kyi bu gang myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod na dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la nan tan gyi rgyan gyis brgyan ne kyite/ mi dge ba bcu'i sdom pa la mi gnas na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o(pe / /gang myur du theg pa chen po'i spyod yul du chud par 'dod dam/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod dam/ myur du dge ba'i pachos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'dod na sngar dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam shin tu bsrung bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam gyis ni dge ba'i chos thams cad dang / yon tan rnam par gzhag 8pa'i gzhi dang / 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'da' ba'i 'bras bu'i mchog thob par byed pa'i rgyu yin no/ /de bas na dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la 65—531

shin tu nan tanamatsho bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis5kyedon 'di dag gsal bar bzlasar pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad9)de gsungs pa/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun gcod cing / /byang chub chen po 'thobartsos 'dod pa/ /dge bcu'i 'khor lo'i nan tan la/ /le lo ma byedam neribartson par gyis/ /theg pa gsum gyishedam chos dang / /theg pa rnam gsum gang zag dang / /rab tu byung ba thams cad la / /'khrul pa med par 'thob 0par 'gyur/ /theg chen spyod laphrodad mos shing ske/ /thams cad 'khor gyi dbugs 'byin pa'i/ /chos mchog rtogs nas zhing dag der/ /byang chub chen po myur du 'thob/ /gal te srog gcod yongs spangs na/ /kun gyis bkur zhing bla mar byed/ /rtag tu nad med tshe yang ring ske/ /bde zhing skyid la gnod pa med/ /skye ba'i gnas ni thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul lam la mos/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun mthong / /myur du bla med byang chub 'thob/ /ma byin len pa yongs spangs na/ /mkhas pas bkur zhing bla mar byed/ /'dod chags skye ba'i lam kun zhi/ /'dod chags med pa skye bar 'gyur/ /skye ba kun tu longs spyod ldan/ /sbyin bdag chen por de 'gyur te/ /rin chen mang pos brgyan pa dang / /yid 'ong sangs rgyas zhing yang 'thob/ /'dod pas log g.yem yongs spangs na/ /nyon mongs dri ma zhi bar 'gyur/ /'dod chags srid mapa'i mtsho yang skoms/ /rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing myur 'thob/ /sems can rnam pa mang po yang / /'dod pa'i 'dam las 'byin par 'gyur/ /theg chen la ni rab bkod nas/ /tshangs pa'i spyad pa spyod du btsud/ /brdzun du smra ba yongs spangs na/ /'phags pa'i dbang dang ye shes 'thob/ /rtag tu bden la 17smra bar dga'/ /brdzun du 65—532

'gyur7ba'i sdug bsngal 'jilan/ /tshig gcig tshad mar btsugs pas na/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun mthong / /brdzun〈7mi smra ba bsgoms pas na/ /byang chub chen po myur du 'thob/ /phra ma'i tshig smra yongs spangs na/ /dge ba'i chos kyi snod du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun mthong / /chad par lta bar yong mi 'gyur/ /'phags pa'i chags med dga' ba dang / /rin chen gter gyi gzungs 'thob cing / /zab mo chos kyi rgya mtshor rig /myur du bla med byang chub 'thob/ /gal te zhe gcod tshig spangs te/ /'jam zhing mnyenam pa'i tshig smras na/ /sems can kun gyis bkur55)bar 'gyur/ /snga ma'i mi dge las kyang zhi/ /'khor rnams rtag tu dga' ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i ston par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mang po'i spyod yul shes/ /sa bcu las kyang 'da' bar 'gyur/ /kyal par smra ba yongs spangs na/ /mkhas pas bkur zhing bla mar byed/ /gzhan la tshig tu smra ba kun/ /yon tan rnam lnga 'thob par 'gyur / /rtag tu 'phags pa'i tshig nyan cing / /'phags pa'i lam tshol spro bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yongs rdzogs shing / /thams cad mkhyen pa myur du 'thob/ /gal te chags sems yongs spangs te/ /'phags pa rnams la mi smod cing / /ngur smrig mgyon la mchod par byed/ /theg pa gsum gyi byang chub sgrub/ /rtag tu rnam dag zhing du skye/ /ston pa'i gnas su gnas par 'gyur / /bla med theg pa la mazhon te/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes myur du 'thob/ /gal te gnod sems yongs spangs te/ /gcig tu byams pa'i sems bsgoms na na / /mnyam par gzhag nyu7)pa'ang myur du 'thob/ /'phags pa'i spyod yul mos 1 phyopar 'gyur/ /rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing du skye/ /nyes pa'i skyon rnams kun 65—533

dang bral/ /de la gnas na byang chub 'thob/ /gnod sems thams cad spang bar tsho1)bya/ /ngan par lta ba yongs spangs te/ /rnam dgadza dad pa'i sems bsgoms rin/ /theg gsum ston lashemos byed cing / /sangs rgyas kun la mchod pa byed/ /ngan song gsum las yongs thar te/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams dang phrad/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan ldan/ /ye shes mchog kyang 'thob 5)par 'gyur/ /dge ba bcu yi lelas lam gyis/ /byang chub mchog thob 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /snyoms par 'jug dang gzungs rnams dang ske/ /sa dang bzod pa ri)skye bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid che ba'i 'khor lo 'dis / /ngan song thams cad rab bcom nas/ /sdig pa'i sgrib pa ⑧kun kyang choms / /myur du byang chub chen po thob/ /'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa zhes bya ba las dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam zhes bya ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zang zing gi sbyin pa'i 9go cha chen po'i 'khor lo rnam pa bcu yod de/ byad chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo de dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed pa 1 rinas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal te11/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das nas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / bsrung kyi ba dang /bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro snye/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rnam pa sna 65—534

tshogs kyi zas dang / skom dang / gos dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / bal glang dang / rta dang / shing rta dang / lus kyi yan lag dang / rkang pa dang /lag pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / mgo dang / mig dang / rkang dang /klad pa0)dang / pagasam1)pa dang / rus pa dang / sha dang / khrag dang /yul dang / srid dang / bu dang / chung ma dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang ske/ khang khyim dang / zhing 'brog la sogs pa de dag thams cad sbyin pa de re re byed pa na lus dang srog la mi lta zhing bdag gcig pu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba 'dod pa'i phyir semasashebaskyed de sbyin pa byed pa ma yin gyi/ sems can thams cad la byams pa chen po dang ④/ snying rje chen po'i myu gu bskyed pa'i phyir sbyin pa sbyin gepa'i sems bskyed do/ /thabs mkhas pa dang shes rab mchog bskyed7pa'i phyir sbyin pa sbyinam7pa'i sems bskyed do / /sems can thams cad la byams pa chen po phan pa dang / bde ba'i don gyi phyir sbyin pa sbyin52)pa'i sems bskyed do/ /sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir sbyin pa sbyinam49)pa'i sems bskyed do/ /gzhan las spag go snyam pa med pa'i sems dang / brlang ba med pa'i sems dang / phrag dog med pa'i sems dang / ser sna dang zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa sbyin 37no / /gang sbyin pa'i dngos po che yang rung / chung yang rung / chung ngu na zan changs gcigatshwa tsam gyi sbyin pa byas na yang rnam par smin 32pa'i 'bras bu la mi re bar sbyin pa sbyinasapa'i sems bskyed do/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa'i 'bras bu la mi re bar sbyin pa sbyin 8pa'i sems bskyed do/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i 'bras bu la mi re bar sbyin pa sbyin nyu9pa'i sems bskyed do/ /gang sbyin pa'i 65wa 535

dngos po de che yang rung / chung yang rung / chung ngu na zan changs gcig tsam gyi sbyin pa byas na yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su bsngo zhing sbyin pa sbyinam11pa'i sems bskyed do/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' semagodapa' chen po zang zing gi sbyin pa'i 5)go cha chen po'i 'khor lo rnam pa bcu poshede dang ldan na/ thog ma sems bskyed pa na 'dod pa rnam pa bralnga yongs su bsal〈geba'i phyir nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri'u)bsod nams chen po'i zhing du 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / —rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod cing bsnyen bkur bya ba ri dang / yongs su bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyis sbyin pa sbyin⑧pa'i sems bskyed pa ni byams pa dang / snying rje chen po'i sems med kyi bdag gi dbul ba de spong ba dang / bdag sdug bsngal las thar ba dang / bdag bde ba thob par bya ba dang / bdag mya ngan las 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir sbyin pa sbyin pa ri9byed de/ sems can thams cad kyi phyir sbyin pa byed pa ni ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa sbyin 3 ༷na ni byams pa dang /snying rje chen po'i sems kyis sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs pa spong ba dang ske/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las gdon pa dang / sems can thams cad bde ba thob par byed pa dang / sems can thams cad mya ngan las bzla 31ba'i phyir sbyin pa byed kyi/ bdag 'ba' zhigatshwa gi phyir sbyin pa spyod pa ma yin no/ /de lta bas na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las〈rteshin tu 'das pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod 65wa 536

nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang /3) rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed cing yongs su bsrungasnyibar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang zang zing gi sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la laspyod pa na 'dod pa rnam lnga'i mchog la sems mi chags te/ bdag nyid dbang ba bde ba'i yo byad thams cad sems can kun la sbyin pa (4)byed de/ sems can thams cad yongs su sdud /de pa'i sems dang / bdag gi sdug bsngal thams cad la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa'i sems gyedang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar bya ba'i sems dang ske/ sems can thams cad la bde ba sbyin pa'i sems dang / sems can thams cad mya ngan las bzlas ba'i sems la gnas te sbyin pa byed do/ /de bas na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang ske/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur dang / srung ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gal te 'dod pa lnga la sems mi chags shing byams pa dang / snying rje chen pos sbyin pa byed na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa zhes bya'o / /gal te 'jig rten gyi 'dod pa rnam lnga yang ma spangs la byams pa dang /snying rje chen po yang med par sbyin pa byed na sbyin pa'i dngos po tshad med grangs med7)dpag tu med pa btang yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes mi bya ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang 65—537

dag pa yang ma yin pas sbyin pa 'di ni 'phags pa rnams kyi phyag rgyas btab pa ma yin no/ /de bas na 'jig rten gyi 'dod pa lnga spangs te/ byams pa dang /snying rje chen po dang tsho17ldan pas sbyin pa bya'o/ /gal te 'jig rten gyi 'dod pa lnga yang ma spangs la byams pa dang / snying rje chen po yang med par sbyin pa byed na byang chub sems dpa' zhes nakyang mi ༷bya la bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa yang ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'dod pa rnam pa 44)lnga la chags pas sbyin pa byed na bdag nyid kyi lus kyi sdug bsngal gyi cha chung (gezad kyang zhi bar mi 'gyur na sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal tshad med pa bsal56)ba lta ci smos/ de nas bcom ldan 'ang/sa kyis don 'di dag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ zang zing sbyin pa'i 'khor lo ldan pa/ /mkhas pa bsam pa dag pa'i mos pas/ /'dod pa rnam lnga dag ni spangs te/ /sems can kun la phan dang bde byed/ /sems can kun la bde ba'i phyir gyi/ /rnam smin 'bras bu re 7phyir ma yin/ /sbyin pa'i dngos po byin pa chung yang / /yang dag bsod nams zhing du de 'gyur/ /sbyin pa'i dngos po mang du byas kyang / /'dod pa rnam lnga dag la gnas na/ /'phags pa dag gi phyag rgyas ma btab/ /ma nges pa yi 8)tshogs la gnas 'gyur9)/ /sbyin pa'i dngos po byin pa chung yang //'dod pa 1 lnga la mi gnas pa ni/ /nyan thos dag dang rang rgyal ba yi/ /yang dag bsod nams zhing du de 'gyur/ /de bas 'dod pa rnam lnga spangs la/ /rtag tu rnam dag sbyin pa byed cing / /sems can kun la bde ba byas 37na/ /yang dag bsod nams zhing du de 'gyur/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos kyi sbyin pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 65—538

rnam pa bcu yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'khor lo de dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa rnam lnga yongs su bsal 3)ba'i phyir myur du nyi ma'i sgron ma'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob cing nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams chen po'i zhing du 'gyur ba dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang /bsrung ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bstan pa dam pa'i chos7nyan thos kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'i dam pa'i chos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'i dam pa'i chos dang / theg pa chen po dang ldan pa'i dam pa'i chos dang /'jig rten gyi chos dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos dang / zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos dang / zag pa zad pa'i chos dang / 'dus byas kyi chos dang ske/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos dang / gnyis su med pa'i chos rnams te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos rnam pa bcu po 'di la dad cing gus par byed pa dang / ji skad thos pa rnams ci nus su gzungs su 'dzin cing yid la byed do/ /rab tu rtog go/ /mthar khong du chud par byed cing gzhan dag la yang ci rigs par ston5)par byed do/ /namatshagechos ston pa'i tshe na phrag dog med pa'i sems dang / ser sna med pa'i sems dang / nga rgyal med pa'i sems dang / rnyed parang mi re ba'i sems dang / gzhan mi smod pa'i sems dang ske/ bdag mi stod ri'u pa'i sems dang / bsti stang dang 7)bcas pa'i sems dang —/ phan pa'i sems dang / byams pa chen po'i sems dang / snying rje chen 65wa 539

po'i sems su bya'o/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa can gyi gang zag la ni nyan thos kyi chos ston cing 'chad kyi/ de la rang sangs rgyas kyisko1)chos sam/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyisamasam yin pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can gyi gang zag la ni rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i chos ston gyi/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i chos sam/theg pa chen po'i chos kyis sgom yin pa dang / theg pa chen po'i gang zag la ni theg pa chen po'i chos ston gyi/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i chos kyis ma yin pa dang / sems can gyi dbang po dang / snod ji lta ba bzhin du dam pa'i chos ston gyi/ dbang po dang snod du ma gyur pa la chos mi ston tol/ /gang theg pa chen po'i sems can la rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa spyod cig par ram/ nyan thos kyi theg pa spyod cig par mi skul lo/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can gyi sems can la skabs kha cig tu theg pa chen po'i spyod pa la nan tan byos shig ces skul tshadaba'i skabs ni yod de55)/ nyan thos kyi theg pa can gyi sems can la skabs 6)kha cig tu rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i spyod pa dang /theg pa chen po'i spyod pa la nan tan gyis shig ces skul ba'i skabs kyang yod de/de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos chung ngu na tshigs su bcad pa gcig gam tshigs su bcad pa phyed tsam la yang shin tu dad cing bkur sti byed kyi/de la 'phya ba'am 7kyiskur pa 'am/ bgegs sam/ bar chad mi byed de/ chos ston pa la sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar 'du shes pa dang 58ni/ chos nyan pa'i 'khor rnams la nad pa dang 'dra bar 'du shes pa dang / gang 'chad pa'i chos la sman bzang po dang 'dra bar 'du shes shing 'dod pa rnam pa 1)lnga yongs su bcadarka tshode re ba med pas dam pa'i chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di dag ni byang chub 65wa 540

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi sbyin pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo rnam pa bcu zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gyo)gang 'khor lo de dang ldan na 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsalasate/ myur du nyi ma'i sgron ma'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob cing nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / bsrung ba dang /bsnyen bkur(byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di dag gsal0bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ mkhas pa chos kyi sbyin pa spyod pa dag /snod bzhin theg pa gsum gyi chos ston toge/ /theg pa gzhan dag de la ston (6)mi byed/ /thos nas de la 'phya zhing skur mi 'gyur / /dbang po snod bzhin dam pa'i chos ston gyi/ /dbang po snod min dag la ma yin no/ /so sor ji ltar ci la mos pa bzhin/ /de dang de yi ri7)chos ston mgu bar byed/ /theg pa chen po spyod pa'i gang zag la/ /theg pa rnam pa gnyis kyi chos mi bstan 2)/ /bar rabapo theg pa gnyis kyi gang zag la/ /theg pa 'bring dang rab kyi chos ston to/ /shin tu dad cing gus pas chos mnyan gyi/ /de la 'phya zhing skurasnyibar mi bya'o/ /chos smra ba la mchod pa byed pa ni/ /sangs rgyas 'dra bar de la 'du shes bskyed/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa yi nad bsal 11 phyir / /dam pa'i chos kyi sman dag nyan par bskul/ /khe dang grags pa shin tu ring spangs te/ /dam pa'i chos dag bstan cing bshad par bya/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims rnam par 65—541

dag pa'i 1)go cha chen po'i 'khor lo yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo de dang ldan na/ thog ma (misems bskyed nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal 5te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing 4chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / bsrung ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar 'gyur ror / /de la ji ltar na tshul khrims rnam par dag pa go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa rnam pa gnyis te/ thun mong ba dang / thun mong ba ma yin no6)/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i 'khor lo thun mong ba zhe na/ gang khyim na gnas pa dge bsnyen57)pha dang / dge bsnyen ma'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa blangs pa'am/ yang na rab tu byung ba so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa ste/ sdom pa 'di dang so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i rin)tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i 'khor lo thun mong ba ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ba yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims kyi 'khor lo rnam par dag pa 'di'i dbang gis sems can thams cad kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa chod par ram/ log par lta ba sel bar ram/ las kyi sgrib pa dang / 'khor ba las grol bar mi 'gyur te/ go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes kyang mi bya/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 9chen po zhes kyang mi bya ste/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa ma yin no/ /de 65—542

la ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa go cha chen po'i 'khor lo thun mong 1)ma yin pa bzhe na/ gang byang chub sems dpa' rnams phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid kyi sems dang / gnod pa med pa'i sems dang / khon 3)du 'dzin pa med pa'i sems kyis rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims srung ngo / /tshul khrims dang / tshul khrims ngan pa can dang /sbyin pa dang / ser sna dang / byams pa dang / zhe snang dang / brtson 'grus dang ske/ le lo can rab 'bring tha ma kun la bye brag mi 'byed pa'i sems dang /khyad par med pa'i 'du shes kyis tshul khrims yongs su srung mngo / /khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la zhe snang med pa dang / khong khro ba med pa dang ske/ ngan par spyod pa med pas tshul khrims yongs su srung ngo / /srid pa gsum gyi phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched la rnam par rtog pa med pa sa tshul khrims yongs su srung (5)ngo / /'dod pa'i khams la mi gnas par tshul khrims srung ngo / /gzugs yod pa'i khams la mi gnas par tshul khrims srung ngo //gzugs med pa'i khams la mi gnas par tshul khrims srung ngo / /ne srid pa'i rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu thams cad la mi gnas par tshul khrims srung ngo / /rnyed pa dang mi rnyed pa la mi gnas par tshul khrims srung ngo / /'du byed rnams la mi gnas par tshul khrims srung ste/ 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa go cha chen po'i 'khor lo thun mong ma yin pa zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i 3)go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal 8te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 65wa 543

chen po zhes bya'o/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das shing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung ha)ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar 'gyur ro / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di dag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ khyim na gnas shing sdom pa len pa/ /raba'abu byung so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims/ /theg pa gnyis dang thun mong yin te/ /byang chub chen po zhes ni mi bya/ /mkhas pa stong pa nyid chos sgom pa/ /'jig rten kun la mi rten mi gnas/ /srid pa kun la gnas ma yin par/ /rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims srung ngo / /mtshan ma spong ba'i tshul khrims dag ni/ /chags pa med de zag pa kun med/ /tshul khrims 'di lta srungangs ba dag ni/ /yang dag bsod nams zhing zhes de bya/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal te/ nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang /bsrung cab dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la ji ltar na bzod pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 5zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa la mtshan nyid rnam pa gnyis te/ gang zhe na 'jig rten pa dang /65—544

'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten gyi bzod pa zhe na/ de ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i bzod pa ste/ sems can la dmigs pa/ len pa dang bcas pa/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu la rten pa/ bsod nams kyi las la brten te bzod par byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang bdag gi gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang /ro dang / reg bya la brten tshonas bzod par byed pa'o/ /'jug pa dang bcas pa'i bzod pa ji mi snyam pal5)med pa'i bzod pa dang / mthu zhan pa'i ribazod pa'i sems can gtong ba'i bzod pa dang / g.yo dang 4sgyur bcas pa'i bzod pa dang / pha rol la 'drid pa'i bzod pa dang / sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i don mi byed pa'i bzod pa ste/ 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten gyi bzod pa zhes bya ste/ bzod pa 'di ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dang thun mong ma yin gyi 5go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes mi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang ma yin te/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa zhes kyang mi bya'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzod pa 6)go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 7)zhe na/ zag pa med pa'i bzod pa ste/ 'phags pa thams cad kyi chos chen po'i 'od kyis sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir chags pa med pa'i 8bzod pa dang / bya ba'i dngos po thams cad dang / tshig tu smra ba dang / rgyu dang / mtshan ma dang ske/ yitshashe)ge dang / sgra skad thams cad yongs su bcad pa'i skye mched la brten pa'i bzod pa spyod do/ /bzod pa 'di bsgoms pas kun nas nyon mongs 65wa 545

pa gsum dang / bskal pa rnam gsum dang / mtshan nyid gsum dang / dus gsum dang / srid pa gsum dang / 'du byed rnam gsum dang / mi dge ba'i rtsa ba gsum dang / chu bo bzhi dang / mdud pa rnam bzhi dang /0) nye bar len pa bzhi dang / 2lus kyi mdudas pa rnam bzhi la sogs pa yongs gsu bcad pas bzod pa 'di sgom 5 pa'i tshe sems dang yid rab tu zhi bas 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo'i ri bzod pa zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po'i 'khor lo'i bzod pa de dang ldan pas thog ma sems bskyed pa rimanas 'dod pa lnga rnams yongs su bsal 8ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das shing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa tho thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / bsrung khob dang / bsnyen bkur 17byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di dag 12gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ bzod pa la ni rnam pa gnyis te/ /mtshan mar bcas dang mtshan ma med pa/ /mtshan mar bcas pa'i bzod pa chags yod/ /mkhas pa dag ni de la mi stod1 / /'du byed rnam gsum phung gepo khams dang / /skye mched la rten bzod pa sgom pa/ /de ni zag bcas bzod pa yin te/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po ma 7yin/ /phyin ci log ni rnam bzhi bsal minas/ /chags pa med pa'i bzod pa sgom zhing / /'du byed rnam pa gsum dag zhi 1 na/ /bzod pa 'di la thams cad bstod 'gyur/ /'du byed thams cad rab tu zhi 65wa 546

zhing ske/ /rtog pa thams cad yongs su spangs te/ /sems ni nam mkha' 'dra bar mnyam pa/ /bzod pa 'di la thams cad bstod 'gyur/ /thams cad chos la ro gcig 'thun par/ /stong pa mtshan ma med pa zhi ba/ /sems ni ci la'ang mi gnas mi chags/ /bzod pa 'di ni phan don cher 'gyur/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo de dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed pa nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyimatshobasod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la ji ltar na brtson 'grus kyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo70zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus la rnam pa gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na la byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten pa'i brtson 'grus zhe rin/na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams 6)shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis 'jig rten gyi bsod nams kyi las kyi dngos po rnam pa gsum la nan tan byed do/ / bsod namasam gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa byed pa'i bsod nams kyi las dang / tshul khrims srung ba'i 8bsod nams byed pa'i las dang / bsgom pa'i bsod nams byed pa'i las so/ /las 'di dag byed pa ni brtson 'grus rnam pa gsum zhes bya ste/ brtson 'grus rnam pa gsum po 'di dag ni sems can la dmigs pa zag pa dang bcas pa/ nye bar 65—547

len pa dang bcas pa/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu la brten〈tu)pa bsod nams kyi las la brten pa ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten gyi brtson 'grus zhes bya'o/ /brtson 'grus 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la sogs pa dang thun mong yin te/ go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes mi bya/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes kyang mi bya ste/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa yang ma yin no/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo nazhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' dag shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i sems kyis nyon mongs pa'i las dang sdug bsngal thams cad sel ba ste/ brtson 'grus 'di ni 'phags pa thams cad kyis bsngags pa/ zag pa med pa/ nye bar len pa( rimed pa/ rten dang gnas med de/ brtson 'grus dang / le lo dang / sbyin pa dang / ser sna dang / tshul khrims dang / ngan pa'i tshul khrims can dang /byams pa dang / zhe sdang dang / sems can rab dang / 'bring dang / tha ma kun la mi 'byed pa'i sems dang / bye brag med pa'i 'du shes kyis shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / dmigs pa med pas bya ba'i las byed de smra ba dang /rtog pa dang / dpyod 4pa'i gnas thams cad la mi gnas pa'i sems kyis shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /srid pa gsum gyi phung po dang / khams dang ske/ skye mched la 5rnam par rtog pa med pas shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom 6ste/ 'dod pa'i khams la mi gnas pa'i 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus 65—548

dang ske/ gzugs yod pa'i khams la mi gnas pa'i 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus dang /gzugs med pa'i khams la mi gnas pa'i nye'abad pa'i brtson 'grus dang /srid pa'i rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu thams cad la mi rtog pa'i 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus dang / rnyed pa dang ma rnyed pa kun la mi gnas pa'i 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus dang / 'du byed rnams la mi gnas pa'i 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi bsod nams kyi las kyi dngos po gsum la mi gnas pa'i 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus dang / ba'ajig rten las 'das pa dang ldan pa'i bsod nams kyi las kyi dngos po rnam pa gsum la shin tu brtson 'grus rtsom pa ste/'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i gang brtson 'grus kyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo de ri dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed pa nas 'dod pa rnam lnga yongs su bsal te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung cab dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di dag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ dbang po drug la shin tu chags pa'i/ /bus pa chu bo lngas ni khyer ba/ /shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom yang dz+wa/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis de la smod 'gyur/ /sems can dmigs shing zag dang bcas la/ /len par bcas shing brtson 'grus rtsom na/ /65—549

yang dag bsod nams zhing ma yin te/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po ma yin//mkhas pa brtson 'grus com 17pa dag ni/ /chags pa thams cad ring du spangs te / /sems ni ci la'ang mi gnas mi chags/ /yang dag bsod nams zhing zhes de bya/ /ming dang gzugs la chags pa med cing / /phung po khams dang skye mched spangs te/ /thams cad 'khor gyi rten du 'gyur ba/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po/ /'jig rten spyod kyang chu zla bzhin te/ /'bad pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i mthar phyin/ /'khor lo 'di yis yongs su bcom pa/ /skye bo kun nas nyon mongs bcings pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan5)yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang ni 'khor lo 'di ④dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed pa nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal (gete/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das nas nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang ske/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis phyo)mchod pa dang / srung 7ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la ji ltar na bsam gtan gyi go chas chen po'i 'khor lo nyu)zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan la rnam pa gnyis te/ 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten gyi bsam gtan 1 zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams phung po la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom 11pa dang / khams la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom 12pa nyurtedang /skye mched la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom 0pa dang / 'dod pa'i khams la 65wa 550

gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / gzugs yod pa'i khams la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom ①pa dang / gzugs med pa'i khams la geganas nas bsam gtan sgom50pa dang / sdom pa gsum la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang /rnam par grol ba gsum la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhagate④pa bzhi la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / dbang po lnga la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / stobs lnga la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pasnyil gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / sa'i khams la gnas nas bsam gtane sgom pa dang / chu'i khams la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / me'i khams la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom56)pa dang ske/ rlung gi khams la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom 7pa dang / nam mkha'i khams la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / bde ba'i tshor ba la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / bde ba yang ma yin sdug bsngal brtsonayang ma yin pa'i tshor ba la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / cung zad she)med pa'i skye mched la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched la gnas nas bsam 65—551

gtan sgom pa dang / 'jig rten 'di la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom paskosnadang ske/ 'jig rten pha rol la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'du shes chung ngu la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'du shes chen po la gnas nas bsam gtan sgoms pa dang / 'du shes tshad med pa la gnas nas bsam gtan sgom pa stechos/ bsam gtan de dag ni zag pa dang bcas pa nye bar len pa dang bcas pa/ chags pa dang bcas pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya'o/ /bsam gtan 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang thun mong ba zhes bya 4ste/ go cha chen po'i 'khor lo ma yin byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes mi bya ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa yang 'arim yin no/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam ri cigatan gang tsunozhe na/ 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams phung po dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang /khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / skye mched dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'dod pa'i khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang ske/ gzugs kyi khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / gzugs med pa'i khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / sdom pa gsum dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / rnam par thar pa gsum dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag 8)pa bzhi dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom 9pa dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom 65—552

pa dang / dbang po lnga dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / stobs lnga dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / sa'i khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / chu'i khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / me'i khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / rlung gi khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / nam mkha'i khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang /bde bar tshor ba dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / sdug bsngal du tshor ba dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin par tshor ba dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / chungamo17)zad med pa'i skye mched dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'jig rten 'di dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'jig rten pha rol dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'du shes chung ngu dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'du shes chen po dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa dang / 'du shes tshad med pa dang bral bar bsam gtan sgom pa ste/ bsam gtan 'di ni 'phags pa'i 'od zer chen po bskyed dun pa/ zag pa med pa/ nye bar len pa med pa/ chags pa med pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig 65—553

rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan gyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang bsam gtan gyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed pa nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal te1/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das shing nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'gyur ba dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang /srung na ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di dag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/bdag gi khur lci spong ba'i phyir ni/ /dmigs dang bcas parme ting 'dzin bsgoms te/ /bdag gi kun nas nyon mongs gcod 'dod/ /yang dag mkhas pa'i mtshan nyid ma yin/ /snod la rten cing rtog shedang bcas pa/ /rnam par grol 'dod ting 'dzin sgom 4)yang / /tshu 5)rol pha rol mu la gnas na/ /sems can dag la phan don byed min/ /sems can kun la phan dang bde phyir/ /ting 'dzin snyosgom zhing khur lci spangs 7te/ /kun nas nyon mongs thams cad sel ba/ /de ni yang dag mkhas pa'i namatshan nyid/ /sems can thams cad sim par byed phyir/ /mi gnas pa yi (ting 'dzin sgom ste/ /'dod pa'i srid pa thams cad chod pa/ /de ni blo gros chen po zhes bya/ /srid pas bcings pa thams cad bkrol te/ /'jigs pa med pa'i grong du bzung ཿ 7phyir/ /rab tu zhi ba'i ting 'dzin sgom 11pa/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po'o// //32bam po bcu pa ste tha ma/ rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 65—554

sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba yod de/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo de dang nyu)ldan na thog ma sems bskyed pa ( nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal te/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das shing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / (nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung 4 ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la ji ltar na shes rab kyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab la ni rnam pa gnyis te/ 'jig rten gyi rigedang 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten pa'i shes rab ce na/ 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams theg pa gsum gyi dam pa'i chos klog pa dang /'don pa dang / glegs bam du 'dri ba dang / nyan 0pa dang / pha rol la ston cing 'chad pa 'ba' zhig57)la rten te/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bar 'dod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi shes rab kyi sgron ma 'byung rinadaba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pas ri9bstan pa'i nyan thos kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'i chos la shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis klog pa dang /'don pa dang / nyan pa dang / glegs bam du 'dri ba dang / gzhan dag la rgyas par ston cing 'chad pa dang / yang dag pa'i brtson 'grus kyis nan tan byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas 1 bstan pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'i chos la klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / nyan pa dang / glegs bam du 'dri ba dang / gzhan dag la rgyas par 31ston cing 'chad pa dang /65—555

yang dag pa'i brtson 'grus kyis nan tan du spyod donyu)/ /de bzhin gshegs pasadzaXbastan pa'i theg pa chen po dang ldan pa'i chos la brtson 'grus su klog pa dang /'don pa dang / nyan pa dang / glegs bam du 'dri ba dang / gzhan la yang rgyas par ston cing 'chad pa dang / yang dag pa'i brtson 'grus kyis nan tan byed pa gaste/ 'phags pa'i zag pa med pa'i lam gyi yan lag tshol ba ma yin/'phags pa'i lam tshol ba ma geyin/ 'phags pa'i lam du gtogs ④pa'i rnam par grol ba tshol ba ma yin/ rab tu zhi ba yang dag pa'i shes rab la nan tan yibyed pa ma yin te/ rtag tu lta ba dang bcas pag/ shes rab dang bcas pa'i shes rab la nan tan byed do/ /de ltar len pa dang bcas pa/ chags pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten gyi shes rab ces bya'o/ /shes rab de ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ba yin te/ go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes mi bya/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes kyang mi bya ste/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa ༄8)ma yin no/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab ce na(spu/ 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub kyi lam la brtson 'grus su nan tan byed pa ni ci nus su theg pa gsum gyi yang dag pa'i chos la klog pa dang / 'don pa dang ske/ nyan pa dang / glegs bam du 'dri 1 ba dang / gzhan dag la rgyas par ston cing 'chad kyang 11de la dmigs su med pa'i sbyor ba la gnas cite/ mi g.yo ba dang / mi rtog pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa dang (ge/ nam mkha' lta bu'i sems dang / rab tu zhi ba'i sems dang / 'phel ba dang / 'grib pa med 65—556

pa'i shes rab dang / chags pa med pa'i semasamatsho1dang / skye ba dang 'gog ri pa med pa'i semasam dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i sems dang / chos mnyam pa nyid kyi sems dang / de bzhin nyid kyi sems dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'i sems dang ske/ chos kyi dbyings kyi sems dang / bdag med pa'i sems dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems dang / rab tu zhi ba dang / bzod pa dang / rtog pa dang bral ba'i sems kyis grub pa dang / 'jigs pa medasapa'i sa la shin tu thabs mkhas pas bde bar gnas pa dang / mi gnas pa mi chags pa'i mchog dam pa'i blo gros kyi sa la thabs mkhas pas bde bar gnas pa ste/ shes rab 'di ni len pa med pa rinachags pa med pas byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las7'das pa'i shes rab kyi go cha57)chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsalamacho8)ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las shin tu 'das shing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi she)mchod pa dang / bsrung 1 rdzob dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'o/sto/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i thabs mkhas pa'i 12go cha chen po'i 'khor lo yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po /lhagang 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das nas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 65—557

bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la ji ltar na/ thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 17zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i〈thabs mkhas pa la rnam pa gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa snyedang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten pa'i thabs mkhas pa ④yin zhe na/'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag gi don nam gzhan gyi don nam/ gnyi ga'i 5ridon la bdag dang gzhan du rtog cing bzo dang sgyu5yirtsal rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bdag dang gzhan gyi don yongs su bsgrub pa'i phyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /nyan thos la mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / pha dang / ma dang /nad pa dang / nyam 3)thag pa dang / mgon dang rten med pa dang / gnod pa mang pos sdug bsngal bar gyur pa mthong na shin tu thabs mkhas pas sgrol zhing bsdu ba'i dngos po rnams zhes na kyisems can yongs su smin par byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bdag (theg pa chen po la gnas pas nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa dang / theg pa chen po'i snod ma yin pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi dbang po yongs su ma smin pa la shin tu phra la 1 zab pa dam pa'i chos ston te/ slob tu gzhug pa dang / 'phags pa'i bsam gtan la nan tan du byed du gzhug go/ /gzhan yang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan 11te nan tan byed du gzhug pa dang / phyin ci log bzhi las bzla zhing 12mi ltung ba'i chos kyi mtshan nyid rig par bya ba dang / so so yang dag 65—558

par rig pa bzhi la gzhol bar bya ba nas/ gzhan yang dran pa nye bar gzhagamatsho)pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ske/ dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang ske/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / lhag ma dang bcas pa dang ske/ lhag ma ma lus pa'i lam dang lam gyi 'bras bu'i bar du 'jug par bya ba la mkhas pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su smin par byed do/ /sems can gang khe dang /grags pa dang / longs spyod la chags te dbang po rgod pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma smin pa la ni mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / ma mo klog pa dang /'don pa byed du gzhug pa dang / sangs rgyas gzhan gyis bshad pa las gzhan pa rnam par grol ba dang / 'thun pa'i gtsug lag klog cing 'don du bcug ste yongs su smin par byed do/ /sems can gang sbyin pa byed pa lam nimi mos pa la ni༄nor rin po che dang / nor dbyig rnam pa sna tshogs gtong bar bskula' bas yongs su smin par byed do/ /sems can gang gtum pa mi nges pa'i rang bzhin can las)tshangs pa'i gnas bzhimayislob tu skul57ba dang / sems can gang zhe snang can la bzod pa slob par skul ba dang / sems can gang le lo can la ni brtson 'grus slob tumasaskul ba dang / sems can gang sems g.yengs pa shel ni bsam gtan sgom par skul bas34 )dang / sems can gang 'chal ba'i shes rab can la ni yang dag pa'i chos ston pas bka' lung brda 11sprod cing lung 'bogs nyi pa la thabs mkhas pas yongs su smin par byed do/ /sems can gang dkon mchog gsum la mngon par ma dad cing mi gnas pa dang / mi spyod pa can la ni dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / dkon mchog gsum 65—559

la dad pa dang / dge bsnyen pa'i sdom pa la bslab pa dang /1) bsnyen gnas pa'i tshon)sdom pa bslabs (pas yongs su smin par byed do/ /gzhan yang bzo dang sgyu — rtsal rnam pa sna tshogs kyi gnas la slob cing spyod du btsud pas〈nyeyongs su smin par byed do/ /de la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten pa'i shin tu thabs mkhas pa'i 6)ye shes kyi rnam pa ni chu klung gang gā'i 7)bye ma snyed pas mang ngo / /de ltar yi 8)ge dang / gtsug lag dang /bzo dang / sgyu /'o rtsal gyi las kyi gnas thams cad la lhag pa'i spyod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / thabs mkhas pa'i ye 1 )shes kyis mu stegs can dang /ston pa gzhan la zhugs pa thams cad btul ba de ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten pa'i thabs mkhas pa'o/ /thabs mkhas pa 'di ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ba yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad gnas pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ thabs mkhas pa spyod pa'i gnas su gyur pa77shin tu thabs mkhas pa lhun gyis grub pas rtog pa med pa'i phyir ldog pa med pa'i chos su gyur pa'o/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' gang ston pa mkhas pa la'ang mi rten/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la'ang mi ltos par 'jig rten gyi thabs mkhas pa la nan tan byed na/ byang chub sems dpa' de ni 'jig rten gyi thabs mkhas pas rmongs pa yin te/ ngan song du ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shin tu thabs mkhas pa'i ye shes la gzhol zhing gnas par yang mi nus la/ thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag patshamam yin no/ /shin tu thabs mi mkhas pas sems can gyi dbang po dang / spyod pa'i khyad par yang mi shes la/ shin tu thabs mkhas pa la'ang rmongs par gyur 65wa 560

pas nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen po'i snod ma yin pa dang / theg pa chen po'i dbang por ma smin pa dag la theg pa chen po ston pa dang / slob cing nan tan byed du bcug go/ /gang theg pa chen po'i chos kyi snod du gyur pa'i sems can la ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i chos ston cing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la slob cing nan tan byed du bcug go/ /gang 1)sangs rgyasakekyi theg ri pa'i chos kyi snod du gyur pa'i gi sems can la ni nyan thos kyi theg pa'i chos ston cing /nyan thos kyi theg pa la slob cing nan tan byed du bcug go/ /gang nyan thos kyi theg pa'i chos kyi snod du gyur pa'i sems can la ni 'khor ba'i chos lapo)bde ba dang dga' bar ston te/ 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyed 61par mi ston to/ /gzhan yang shin tu thabs mkhas pa la rmongs pasasho )sems can gang srog gcod pa la dga' ba nas de bzhin du log par ltadzad ba'i bar du mos pa dag la ni shin tu zab pa theg pa chen po'i chos ston te/ de la 'khor ba 'di nas shi 'phos nas pha rol tu skye zhing sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa myong ba la skyo zhing 'jigs pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos spongs9)ba mi ston to/ /gzhan yang shin tu thabs mkhas pa la rmongs pas sems can gang tshul khrims srung bar mos pa la ni sbyin pa spyod du 'jug go/ /sems can gang bzod pa sgom par mos pa la ni bzod pa spong ba ston cing tshul khrims srung du 'jug go/ /sems can gang brtson 'grus sgom 9/ )par mos pa la ni brtson 'grus spong ba ston cing bzod pa spyod du 'jug go/ /sems can gang 11bsam gtan sgom par mos pa la ni bsam gtan spong ba ston cing brtson 'grus la nan tan byed du bcug go/ /65—561

sems can gang shes rab sgom par mos pa la ni shes rab spong ba ston cing bsam gtan sgom du 'jug go/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'4)'jig rten gyi thabs mkhas pa la rmongs pas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i don byed mi nanus te/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa'i grogs por gyur to/ /thabs mkhas pa 'di ni dmigs pa dang bcas pa chags pa dang bcas pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten gyi thabs mkhas pa zhes bya'o / /de ltar 'jig rten gyi thabs mkhas pa 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang thun mong pa yin te/ go cha chen po'i 'khor lo ma yin/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ②zhes kyang mi bya ste/ nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing yang dag pa ma yin no / /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shin tu thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag gi don btang ste/ gzhan gyi don lhur byed pas bzo dang sgyu rtsal rnam pa sna tshogs mngon par ston pas yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / pha dang ma la bsnyen bkur dang / mchod pa byed pa dang /nad pa dang / phongs pa dang / nyam ④thag pa dang / mgon dang skyabs med pa dang / shin tu sdug bsngal rnam pa mang pos gzir ba la thabs kyis sgrol ba dang ske/ bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa 4ldebazhis sems can yongs su smin par byed do/ /ci la mos pa dang / dbang po dang / snod ji lta ba bzhin du sems can la dam pa'i chos ston to/ /gzhan yang rim gyis nyan thos kyi theg pa pa ni 65—562
