rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la slob cing nan tan byed par skul ba dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa ni theg pa chen potsham)slob cing nan tan byed par skul ba dang ske/ gal te nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg par dbang po ma smin pa ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi chos kyis miskyo ba stonas45)cing 'khor bas skyo ba dang ske/ mya ngan las 'da' ba tshol bar skul lo/ /sems can gang srog gcod pa la mos pa nas log par lta ba'i bar du chags pa la ni dbang po dang / rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin du 'khor bar 'khor ba'i chos ston pa dang / 'jig rten 'diwonas pha rol du skye ba ri dang / pha rol gyi sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu myong bar ston te/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos kyis 'jigs pa dang skyo ba ston to/ /kha cig la ni nyan thos kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'i chos ston to/ /kha cig la55)ni rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'i chos ston to/ /kha cig la ni bla na med pa'i theg pa'i chos yang dag par bstan te khad kyis slob tu 'jug go/ /sems can gang sbyin pa la mos par gyur pa 47)rnams la ni tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i mchog srung〈kyebar bstan pa de bzhin du rgyas par sems can gang bsam gtan la mos par gyur pashel ni zag pa med pa 'phags pa'i lam gyi mchog gis bsdus pa dang ske/ shes rab bla na med pa ston cing nan tan byed du bcug ste/ shin tu thabs mkhas pa hu )'di ni dmigs pa med pa dang / chags pa med pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shin tu thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa rnam pa lnga yongs su bsal 11bas byang chub 65—563

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das shing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / bsrung ①ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don de dag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa(9/ shes rab nan tan rnam gnyis te/ /'jig rten bcas dang 'jig rten 'das/ /chags pa de ni 'jig rten bcas/ /chags med pa〈(ni 'jig rten 'das/ /shin tu thabs mkhas nan tan ni/ /khyad par rnam pa gnyis la gnas/ /dmigs pa yod pa 'jig rten bcas/ /dmigs med de ni 'jig rten 'das/ /gang zhig theg pa gcig braston pa/ /de ni legs par chos ston min/ /bdag kyang yongs su mi smin na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la 'gyur/ /gciga'abatu mi dge sems can la/ /theg pa gsum gyi chos ston na/ /de ni gti mug rmongs pa ste/ /byang chub chen po de'ilogam yin/ /theg pa gsum la 'jug spro zhing / /yang dag pa yi7)chos 'dod lo //'khor bas spro ba'i chos ston na/ /mkhas pa'i rang bzhin de ma yin/ /rtse gcig blo yis rab brtags te/ /'dod dang mos pa bzhin du ston/ /'di ni shin tu thabs mkhas pas/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis7de la bsngags/ /sems can sdig pa dag spyod 7cing / /theg pa gsum gyi snod 'gyur na/ /dbang po'i snod bzhin chos bstan te/ /sdig pa kun las grol 17bar byed/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po7byams pa chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo yod do/snye/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 65—564

'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa rnam pa lnga yongs su bsal te/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas7)thams cad kyi bsod ri nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srungs ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya'4)bar 'gyur ro/ /de la ji ltar na byams pa chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhe na/rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i byams pa la rnam pa gnyis te/ chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa dang / sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa'o/ /chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni byams pa chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o / /sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni ri byams pa chen po'i go cha zhes mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang thun mong du gyur pa ste/ nyan thos dang —/ rang sangs rgyas ni bdag la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir sems can la dmigs pa'i bzod pa la 5kyinan tan byed do37/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas ni bdag zhi ba dang / bdag mya ngan las 'da' ba dang / bdag gi sgrib pa bsal ba dang / bdag gi kun nas nyon mongs pa gcad〈8)pa'i phyir yin gyi sems can thams cad kyi phyir sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pas brtson 'grus la nan tan byed pa ni ma yin no/ /de bas na byams pa 'di ni byams pa chen po zhes mi bya ste/ go cha chen po mtsha97yin no/ /chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa dang thun mong ba ma yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams 'ba' zhig gis 65—565

nan tan byed nus par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du/ brtson 'grus kyi sbyor bas chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa 'di la nan tan byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni0)sems can thams cad50yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba ri dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa yongs su gcadasnyipa'i phyir shin tu 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa la nan tan byed do / /de bas na byams pa 'di ni byams pa chen po'i go cha chen po zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa la nan tan byed pa ni phung po la mi gnas/ skye mched la mi gnas/ khams la mi gnas/dran pa nye bar gzhag ri pa rnams la mi gnas pa nas byang chub kyi lam gyi yan lag gi bar du mi gnas so/ /'dod pa'i khams la mi gnas/ gzugs kyi khams la mi gnas/ gzugs med pa'i khams la mi gnas/ 'jig rten 'di la mi gnas / 'jig rten pha rol la mi gnas/ tshu rol gyi mu la mi gnas/ pha rol gyi mu la mi gnas/ dmigs pa la mi gnas/ mi dmigs pa la mi gnas te/de ltar byang chub sems dpa' chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa la nan tan byed pas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi theg pa'i sa las shin tu 'das te/ de ni byang chub sems dpa'i ༅chos la dmigs pa'i byams pa chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang byams pa chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na 7 thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa rnam pa lnga (8)yongs su bsal te/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/ nyan thos 65—566

dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'gyur ba dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa nyu)thams cad kyis mchod pa dang /srungasab dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di dag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal ba/ /sems can dmigs pa'i byams sgomadza pa/ /sems la bcu gsum skyon 'chang zhing / /bdag la phan pa'i don phyir rtsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen ni/ /sems can thams cad kun gyi phyir/ /thun mong ma yin byams chen bsgoms/ /bcu gsum sems kyi skyon rnams spangs//dri ma bcu gsum rab spangs nas/ /byang chub chen por gzhol bar byed/ /chos la dmigasalgepa'i byams bsgoms na/ /bsod nams zhing grub ring ba min//bcu gsum stobs la bder gnas na/ /sems can kun las shin tu 'phags/ /ji ltar seng ge'i rgyal po de(snye/ /ri dgasamane kun las 'a phags pa bzhin/ /bcu gsum dgra rnams shin tu btularin/ /rtag dang chad pa'i mthar 'dzin spangs/ /sems la cisashekyang mi gos na/ /myur du byang chub chen po 'thob97// /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo yod do0/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa rnam pa 31lnga yongs su bsalasate/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur zhing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung 32ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar ske 65—567

'gyur ro/ /de ji ltar zhe na/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad ni bdag la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir snying rje la spyod kyi/sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir snying rje chen po skyedamanyu7pa ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni bdag 'ba' zhig la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir snying rje chen po skyed ②pa ma yin gyi/sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyis0phyir snying rje chen po skyed (hodol/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpa' 45)snying rje chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo dang ldan pas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa ponyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung ri9)ba dang / bsnyen bkuram bya bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa 59)bzhis sems can yongs su smin par byed do/ /snying rje chen pos sems can thams cad la 3 bde ba'i don gyi phyir sbyin pas yongs su sdud nyunyepa ni 'di lta ste/ rin po che dang / nor dang / dbyig dang / theg pa dang / bran dang / las byed pa'i mi 12dang / yul dang / srid dang / bu dang / chung ma dang /lus dang / srog gi bar du yongs su gtong ba la ser sna med de/ mi dmigs pa'i spyod pa la sbyor bas sna 'dul ba'i sems can yod par mi mthong / sbyin pa byed par mi mthong / len par mi mthong / nor gyi dngos por mi mthong /sbyin pa spyod par mi mthong / sbyin pa byas pa'i 'bras bur mimi mthong ba nas mi 65wa 568

dmigs pa'i bar du yang mi mthong ste/ de lta bu'i snying rje chen po skyed do/ /sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir ngag snyan pa dang /don sgrub pa dang / don 'thun pas ci dang cis 'dul ba bzhin du mi dmigs pa yang mi mthong ba'i bar du de dang des0)rgyas par ston cing 'chad do//de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rtag tu mchog dam pa'i dul ba'i sems dang / rab tu zhi ba'i sems dang / tshad med pa'i sems dang la/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched thams cad la mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i sems kyis gang nas gang du skyes kyang g.yo ba med pa dang / mi gnas pa'i snying rje chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 'dis zhusnod du gyur pa'i sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa la skyo ba med do/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nisnying rje chen po'i go cha chen po'i ge'akhor lo zhes bya ste/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ba ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang snying rje chen po'i go cha chen po'i ⑤'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa lnga yongs su bsal te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes bya'o/ /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das shing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'gyur ba dang ske/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di dag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ shin tu zab mo dam pa'i chos dag /snying rje chen po'i gzhi ru 65—569

de 'gyur/ /shin tu dpag dka' nam mkha' 'dra ste/ /gnas pa med de gzugs kyang med do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus chen po/ /yon tan chen po dang ni ldan te/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes snying rje chen pos/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten 'da' bar des 'gyur/ /mgon dang skyabs med sems can dag ni//'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtog pas bcings pa/ /snying rje chen po'i chu yis bkrus te / /sems can rnam par grol bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje bskyed pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skoms par byed de/ /nyan thos theg pa'i 'khor rnams dang ni/ /rang rgyal theg pa spyod pas ma yin/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug sems can/ /ngan song dag tu ltung7bar 'gyur ba/ /snying rje chen po'i chu yis bkrus te/ /sdug bsngal kun las grol bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshig so so yang dag par rig pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa/ tshad med pa/ mtha' yas pa / shin tu rgya chen po dang ldan pa ji snyed sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de/ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs rnams dang / shin tu brtan pa'i bzod pa chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo yod de②/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed nas 'dod pa rnam pa ri )lnga yongs su bsal5gete/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das pa 5nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing chen por 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis nyamachod pa dang / srung ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems 65—570

dpa' chen po tshig so so yang dag par rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa tshad med pa mtha' yas pa/ shin tu rgya che ba dang ldan pa ji snyed sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de/ ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs rnams dang /shin tu brtan pa chen po'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo gangs17zhe na/ 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams du chos thams cad la shin tu rtog pa ni ji ltar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyis nam mkha' kun tu khyab pa bzhin du/ sems mnyam pa nyid gdu gyur pa/ mtshan ma med pa rten pa med pa 47mi gnas pa/gos pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi sgo dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad la sems kyi spyod pa med pa/ mig tsho dang / gzugs dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa la yid kyis rnam par zhen pa dang bral ba/ sems kyi rgyaspyod pa med pa las mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis nang gi tshor ba rnam57gsum skyes te/ bde ba dang / sdug bsngal dang / bde ba yang ma yin sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin par tshor ba la sems rab tupozhi zhing chags pa med do/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang / sgra dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna dang / dri dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce dang / ro dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus dang / reg bya dang ske/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid dang ske/ chos dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i bar du gzhung de bzhin du rgyas par sems dang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa thams cad rtag tu zhi zhing chags pa med do/ /sems dang / yid 65—571

dang ske/ rnam par shes pa las 11skyes pa'i tshor ba rnam gsum ste/ bde ba dang /sdug bsngal dang / bde ba yang ma yin sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin par tshor ba la sems rtag tu zhi zhing chags pa med do/ /dus gsum gyi phung po dang / khams dang ske/ skye mched rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad la len pa med pa/ sems kyi spyod pa med pa'o/ /gang ji snyed khams gsum dang / 'du byed gsum dang /reg bya gsum dang / tshor ba gsum dang / dbang po gsum dang / theg pa gsum dang / sdom pa gsum dang / rnam par grol ba gsum dang / rnam pa de dag thams cad la sems rab tu zhi ba②/ gnas med pa/ mtshan ma med pa/len pa med pas mnyam pa nyid du gnas so/ /gang ji snyed sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang /shes rab dang / pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad la sems kyi spyod pa med pasherab tu zhi bar gnas so/ /de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang ske/ stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la yang sems kyi spyod pa med pa (gerab tu zhi bar gnas sol/ /gang ji snyed dgu mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la yang sems kyis spyod pa med par rab tu zhi bar gnas so/ /gzhan yang mngon par 'du byed pa gsum dang / chos la sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes dang / lam gyi yan lag dang / lam gyi rang bzhin 'dren par byed pa dag lamachos)yang len pa med pa/sems kyi spyod pa med pa/ kun gzhi rnam par shes pa dang / kun gzhi rnam par shes pa ma yin pa dang / nye bar len pa dang bcas pa dang / nye bar 65—572

len pa med pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang / tshu rol gyi mu dang / pha rol gyi mu dang / chung ngu dang / chen po dang / tshad med pa dang / byed pa dang / mi byed pa dang / dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / lung du mi ston pa thams cad kyi rnam pa la len pa med pa dang /sems kyi spyod pa med par rab tu zhi bar gnas so/ /gang ji snyed byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / thabs mkhas pas sems can yongs su0smin par byed pa nas bsrung bar byang ba med pa gsum dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar du chos thams cad kyi rnam pa la len pa med pa/ sems kyi spyod pa med paralobarab tu zhi bar gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag 'khor lo 'di'i dbang gis tshor ba rnam gsum gyi nyes pa yongs su bsal ba dang / rnam par rtog pa thams cad yongs su zhi ba dngasngonar/ mtshan ma'i chos thams cad yongs su spong bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ji snyed nam mkha'istonamig dang / spyi bo'i ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs rnams la thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo yang 'dren par 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i53)'khor lo de la gnas pas gang 'das pa'i dus kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi lhag mas 42)gnyer te ngan 'gro mnar med pa dang / gzhan yang srid pa dang / 'gro ba rnams su5she'akhor ba'i las thams cad lhag ma ma lus par yongs su bsal te/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu mi myong bar byed do/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu/ 'di lta ste/mun pa nag pos nam mkha' thams cad yog pa na 7nyi ma shar ba'i tshe mun pa thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang tshig 65—573

so so yang dag par rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa/ tshad med pa/mtha' yas pa/ yangs shing rgya chen po dang ldan pas ji snyed sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de/ ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs rnams dang / shin tu brtan 1pa'i bzod pa'i (gyigo cha chen po'i 'khor lo yang grub cing 'dren par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang nam mkha'i mig dang / spyi bo'i ting nge 'dzin rnams dang ris/ gzungs rnams la thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo la gnas pa dpag tu med pa sa)nam mkha' lta bu'i ye shes kyi nyi mas phyin ci log ⑤bzhi'i mun pa yongs su bsal te/ 'das pa'i dus kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi lhag mas 46)gnyer te ngan 'gro mnar med pa dang / gzhan yang srid pa dang 'gro ba rnams su 'khor bar 'khor ba'i las thams cad lhag ma ma lus par yongs su sel te/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu myong bar mi byed do/ /gzhan yang de'i dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la dbang thob pa dang / phyir mi ldog par 'gyur te/ sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing rjes su mi spyodakyipa dang /rtag tu sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang ske/ nyan thos kyi nye gnas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / chos thos pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / yon tan thams cad la sems mi ngoms pa nas byang chub kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad de/ rtag tu sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang mi 'bral ba ni chung ngu na mi lam du yang bar chad med par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshig so so yang dag par rig pas nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa/ tshad med pa/ mtha' yas pa/65—574

yangs shing rgya che ba dang ldan pas ji snyed sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de/ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs rnams dang / shin tu brtan ①pa'i bzod pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo 'dren par 'gyur zhe na/ 'di lta ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams bsam gtan dang po nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i bar du snyoms par 'jug pa dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched nas 'du shes med 'du shes med ②min skye mched kyi ④bar du snyoms par 'jug pa dang /'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jugasho )pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ⑤la gnas na tshor ba rnam gsum dang / 'du byed gsum po yongs su bcad de⑥/ mngon par 'du byed pa dang / g.yo ba'i sems kyi spyod pa med pa/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / sems pa dang / rigashepa dang /yid la byed pa la sogs pa kun gcod par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas na zhag gcig⑧gam/ zhag bdun gyi bar du bsam gtan gyi zas za bar 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin de las langs na yang sems rab tu zhi ba len pa med cing ske/ lhan der gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang don dam pa'i mthasalo)gtugs pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog go/ /ting nge 'dzin de la gnas na sems rab tu mnyam pas nam mkha' ltar chags pa med pa dang ske/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga kun nas zil dngar 0gyi thigs pa /nyaskar mtshwa lta bu/mngon par byung bas kun nas nyon mongs pas bcings pa'i yongs su gdung ba thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas yang dag pa'i dran pa thob ste/ dga' ba khyad par can gyis lus la khyab par gyur pa ni ji tsho/rteltar lha'i sras po dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin 65—575

thams cad la 'jug pa nas lus kyi ba spu'i khung bu kun nas rab tu bde ba myong ba bzhin de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de lus la bde bas reg pas ①sangs rgyas rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pasakhusangs rgyas mthong ba las mtshan ma gzhan mthong ba med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' de'i tshe sangs rgyas gcig yid la byas nashesangs rgyas gcig mthong ngo / /gal te sangs rgyas mang po yid la byas na sangs rgyas mang po mthong ngo / /gal te sangs rgyas kyi sku chung bar 9)yid la byas na sangs rgyas kyi sku chung ngur mthong ngo /gal te sangs rgyas kyi sku chen por yid la byas na sangs rgyas kyi sku chen por mthong ngo / /gal te sangs rgyas kyi sku tshad med par yid la byas na sangs rgyas kyi skurabatshad med par mthong ngo / /gal te bdag gi lus sangs rgyas kyi sku'i mtshan dang ldan par yid la byas na bdag gi lus de sangs rgyas kyi sku dang 'dra bar mtshan phun sum tshogs par mthong ngo / /gal te gzhan gyi lus sangs rgyas kyi skur yid la byas na gzhan gyi lus sangs rgyas kyi skupo)dang 'dra bar mtshan phun sum tshogs par mthong ngo / /gal te sems can dang sems can ma yin pa dang /ji snyed gzugs su gtogs pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan dang ldan par yid la byas na sems can dang / sems can ma yin pa dang / ji snyed gzugs su gtogs pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sku dang 'dra bar mtshan phun sum tshogs par mthong gi gzugs gzhan du mi mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' de'i tshe yang 'di snyam du chos thams cad dang / gzugs thams cad ni sgyu ma dang 'dra ste/ yang dag pa ma yin pas bdag gis tshor ba rnam gsum dang /'du byed gsum la sogs pa chos thams cad lhag ma ma lus par yongs su gcad5 65—576

do snyam nas 'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ting nge 'dzin de la gnas nas blo sngon du btang ba bzhin du thams cad yongs su bcad de ting nge 'dzin gyi ro'i zas kyis 'tsho'o6)/ /gal te na zhag bdun nam/ zhag bdun gnyis sam/ bdun gsum masami/ bzhi'am/ lnga'am/ drug gam/ bdun nam/ brgyad dam/ gal te na⑧bskal pa tshad med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi bar du ci nus su gnas te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi zas za'o/ /ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas sems rab tu zhi bas ci la yang mi chags te bde bar gnas so/ /gal te don dam pa'i mthas gtugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin lasazhugs na yang sngar ji skad bshad pa bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan dang ldan pa yid la bya ba nas chos thams cad dang / gzugs thams cad sgyu ma dang 'dra ste yang dag pa (ge)ma yin pa'i bar du chud par byed doyi/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa/ tshad med pa/ mtha' yas pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba dang ldan pa ji snyed sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs thams cad dang / shin tu brtan pa'i bzod pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo zhes bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na nam mkha'i mig dang / spyi bo'i ting nge 'dzin rnams dang ske/ gzungs rnams las shin tu thabs mkhas pa thams cad lhag ma ma lus par spangs te rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu len par mi byed do/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams su mes 'jig pa 'byung du nye ba ni nyi ma lnga cig car shar te/ 'jig rten gyi khams na rdzing bu dang / rdzing bu chen 65—577

po dang / 'bab chu dang / 'bab chu chen po dang / mtsho dang / mtsho chen po'i chu rnams lhag ma ma lus par thams cad skems ①par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang tshig so so yang dag par rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa(mi/ tshad med pa/ mtha' yas pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba ji —)dang ldan pas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de/ ting nge 'dzin rnams dang ske/ gzungs rnams dang / shin tu brtan5gepa'i bzod pa'isnyigo cha chen po'i 'khor lo yang mngon par 'dren to/ /gzhan yang nam mkha'i mig dang /spyi bo'i ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs rnams la thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo la 6)yang gnas shing 'dren par 'gyur ro/ /gang 'das pa'i dus kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi lhag mas gnyer te/ ngan 'gro mnar med pa dang ske/ gzhan yang srid pa dang / 'gro ba rnams su 'khor bar 'khor ba'i las thams cad lhag ma ma lus par yongs su bskams ༄7)te/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu mi len rin par byed do/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten du chu'i 'jig pa byung ba na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i ⑨'jig rten gyi khams chu nyu 'di'i khams chung ngu'i gling chen po nyu1bzhi dang / gling phran brgyad dang ske/ ri rab ri'i rgyal po dang / ri phran thams cad chu yis bkrus te zhig nas lhag ma ma lus par zad par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang tshig so so yang dag par rig pa nam mkha'i nyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ tshad med pa/ mtha' yas pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba dang ldan pas ji snyed sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de/ ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs rnams dang /shin tu brtan pa'i 32bzod pa'i go cha chen po'i 〉'khor lo yang 'grub cing 'dren 65—578

par 'gyur ro/ /nam mkha'i mig dang / spyi bo'i7ting nge 'dzin rnams dang /gzungs rnams la thabs mkhas pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo la gnas shing 'dren par 'gyur bas 'das pa'i dus kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi lhag mas gnyer te ngan 'gro mnar med pa dang / gzhan yang srid pa dang / 'gro ba rnams su 'khor ba ②'khor ba'i las la mkhas pa'i go cha chen po'i 'khor lo la yangasheganas par 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo 'di la gnas pas dpag tu med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ④ye shes kyi nyi ma byung risnyebs rang gi lus la phyin ci log bzhi dang ske/ ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad yongs su sel bar 'gyur ro/ /'das pa'i dus kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi lhag mas gnyer te ngan 'gro mnar med pa dang / gzhan yang srid pa dang / 'gro ba rnams su 'khor bar 'khor ba'i las thams cad kyang lhag ma ma lus par yongs su sel te/ rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yang myong bar mi 6)byed do/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang 'khor lo 'di dang ldan na thog ma sems bskyed pa thonas 'dod pa rnam lnga yongs su bsal te/ nyan thos dang / rang 67/sangs rgyas thams cad las shin tu 'das shing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa thams cad kyis mchod pa dang / srung 9)ba dang / bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo 'di'i dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la dbang du 'gyur ba dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang / sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang du mi 'gro ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos kyi nye gnas mthong ba dang 65—579

mi 'bral ba dang / chos thos7pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / dge 'dun la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / yon tan thams cad la sems mi ngoms pa ste/ mngon par byang chub kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa dang rtag tu sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa〈kyedang mi 'bral ba ni chung ngu na rmi lam na yang 'bral bar mi byed do/ /de ltarashebyang chub sems dpa' de bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyang myur du rdzogs pa dang / ring po mi thogs par rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na sems can thams cad kyang rdzus te skye ba ④dang / mtshan dang gzugs sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang 'dra ba/ nyon mongs pa srab cing chung ba/ theg pa chen po la bde bar gnas pa sha stag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis don desnyedag gsal bar bzlas pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ chos kyi snod du 'gyur bar 'dod pa dag /nyon mongs thams cad yongs su gcad7par bya/ /yang dag stong pa nyid la snyoms zhugs na/ /dngos po gang yang bya bar dka' ba minagashes / /srid pa'i bcings pa thams cad gcad pa'i7phyir/ /snyoms par 'jug la skrunan tan brtson par bya/ /ting 'dzin yon tan dag dang ldan pas na / /gdon mi za bar dpag dka'i shes rab thob/ /gzugs med pa yi bsam gtan 1tsherab bsgom 1)zhing / /'gog pa'i ting 'dzin stong pa nyid brtags na/ /sangs rgyas dran pa'i blo mchog rab skyes te/ /sdig pa〈nyethams cad yongs su zad 'gyur ro/ /yod dang med pa'i chos rnams thams cad ni/ /yang dag stong pa nyid du brtags pas bcom/ /ngan parasnyi'agro ba'i rgyud rnams 65—580

yongs bsal nas/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas mang po mthong bar 'gyur/ /yang dag stong pa nyid la rab bsgoms7pas/ /dge ba'i chos gzhan kun la brtson bya ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kun la rab mchod na/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /sems can kun gyi dge ba'i grogs byas te/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa yi nad bsal〈min/ /rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing du myur du skye/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya byang chub chen po 'thob/ /sangs rgyas mtshan dang ldan pa'i sems can dag /sangs rgyas zhing der yongs su gang bar 'gyur/ /thams cad sangs rgyas theg la 'dun⑧pa ste/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa yongs su spong / /'phags pa shin tu rgyas pa chen po sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo bcu pa ④bya ba las bsod nams kyi zhing gi mtshan nyid kyi le'u zhes bya ste bdun pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa chen po'i (gernam grangs 'di bshad pa'i tshe 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam pa sngon she)'das pa'i dus na sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la goms pa dag deng 'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa la nan tan bya ba'i⑧sbyor ba bshad pa thos nas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mo thams cad thob bo/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa rnams chos 'di thos nas ting nge 'dzin gyi 'tsho 9)ba me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgo mo thams cad thob bo/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos 65—581

nas dpa' bar 'gro ba glog gi 'od la rten pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgo mo thams cad thob bo/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas chos la sgyur ba 'od snang ba las rten par byed pa rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pa thams cad thob bo/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas rdul dang dri ma dang bral te chos la chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa skyes te rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med7pa dag ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas lan cig phyir5mildog pa'i 'bras bu thob bo / /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dgal bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas mchog gi dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas khams gsum gyi btson 4)ra nas 'byung bar rtsom pas sgrubacom ldan 'das la rten cing rab tu byung nas yang dag pa'i chos la zhugs par gyur to/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med phyinapa dag nam 'tsho'i 7)bar du dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bde bar gnas shing nyan thos kyi theg par sems bskyed pas phyir mi ldog par gyur to / /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag⑧bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas nam 'tsho'i (bar du dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bde bar gnas nas/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg par sems bskyed pa las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag bcom ldan 65—582

'das kyis bshad pa thos nas nam 'tsho'i0)bar du dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bde bar gnas nas theg pa chen por sems bskyed cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to(ge/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas 'jig rten gyi yang dag par lta ba thob par gyur te(kye/ yang dag par lta ba de'i dbang gis ngan song du 'gro ba'i rgyu dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i las dang /nyon mongs pa thams cad byang nas mtho ris su 'gro ba'i rgyu dang / yang dag pa'i smon lam dang / dge ba'i las thams cad skye zhing 'phel bar 'gyur ro(pe/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med ri pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ste/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs nas yisangs rgyas mchod pa la spro ba dang / chos thos pa la dga' ba dang ske/ dge 'dun gyi g.yog byed pa la mos te/ nyin mtshan du 'bad pa'i brtson 'grus la sems par tshad med par gyur to/ /gzhan yang sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa thos nas log pa la 'babalgepa dang / log pa la phyogs pa dang / blo gros ngan pa dang / las ngan pa thams cad yongs su spangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la mi 'gyur ba'i dad pa thob nas khyim na gnas pa'i chos yongs su spangs te rnam par dag pas rab tu byung bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu ngas sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo bcu pa zhes bya ba brda')sprod pa chen po chos kyi sgo mo 'di/ khyod kyi lag tu gtad kyis khyodam kyis gzungs su zung7la 65—583

shin tu rgyas par gyis shig /sems can gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la klog gam / 'don tam/ yid la byed dam/ gzhan la yang rgya cher 'chad dmatsho/yang dag pa'i spyad (1pa la gnas pa dag la khyod kyis chos rnam pa 'di bcus bsrungs du te/ yun ring por phan pa dang bde ba'i don thob par gyis shig /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de'i thabs dang bdog pa'i nor thams cad bsrungs te nyams par mi bya ba dang / gnod pa thams cad las bsrungs te/ gnod pa ④med par bya ba dang / log par lta ba dang / log par phyogs pa las 6)bsrungs te mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam spang bar bya ba dang / de'i lus dang ngag la gnod pa thams cad las bsrungs te med par bya ba dang / 'phya ba dang skur pa thams cad las bsrungs te med par bya ba dang / tshul khrims dang ske/ spyod pa thams cad nyams par mi 'gyur bar srungasnyib dang / de la mi ma yin pa thams cad dang / 'byung ba chen po 'khrugs pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i nad dang / mi dge tso)ba thams cad yongs su sel bar srung5nyeb dang /de la dus ma yin pa tshul ma yin pa/ ltas ngan dang / rims thams cad mi 'byung bar srung 1gleb dang / de la 'chi ba'i dus byed pa na yang sangs rgyas thams cad mthong bar srung〈nyeb dang / de tshe 'phos nas kyang bde 'gror skye ba dang ske/ phan pa dang bde ba'i don thob par yongs su srung〈nyebar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di klog pa dang / 'don pa dang ske/ don yid la byed pa dang / gzhan la rgya cher 'chad dam/ yang dag pa'i spyod pa la gnas pa dag la khyod kyis 8chos rnam pa 'di bcus 7shin tu bsrungs shing / byin gyis brlabs te/ chos rnam pa 'di bcus yun ring por 65—584

phan pa dang bde bar gyis shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de de bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs7)gzungs su 'dzin cing shin tu rgyas par bgyi'o/ /sems can gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / don yid la bgyid pa dang / pha rol po la rgya cher ston pa dang / yang dag pa'i spyod pa la gnas pa dag la bdag gis chos rnam pa 'di bcus shin tu bsrungs te yun ring por phan pa dang bde bar bgyi'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde 'di gsungs nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems gedapa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa'i snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rigs par the tsom 'dri ba dang / tshangs pa chen po lha'i snying po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa la sogs pa 'khor mang po thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga'o// //'dus pa chen po las byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo bcu pa las bde ba'i don thob pa yongs su gdams pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste brgyad tso// //'dus pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po'i 'khor lo bcu pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so4)// //65—585

༄ga /'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1ris༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+sā be+e cibarta tsakra nār rim ma hā yā na sudza4)tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig (57)tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nam gyi cha smad kyi thun la 'od dri ma yemed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa ni5༷ kun du snang byed ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa ni kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan 65wa 625

pa shā 1ri'i bu nam gyi cha smad kyi thun nam nangs nadakar gnas khang nas byung ste/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i gnas khang ga la ba der song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i gnas khang du 'jug par bsams dpa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi bzhugs khang gi khor yug nas pad ma khri byung ba mthong zhing glu'i sgra chen po yang ri thos so/ /pad ma de dag las kyang 'od byung ba mthong ngo / /'od des kyang rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad snang bar byed pa rimathong ngo / /mnyan du yod pa'i grong khyer chen po thams cad dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang snang bar gyur par mthong ngo / /de nas potshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i gnas khang du mi 'gro bar bsams pa dang / zhugs par gyur cing bdag nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mdun na 'dug par shes te/ des 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa skyil mo krung rtso)bcas shing 'dug par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang se gol gtogs na ma langs so/ /de nas lud pa'i sgra phyung nan yang ma langs te/ des 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i cho 'phrul mthong nas/ bdag rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na gnas pa snyam du shes shing 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa skyil mo krung gebacas te/ 'dug nas gnas khang dang bcas te/ shar phyogs su 'gro ba mthong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 1 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i mdun du skyil mo krung nyu1 bcas te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la mig mi 'dzums nyu2par lta 12zhing 'dug pa dang / des 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa shar phyogs su gang gā'i sgoklung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams las 'das te/ 'jig rten gyi khams 65wa 626

phyir mi ldog pa'i dbyings zhes0)bya bar phyin paras mimathong ngo / /de nas de bzhin gshegs par 'od zer gyis khebs pa'i pad ma rab tu rgyas pa'i sku zhes bya bsngonemathong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de'i spu'i khung bu rnams nas pad ma dag byung ste pad ma de dag gis dpag tshad khrir khyab pa mthong ngo / /pad ma de dag kyang shin tu rgyas shing 'dab 5)ma stong dang ldan par mthong ngo / /pad ma'i snying po de dag la yang byang chub sems dpa' mtshan sum cu sgyu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa/lus kyisamadog gser gyi kha dog lta bu dag 'khod par namathong ngo / /de'i nang na pad ma chen po gcig las bcom ldan 'das byung nas stong par gyur te/pad ma chen po de la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'dug nas/ pad ma chen po de dang lhan cig tu nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te/ mngon par 'phags nas bcom ldan 'das de la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 9nas/ pad ma chen po de nyid 1 la skyil mo krungs31bcas te 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer gyis khebs pa'i pad ma rab tu rgyas pa'i skus mkhyen bzhin du12/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa khyod da gzodamu gang nas 'ongs/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /'jam dpal migazhon nur gyur pas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer gyis khebs pa'i pad ma rab tu rgyas pa'i sku la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed nas mchis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de'i rim gro pa byang chub sems dpa' sgra snyan ces bya ba de/ pad ma'i stan de las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig 7tu gzar tshanas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i 65—627

zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal7)te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga pad ma'i snying po la btsugs nanonas/ bcom ldan 'das ga' )la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skada'4)ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed de ji srid cig na mchis/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ⑤'od zer gyis khebs pa'i pad ma rab tu rgyas pa'i skus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgra snyan la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nas7nub phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i57klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na'o/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams de na(kye/ bcom ldan 'das gang chos ston/ bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya'o/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni chos ston pa ci 'dra ba zhig lags/ bka' stsal pa/ theg pa gsum la brtsams te'o/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das theg pa gsum po de dag gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen po ste/ theg pa gsum po de dag la 9)brtsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de chos ston to/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi chos bstan pa 'thun7pa ma lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos bstan pa ni 'thun no/ /gsol pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos bstan pa ji tsam zhig 'thun/ bka' stsal pa/ sangs 65—628

rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos bstan pa ni phyir mi ldog pa'i chos kyi 'khor lor0)'thun no/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ji55)ltar bcom ldan 'das de theg pa gsum la brtsams te de ltar chos ston/ bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu sems can de dag ni dman pa la mos pa dag ste/ de dag theg pa gcig la mi 'jug pasashen thabs mkhas pas/ de dag de ltar nye bar khrid de/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thabs mkhas pa chen po dang ldan pa'o//④bcom ldan 'das de ni snyigasahonam lnga'i dus na byung ste/ de dag ni theg pa gcig la ma mos pa dag go/ /gsol pa/0 bcom ldan 'das de nam chos ston pa ni de ltar tshegs0)che lags pa lta/ bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de lta'o//gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag der ma po/skyes pa ni bdag gis rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa lags hu1so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de skad ma zer cig /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du lags/ bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu gang zhig 'dir lo nyi khri 97dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsgrub pa bas/gang zhig der snga dro gcig gis 32de ni de bas ches bsod nams mang du yang dag par sgrub 8bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten gyi khams de tshatsam du kun nas nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams de ji tsam du kun nas nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa lags/bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'jig rten gyi khams de'i kun nas nyon mongs par gyur pa ji tsam pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams de'i kun nas nyon mongs pa mnyan na/khyod7kyi che'i tshad zad par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgra snyan gyis de'i tshe rin po che sna bdun gyi pad ma dag blangs te/65—629

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la ba de logs su gtor to/ /gtor nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de blta'o0)zhes tshig tu yang dang yang smras so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de mthong bar 'dod dam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mthong bar 'tshalasho lags sos/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur rigapa 'di dang lhan cig song shig5) /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sgra snyan gyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de blta'oyi/ /smras pa/rigs kyi bu re zhigate7)kho bos phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /smras pa/ kho bo yang khyod dang lhan cig tu phyag bya'o / /bsnyen na bkur du bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zeradzaspugyis khyab pa'i pad ma rab tu rgyas pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal 0te/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas 'di lta ste dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas lag pa bskum 11pa las brkyang ba'am/ brkyang ba las bskum pa de bzhin du 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'jig rten gyi khams der mi snang bar gyur nas/ shar phyogs sum8'jig rten gyi khams 12gang gā'i 1 klung gi bye ma snyed rnams su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gan du byung ste/ thams cad na yang chos bstan pa 'di nyid byung ngo / /lho phyogs dang / nub dang / byang dang sku/ steng dang /65—630

'og skyedang / phyogs mtshamasamaXgernams su yang de bzhin te/ 'on kyang 'dzam bu'i7gling 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir54)nam ma nangasaspobaso/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo gnas khang gi nang na 'dug bzhin du skar khung gi gseb yinas 'od byung bar mthong nas/ de 7gnas khang nas 'byungs dngo snyam ste/khri lasashelangs pa dang / nyi ma ma shar bar rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshalam thams cad snang bar gyur par mthong ngo / /rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal 17thams cad chu dang ba sngo ba gsal bas gang ba dang / 'di na shing yang med gtsug lag khang yang med par mthong nas/ des 'di 1 snyam du bsams te/ ji ltar sngon ma byung ba'i sngal ltas 'di dag snang ba las na/ deng ni michos chen po zhig ston par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di snyam du bsams te/ rkang pa sa la bzhagastogego snyam nas/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos rkang pa sa la bzhag na gsher skyab yang med/ byed pa yang0 tshomed nas de0shedaga' ba dang nyi bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bzhugs khang ga la ba der song nas phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi bzhugs khang gi khor yug nas pad ma khri mthong zhing / rol mo'i sgra chen po dang / glu'i sgra chen po yang thos so/ /pad ma de dag las kyang 'od byung bar mthong ste/ 'od des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar gyur paraphu )mthong nas/ de dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes 1te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs tsho snyenas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal to ge/ /phyag 'tshal 34ba dang nam nangasam te/ nyi ma shar bar gyur to/ /de dag gi nang nas pad ma gcig gergyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi dbus su song ste 65wa 631

'dug par gyur to03/ / de nasadza )tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos pad ma de rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi dbus su 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di snyam du ribabasams te/ chos ston pa'i snga ltas byung gi ④bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi 451gdan shom du 'gro'o 6)snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan bshams ma thag tu sa chen po yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur to / /rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad kyang57)me tog gis khyab par khebs par gyur to/ /me tog dang bcas pa dang / 'bras bu dngaphubacas pa'i shing ljon pa rnams kyang byung tsa/bar gyur to0/ /dge slong thams cad kyang gnas khang nas 'byung bar bsams pa dang / rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad chu dang 37ba sngo ba gsal /gebs gang bar mthong nas/ de dag 'byung ba'am ldog par yang mi nus la/ 'di nas shing dang gtsug lag khang yang ma mthong gi snang ba chen po mthong nas/ de dag gnas khang de nyid na 'dug bzhin du 'di snyam du sems te/ de'i snga ltas 'di dag snang ba las hurin/ deng chos chen po zhig ston par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin desnyilas bzhengs nas gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhugs ma thag tu 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag grangs med pa rnams dang / lhan cig tu sa rum nas mngon par 'thon te/'thon nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal tetunye/bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de (snyedag dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 65wa 632

bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod song la mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byedatukyi tshal na dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma ji srid cig 'khod pa de dag thams cad bos shig /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te②/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ gtsug lag khang nas5migatsug lag khang du rgyu zhing song ste/ dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyed la ston pa gsung ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis kyang snga ltas rig mod kyi 'gro ma nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad chu dngasnyib sngo ba gsal bas gang bar mthong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos dge slong de dag gisaltar mnyan nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal4)nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong dag ni mchi57ba'i rngo mi thogs sokha/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal bas par chab dngasheb sngo ba gsal bas bltams par mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dge slong de /stodag ni chu ma yin pa la chur 'du shes pa dag ste/ ji ltar dge slong de dag chu ma yin pa la chur 'du shes pa de bzhin du de dag rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ma yin pa la rgyun du zhugasatshwa pa'i 'bras bur 'du shes/ lan cig nyu2phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mar yin pa la lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bur 'du shes/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ma yin pa la phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bur 'du shes/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu ma yin pa la dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bur ⑩'du shes/ rang sangs rgyas nyid 65—633

ma yin pa la 3)rang sangs rgyas su 'du shes/ gzugs ma yin pa la gzugs su 'du shes/ tshor ba ma yin pa dang mi/ 'du shes ma yin pa dang / 'du byed rnams ma yin pa dang / rnam par shes pa ma yin pa la rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dag ste/ kun dga' bo khyod song la bos shig dang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan te/yang dge slong de dag bod pa'i phyir mnyan du yod pa'i ri —)grong khyer chen por 'dizhugs nas dge slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams dang / dge bsnyen rnams dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams la bsgo zhe)ba/ tshe dang ldan pa dag khyed yel ston pa gsung ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'khor bzhi po dgatsoril bsgo nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nananas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi la bsgo lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal ri9gyi bu chen po la bka' stsal pa/ mod gal 1 gyi bu khyod song la stong gsum gyi stong 17chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa rnams dang /dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad 12bos shig /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal nyu2gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas/ 'di lte ste dper na/ skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas 65wa 634

lag pa bskum tu)pa las brkyang ri ba'am/ brkyang ri rib las bskum pa de bzhin du skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la mod gal 4gyi bu5༄chen pos/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / dge slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams dang / dge bsnyen 9rnams dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams dang /475 lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang ske/ nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi 'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / mi rnams dang / mi ma yin pa rnams na la bsgo nas sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / bdag nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi la bsgo 9tsholags so/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po de dag gis dpag tshad stong khor yug tu khyab par gyur to/ /lha rnams kyis kyang dpag tshad lnga khri tsam gyi steng hu )gi bar snang khyab par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 17'khor bzhi po 'di yang 'dus shing mchis/ lha rnams kyis kyang bar snang bltams shing mchis na32/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par nyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo la brtsams ñtsate chos bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'di na dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang /15 dge bsnyen ma dag kyang mang / lha brgya 7stong phrag kyang mang / de ma lags pa gzhan gang dag rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bur 'du shes pa dang / lan cig 1 phyir 'ong ba'i 65wa 635

'bras bur 'du shes pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bur 'du shes pa dang /dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bur 'du shes pa dang / rang sangs rgyas nyid du 'du shes pa mang du mchisanyen/ de dag gi5)'du shes rnam par dgrol ba'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis gang la dgongs te/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu bstan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gang la dgongs te/ rang sangs rgyas nyid kyisabastan pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bas gnang bar mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mdang 'dir nam gyi cha smad la mchis langs nas/ gnas khang nas byung ste/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i gnas khang ga la ba der mchis nas son te/ge/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i gnas khang du 'jug ces bgyis na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bzhugs khang mthong ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bzhugs khang gi khorasayug nas pad ma khri yang mthong 6)/ rol mo'i sgra chen po dang / glu'isko sgra chen po5shethos/ pad ma de dag las 'od byung ba yang mthong / 'od des rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad gda'am9)bar gyur pa dang / mnyan du yod pa'i grong khyer thams cad dang /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gda' bar gyur pa yang mthong na bcom ldan 'das 'di su'i snga ltas lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyu notshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /shā ri'i bu 'di ni gang gi phyir 'jam dpal gyis bskul ba'i 65—636

chos 'di bstan pa'i snga ltas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mdang 'dir nam gyi cha smad kyi thun la gnas khang gi nang na mchis bzhin du skar khung gi gseb nas 'od mchis pa mthong nas bdag gnas khang nas 'byung snyam7)ste khri las7langs pa dang / gdugs ma shar bar byurgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal bas par gda' bar gyur cing / rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal bas par chab dngas ba sngo ba gsal bas bltams lams)'di na zhugs shing yang ma mchis/ gtsug lag khang yang ma mchis par mthong na gebacom ldan 'das 'di su'i snga ltas lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'di ni gang gi phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas59bskul ba rnyog pa med pa'i chos bstan pa 'di'i snga ltas57so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ 'jam pa'i du/dbyangs ni 'jigs med pa//'di yis gang phyir dris pa yime/ /ye shes 'di ni rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bla na med/ /'jam pa'iphu nodabyangs ni 'jigs med pa1me/ /ye shes ldan pas gang phyir dris/ /ye shes 'di ni rnam rtog med/ /spros pa med cing zag pa med/ /'di las dngos po grub pa med/ /ma grub pa yang de bzhin no/ /thams cad spangs pa'i ye shes ni/ /'jam pa'i tsho/rtedapal gyis yongs su dris/ /'di la5nye'abras bu grub pa med mu/ /rnam pa kun tu med par brjod/ /'di ni 'jig rten rnams kyi mgon/ /skyob pa rnams kyi maldem po ngags /'jam dbyangs 'jigs pa med pa yis/ /gang gi 1 tshoched du yongs dris pa/ /'di la sgra ni med pa ste/ /sgra rnams thams cad mnyam par gyur/ /de skad ces bka' 65—637

stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i slad du yongs su zhu lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo de de bzhin te/ kun dga' bo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba dag go/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas ci la dgongs te/ dad pas rjes su 'brang ba bstan / chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba bstan1/ de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ci la dgongs te/ brgyad pa dang / rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas bstan/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas gang la dgongs te/dad pas rjes su 'brang ba yongs su bstan pa dang / de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas gang la dgongs te/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / brgyad pa dang ske/ rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas yongs su bstan pa de / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid kyang de nyid lags napar de ltar yongs su bstan tam/ ci lags bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de de bzhin te / de bzhin gshegs pas de dag nyid byang chub sems dpa'i chos zhes de skad yongs su bstan to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo snyigs risam lnga'i tshe skyes pa'i sems can dag ni dman pa la mos pa dag ste/ de dag sangs rgyas kyi 65—638

ye shes la ma mos pas/ kun dga' bo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thabs la mkhas pa dag thabs mkhas pas de ltar de dag la chos ston to/ /kun dga' bo sems can gang dag rgya chen po la mos pa de dag ni nyung ste/ kun dga' bo sems can gang dag dman pa la mos pa de dag gi ched du de bzhin gshegs pa thabs mkhas pa de lta bus chos ston to1ri/ /thabs 'dis sangs rgyas kyi chos ston to④/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas cang mi gsung bar gyur tog/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa cang mi gsung bas 'da' ci bar mdzad/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo sems can gang dag chos bstanas5)pa 'di lta bu la mos pa de dag ni nyung ngo / /dgra bcom pa'o ne/snyam pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i dgra bcom pa〈pe'adi dag ni shin tu mang ngo / /btsun pa kun dga' bo sems can gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ci la dgongs te/ chos bstan ces de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs te gsungs pa kun du shes pa de dag ni nyung ngo / /kho bo ni 'di la mngon sum na mo//'khor bzhi po de 1)dag ji ltar da ltar de bzhin gshegs pas dad pas rjes su 'brang ba rnam par gzhag 8pa mdzad ces bya ba nas/ de bzhin du rgya cher rang sangs rgyas kyi bar du rnam par gzhag pa mdzad ces the tsom 17du gyur pa dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag mang po 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pas ci la dgongs te/ dad pas rjes su 'brang ba yongs su bstan ces bya ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas ci la dgongs te/ rang sangs rgyas kyi bar du yongs su 65—639

bstan ces/ dpyod par gyur pas chu thams cad kyang thogs shing mi 'bab/bya rnams kyang nam mkha' la mi 'phur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos bstan pa 'di ni mos ga1)par dka'asho ba ste/ de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa cang mi gsung bas 'da' bar mdzad do/ /de nas pad ma khri po de dgashede bzhin gshegs pa'i bzhugs khang gi khor yug tu yongs su 'gro ste/ de dag las bdag cag gis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu rtso)las chos bstan pa 'di sa phyogasamacho5)'di nyid du thos lags na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i chos bstan pa la brtsams te/ chos bstan du gsol zhes de bzhin gshegs pa la5yegasol ba thob shigasheces sgra de lta bu byung ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa/ bdag gis mdang nam gyi cha smad kyi thun la 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang lhan cig shar phyogs su sangs rgyas 8)bcom ldan 'das grangs ma mchis pa dag las chos bstan pa 'di nyid thos shing / de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub dang / byang dang / 'og dang ske/ steng dang / phyogs mtshams thodarnams su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs ma mchis pa dag las chos bstan pa 'di nyid thos lags na/ bcom ldan 'das phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i chos bstan pa bshad du gsol/ de nas bar snang la gnas pa'i lha bye ba khrag khrig phrag brgyad cu rtsa lngas de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba btab pa/ bdag cag gis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis dag las chos bstan pa 'di mes phyogs 'di nyid du thosasnyilags na / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs 65—640

pa'i sangs rgyas kyis phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i chos bstan pa bshad du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gang la dgongs te/ dad pas rjes su 'brang ba yongs su bstan pa dang / chos kyis 3)rjes su 'brang (2ba yongs su bstan pa dang / de bzhin du rgya cher brgyad pa dang / rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang /rang sangs rgyas yongs su bstan pa(7/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bstan du gsol/bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi po lud pa'im mosgra yang mi 'byin par cang mi smra bar mchis pa 'di dag dang / bcom ldan 'das srog chags brgya stong mang po the tsom dang / som nyi 'tshal bar gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ci la dgongs nas dad pas rjes su 'brang ba yongs su bstan cing / de bzhin du rgya cher rang sangs rgyas kyi bar du yongs su bstan snyam pa de dag gi the tsom bsal 5)du gsol/ mang po 'dis6)dag ni dpang du gyur pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to pa/ /kun dga' bo de de bzhin te / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni dpang dang bcas par chos ston to/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dpang gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dpang 65—641

ni chos yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi stobs dang ldan pa ste/ de dag gis chos de dag ji lta bar 1mngon du byas pa de ltar bstan to/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig dang / ji ltar pade bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la dad pas 5rjes su 'brang bar yongs su bstan pa dang / de bzhin du chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / brgyad pa dang /rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang5 —ri/nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas su yongs su bstan pa ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo rin)'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa dag chags tshopa med pasar kyisangs rgyas mthong bar bya ba'i phyir yang dad par byed la / sangs rgyas kyi chos de dag kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong zhing / de gzugs la mi chags/ de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la mi chags pa 'di ni kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dad pas 7)rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de chos 'di dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis stong par bshad par yid ches par byed na/ kun dga' bo de 65wa 642

ltar mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni dad pas rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la yid ches par byed cing / de la 'dod pa yang skyed0)la/ nam nazhig na bdag ye shes 'di lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur snyam du ye shes de yang )yang dag par rjes su mi mthong na/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dad pas rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya ba'i ming thob bo/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga cal dad pa ma yin la/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa rjes su thob na/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dad pas rjes su 'brang bar rig par bya'o/ /yang ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas byin pa ltar chos kyi sbyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbyin par bya ba gang yin pa de lta bur nam zhig na 'gyur zhig gu snyam zhing chos kyi sbyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa de la yang yid ches par byed na/ kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de yang 5dad pas rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de zhum pa med pa'i yid kyis btang ba thams cad yongs su gtong ba yin te/ de lus kyang yongs su gtong yang sbyin pas dag par mi sems shing thams cad du yang ser sna med pa yin la/ de thams cad kyang byang chub tu yongs su sngo 6zhing /byang chub de yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ 7de ltar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de ni dad pas rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o/ /kun dga' bo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sangs rgyas la dad pa 65—643

phun sum tshogs pa yin/ sems rtog pa med pa yin/ rnyog pa med pa'i chos la yid ches pa yin/ skye mched drug kyang mi 'dor nyu)la/ de delokyedag don du gnyer ba yang ma yin/ dad pas mos pa yin/ sems can gang dag dad pa dang mi ldan pa de dag kyang dad pa la 'dzudam cing sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad par byed pa yin/ dad pa dang ldan par gyur nas kyang byang chub tusasems skyed5 snyecing sems de yang mi rnyed pa yin/ dadamo9)nas mnyam pa nyid du shes shing chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid du shes te/ de nim༄7)ji ltar shes zhe na/ de ni tha snyad kyis nachos kyi dbyings so zhes brjod par bya ste/ dbyings de yang mi rnyed9ske/ 'du byed thams cad mi rtagapha pa dang / 'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal ba dang / 'du byed thams cad stong pa dang / 'du byed thams cad bdag gi ba med par yid ches par byed cing de la yang stobs bskyed pa thob pa yin / 'phags pa'i tshul khrims la yid ches pa yin/ spros pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par zhugs pa yin/ sems can thams cad 'gog pa'i dbyings su mnyam mo zhes 'gog pa'i dbyings la yid0stoches pa yin/ dad pa gang gis yid ches pa de'i mtshan nyid kho nar yang dag par rjes su mthong zhing mi chags so/ /ma 12chags nas /tsho kyang sems can thams cad chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par rjes su mthong la chos kyi dbyings de yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos kyi dbyings nyid sems can thams cad kyi sems med pa'i dbyings te/ de de maltar yid ches shing chos de dag ji lta bar sems kyang de bzhin du yid ches par byed de/ de lta bu ni dad pas rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o/ /kun dga' tsobo gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems 65wa 644

dpa' chen po de yang dag par na sems can thams cad gang la yang mi gnas par yid ches shing sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pas/ de dag gi' 1)gnas kyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong la/ sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yangashon)dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ de ltar dad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni dad pas rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba chags med la/ /sems can dpag med dad par byed/ /de ni de la chags pa med/ /de phyir blo ldan dad pas 'brang / /chos 'di thams cad stong pa zhes/ /rab tu bshad par yid kyang ches/ /de ni de yi mos yin te/ /de phyir dad pas 'brang bar 'dod/ /bde gshegs ye shes yid ches te/ /nam zhig 'di 'drar shes ldan zhes/ /de la 'dod pa 'jug byed cing / /shes pa de yang mthong ma yin/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lngasal/ /rtag tu dad pa ma yin te/ /dad pa'i stobs ni rjes thob pa de phyir dad pasa'age'abrang bar gsungs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan byin pa ltar/ /chos sbyin bsam gyis mi khyab 'di/ /sbyin pa nam zhig sbyin snyam pa/ /de phyir dad pas 'brang bar gsungs/ /de ni slong la dad pa yis/ /lus kyang 57thams cad gtong bar byed/ /sbyin la sbyin ne)pa'i 'du shes med/ /de phyirabartan pa dad pas 'brang / /dad pas thams cad gtongam byed cing / /thams cad la yang ser sna med/ /de dag thams cad byang chub gzhol/ /byang chub de yang mthong ma yin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la dad pas na dang / /de yi sems ni rnyog pa med//sems med pa yi chos ston to/ /de phyir dad pas 'brang bar gsungs/ /65—645

sems can gang dag dad mi 1ldan/ /de dag dad la 'dzud byed cing / /dri med chos la dad par byed/ /de phyir dad pas 'brang bar gsungs/ /dad pa'i sems dang ldan gyur nas/ /sems ni byang chub 'jug par byed/ /sems de yang ni mi rnyed de/ /de phyir brtan pa dad pas 'brang / /chos kyi dbyings ni rtag mnyam par/ /dad pas mnyam pa nyid du shes/ /dbyings de yang ni mi rnyed la/ /dbyings zhes tha snyad 'dogs pa'ang medarinano/ /'du byed thams cad mi rtag dang / /sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med par/ /yid ches de yis stobs bskyed pas/ /de phyir dad pas 'brang bar gsungs/ /zag med tshul khrims yid ches la/ /rnyog pa med cing spros med pa/ /zhi ba'i dbyings la mnyam gzhag dpa/ /de phyir blo ldan dad pas 'brang / /sems can thams cad dbyings med cadang / /mya ngan 5'das pa'i kyi/dbyings yid ches/ /dad pa gang gis yid ches pa/ /dad pa de yang de'i mtshan nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings la chags med pas/ /sems can dbyings kyang mthong ma yin/ /ye shes ldan pa chos kyi dbyings/ /bsam gyis mi khyab de mi mthong / /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs med pa/ /chos 'di ji ltar 'di 'dra bar/ /de ltar dad pas yid ches pa ci/ /de phyir dad dang ldan par 8)gsungs/ /yang dag nyid du sems can kun/ /de dag ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /gang na'ang gnas pa ma yin te57 / /de dag gnas ni yod ma yin/ /sems can thams cad mya ngan 'das/ /yang dag tu na 1 de yang stong 11/ /des 12na mya ngan 'das pa de/ /stong pa nyid du yongs su brjod/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs med pa/ /'phags te de nyunyeltar yid ches te/ /des na dad pas rjes 'brang zhes/ /grags 7ldan rnams 65wa 646

kyis ming 'thob botu/ /dad pas rjes su 'brang rnams kyi/ /dad par de ni 'di 'drar gsungs/ /kun dga' khyod kyis de ltar zung 5)/ /de ltar 'di ni rab tu shodari kyi/ /kun dga' chos rnams 'di dag dang / /gzhan yang mang po mtha' yas pa/ /chos de dag gis blo ldan pa/ /dad pas rjes su 'brang ba bstan / /kun dga' bo de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dad pas rjes su 'brang bar yongs su bstan te/ thabs mkhas pas don de nye bar khrid do// //bam po gnyis pa/ kun dga' bo ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rjes su 'brang bar yongs su bstan ce na/ kun dga' bo 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las mi ldog ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang 'dzin cing rab tu ston la ge/dbyings de las kyang mi 'da' zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos rnams kyang rjes su thob pa yin/ bste gtsistang du byas te / de 'dzin cing de'i sems zhum pa med pa yin/ chos kyi ngo bo nyid kyi chos kyi rgyun de yang ston la gang du yang mngon par zhen pa med/ ci nas chos rnams dang / chos ma yin pa rnams la yang mi chags par gnas pa med pa dang rten med pa'i chos nyid kyang ston/chos 'dod pas8)yin gyi chos ma yin pa 'dod pa ma yin/ 'dzin pa med pa'i tshul du chos thams cad 'dzin te / bzung nas kyang sherab tu ston to/ /des shing 'grogs na bde ba yin no/ /zhi ba'i chos de yang rab tu ston la chos kyi 65—647

dbyings de yang g.yo bar mi byed/ mngon par zhen par mi byed do/ /des chos thams cad kyang mtshan nyid med par rjes su rtogs pa yin te/ chos nyid de las kyang mi 'da'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de mi gnas pa'i tshul du lus la legs par gnas pa yin no/ /ji ltar legs par gnas zhe0)na/ lus 'di ni rtag tu lus ma yin pa zhes de'akyeltar legs par gnas pa yin no/ /lus kyi chos nyid kyis thog ma dang / tha ma ma yin pa mnyam par byed domi/ /len par mi byed / khyer bar mi byed par de ltar chos nyid de shes so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gang bstan pa'i chos de yang rjes su thob pa yin no/ /chos thams cad la chags pa med pas dri ma medasel dag pa yang mi mthong ngo / /chos gang dga'agemi mthong ba de dag gang yang mi 'dzin te6)/ chos kyi dbyings 'di ni nyon mongs pa med pa/ mtshan ma med pa / rang bzhin med pa byed pa med pa/ dngos po med pa/ sems dang bral ba / sems med pa zhes bstan to/ /gang la sems mi dmigs pa de7)sems med pa/ thob55)pa med pa nye bar zhi ba zhes brjod do/ /de tha snyad med pa/tha snyad dang bral ba/ dmigs pa med pa ste/ de 'dzin kyang chos nyid dngos po med pa'i phyir/ gang du yang gnas pa ma yin te/ chos nyid des rab tu phye'o / /chos nyid 'di ni bden par na byang chub sems dpa' la bstan te/bsres 9)pa yang med/ rnam par gtor ba yang med/ bkag pa yang med do/ /de la bsnyad pa 'di ni 'gyur ba med pa 7ste/ ci717ltar bsnyad pa depha ltar thob pas / des72na rigs kyi sa zhes brjod do/ /de thob pas rigs kyi sa zhes yongs su bstan to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni rigs 65wa 648

kyi sa 'di yang rjes su thob pa yin te/ chos phra rab tsam yang 'ong ba'am 'gro bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong la/ 'ongs༅)ba med pa dang / 'gro ba med pa'i chos thams cad kyang 'dzin cing g.yo bar mi byed/ rnam par 'thor bar〈mimi byed/ 'du bar mi byed la gtor ba med pa dang / 'dzin pa med pa'i chos kyang 'dzin te/ des na chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o/ /chos nyid thob pa dang ske/ chos thams cad thoba'i )pa med pas/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'dirabadag bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas chos la rnam kun tu/ /chos las ldog par mi byed cing ske/ /chos nyid 'di dag 'dzin byed de/ /de phyir chos rjes 'brang zhes gsungs/ /chos rgyun bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /rgyun de las kyang 'da' mi byed/ /chos nyid de ni rjes su thob/ /de phyir chos rjes 'brang zhes gsungs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad pa'i chos/ /bste lku)stang byas dzite de dag 'dzin/ /de yi57)sems ni zhum pa med/ /de phyir chos rjes 'brang zhes gsungs/ /ngo bo nyid kyis chos kyi7rgyun/ /rgyun de de yis kun du bstan/ /chos la mngon par zhen pa med/ /de phyir chos 'brang shes par bya/ /gnas med pa dang rten med pa'i//chos kyi rgyun ni yang dag rtogs/ /chos nyid de ni 'dzin byed de/ /de phyir blo ldan chos rjes 'brang / /byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid gang / /sangs rgyas kyis ni bstan mdzad pa/ /chos nyid de ni rjes su thob/ /de phyir blo ldan chos rjes 'brang / /dbyings ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /chos rnams kun la nges med pa / /chos nyid de ni 'dzin par byed/ /de phyir blo ldan chos rjes 'brang / /des ni0)chos rnams 7thams cad la/ /stong par brtags nas skyon ma mthong /65wa 649

chos gang mthong bar ma gyur pa/ /de dag la ni 'dzin pa med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dbyings 'di ni/ /nyon mongs med cing mtshan ma med/ /ngo bo nyid kyang med par bstan/ /de ni brjod med dngos po med/ /dbyings 'di sems dang bral ba ste/ /sems de dmigs 1su med pa yin/ /gang phyir sems ni mi dmigs napa/ /de phyir de ni bsam yas brjod/ /sems pa med cing thob pa med/ /nye bar zhi bar dbarjod pa de/ /brjod pa med cing dmigs pa med/ /des na de ni bsam yas brjod/ /chos nyid 'di dag 'dzin byed la/ /de ni gang du'ang gnas pa med/ /dngos po med pas mi gnas te/ /de phyir chos rjes 'brang zhes gsungs/ /byang chub sems dpa' de la ni/ /chos nyid 'di ni rab bstan te/ /bsres pa med cing bzhag pa med/ /'gyur ba med cing la'od gsal ba/ /gang las rigs ni rab brjod pa/ /de ni 'phags pa'i spyod yul te/ /de ni rab tu thos pas na/ /rigs kyi sar ni yongs su brjod/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma smad pa/ /rigs 'di dang ni rjes 'thun pa/ /de ni de ltar 'dzin byed pas/ /de phyir chos rjes 'brang zhes gsungasal/ /chos nyid rab tu thob pas na/ /de chos rjes su 'brang bar 'dodam/ /kun dga' 'di las dgongs nas ni5)/ /byang chub sems dpa' rab tu brjod/ /chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes/ /ngas 6 ni dgongs te 'di bshad do/ /gang dag byang chub ring du me shes/ /de dag de 8ltar nye bar khrid/ /de 9ltar byang chub sems dpa'i chos/ /mang po dag ni ngas nyu bshad de/ /de lta bu yi 11thabs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams rab tu bstan/ /kun dga' bo de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 65wa 650

rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rjes su 'brang bar yongs su bstan to/ /kun dga' bo ji ltar sde bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brgyad par yongs su bstan zhes1rin/ kun dga' bo 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni log pa nyid brgyad las shin tu 'das pa yin te/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la regarten cing yang dag pa nyid brgyad la mngon par zhen pa yang med pa yin/ so so'i 5)skye bo'i chos las shin tu 'das pas /yin/ lam la yang legs par gnas pa yin te bar ma nyid thob pa yin/so so'i skye bo'i chos las kyang 'das la/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mngon du zhugs pa yang yin zhing byang chub de yang mi rnyed/ log par lta ba las kyang shin tu 'das shing yang dag par lta ba yang rnam par bshig pa yin/ mnyam skupa nyid rjes su thob cing 'jig yitshogs las rnam par 'das pa yin/ byang chub tu mngon du zhugs shing sangs rgyas kyi lam rjes su thob pa yin/ de sems can du 'du shes pa bzlog pa yin/ de sangs rgyas su 'du shes pa rnam par bshig 7pa yin / 'du shes mnyam pa nyid rjes su thob pa yin/ sems can gyi gnas las shin tu 'das pa yin/ gnas med pa la yang mngon du zhugs la chos thams cad la mi gnas pa yang yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang dag de'i gnas su 'gyur ba'i chos de dag mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten pa'i chos rnams las rab tu 'das shing / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams la zhugs la 'gog pa'i dbyings dang chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa 8thob pa yin/ 'jig rten pa rnams dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams mi dmigs shing chos 65wa 651

rnams dang / chos ma yin pa rnams dang / yod pa dang med pa rnam par spangs pa yin/ de chad pa dang rtag pa la mtshungs paraphanyu)'du shes pa yin te no/'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sems la mtshungs par gyur pa yin/ byang chub kyi sems de yang mi dmigs pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can thams cad mtshungs par gyur pa/ mnyam pa nyid du des shes pa yin te/ des na de'i lus la dug dang me dang mtshon gyis mi tshugs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ des yul thams cad kyang rnam par spangs pa yin la/de'i rtogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yul la yang legs par gnas pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni 'gro ba med pa/ 'ong ba med pa bde ba zhi ba grangs su ma gtogs pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin de la legs par gnas pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni stong pa'o/ /de ltar nasade'i gnas de med pa yin te/ desngon)na de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi reg mi phog ste/ des na mi sod pa5gezhes bya'o/ /de ltar nges par 'byung ba ni mi sod pa 49)yin te/ des bde bar bde ba'i shes pa rtogs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ des gang gis rtogs pa'i shes pa de yang mi rnyed de/ de'7)na de'i lus la mtshon gyis mi tshugs mi phog go / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de585chos thams cad 'dresalab med par shes pa'i phyir te / des na de mtshon gyis mi sod mdo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad la hu1 byams pas khyab par byed de/ byang chub kyi rnam pa mngon par sgrub 1 pa'i byams pa dang / rnam pa med cing chags pa med pa'i byams pa dang ske/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / zhi ba'i dbyings ma thob pa'i byams pa dang / gnod sems dang / brnabasngo sems spangs pa'i byams pa 65wa 652
