bcom ldan 'das la lta ①zhing phyag 'tshal ②lo/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du lha'i me tog rnams kyis gtor nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gzungasalags so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di kun chub par bgyis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de'i phyir khyod dkyiphyin chad lha dang lha ma yin gyi g.yul ngor 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas srog chags brgya stong mang po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bsgrub pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang tshun chad bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ma bskor ba de srid du/ de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub tu thugs ma dubaskyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal khyod de'i phyir phyogs bcur snang bas byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig mang po rnams kyi mchog tu gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin no/ /de nas de'i tshe sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos te lha'i me tog rnams kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor kun du pus mo nub tsam du khyab par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sa chen po g.yos pa 'jig rten du byung ba'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ me tog 'di dag ni sus gtor/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo lha bye ba khrag khrig phrag mang pos 'jam dpal gzhon ⑦nur gyur pas bshad pa thos nas dga' ba'i sems kyis me tog 'di dag gtor te/ gtor nas kyang tshig 'di skad du bdag 65—754

cag kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'dzin to/ /kun chub par byed do/ /'don to/ /bcang ngo / /bdag cag kyang 'jam dpal gzhon nuratugyur pa ci 'dra ba dekhu'adra bar gyur cig ces smras te/ tshig 'dishesmras ma thag tu de dag la chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mngon du gyur nas de dag thams cad tshim zhing mgu la yi0rangs te/ nga dang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshalasato/ /de nas sa g.yos pa 'di lta bu 'di byung ngo / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni yon tan chen po dang ldan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dag gi rna lam du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di grags 0par 'gyur ba de ⑦dge ba'i rtsa ba ngan ngon dang ldan pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan la thos nas kyang mos pa dang / yid ches pa dang /'dzin pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / 'don pa dang / 'chang ba'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa yin no/ /de dag ni ngan song ngan 'gror rnam par ltungasnyeb thams cad dang / mi khom7par skye ba thams cad las grol ba'o/ /de dag gis bdud sdig can bcom mo/ /de dag gis chos kyi tog bsgreng ngo / /de dag gis chos kyi sgron ma rab tu 'bar bar byas so/ /de dag gis mun pa mun nag bsal to/ /de dag gis byang chub kyi snying por phyin to/ /kun dga' bo gang dag gis chos 65—755

kyi rnam grangs 'di thos ma thag tu mos pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / 'don pa dang / 'chang ba de dag ngatudang nye ba yin no/ /kun dga' bo gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'disa'adzin pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / 'don pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa de dag ni nga'i bu chos kyi sku las skyes pa dag go/ /de dang de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal ②zas za bar 'dod pa dag go/ /de dang de dag ni ji ltar da lta na nga 'dug pa bzhin du byang chub kyi shing drung du 'dug par 'dod pa dag go/ /de dang de dag ni ji ltar da lta na nga ston pa de bzhin du chos ston par 'dod pa dag go/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na kha cig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos par 'gyur ba dang / 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / kun chub par bgyid par 'gyur ba dang / 'don par 'gyur ba dang / 'chang bar 'gyur ba dang / 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang /klog par 'gyur ba mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang dag da lta na mos pa de dag phyi ma'i dus na mos par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag da7lta na7'dzin pa de dag phyi ma'i dus na 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag da lta na klog pa de dag phyi ma'i dus na klog par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gang gis da ltar chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ma thos pa de phyi ma'i dus na 'di thos par 'gyur ba de ni ngas lha dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu'i⑧'jig rten na ma mthong ste7de ni gnas ma yin no/ /kun dga' bo 65—756

'di da ltar gang dag gi nor yin pa phyi ma'i dus na yang de dag gi nor du 'gyur rol/ /kun dga' bo 'di lta ste dper na 'dir khyim bdag gam khyim bdag gi bu 'ga' zhig phyug cing nor che la longs spyod che zhing nor dang yo byad mang bar ①gyur la/ des gter dag gter du bcug⑧nas yul gzhan du song na kun dga' bo de la ji snyam du sems/ de slar 'ongs ma thag tu des gang gter du bcug pa de rnyedakhupar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das rnyedakyilags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ nor de de nyid kyi lags pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de bzhin du 'di da ltar gang dag gi nor yin pa ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yang de dag gi nor du 'gyur te/ de dag ji ltar da lta na nga ⑤yang dag par bged 0pa bzhin du chos kyi nor bla na med pa 'di gzhan dag dang yang dag par bged par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gang dag phyi ma'i dus na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos par 'gyurasnyib dang /'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / kun chub par byed par 'gyur ba dang / 'don par 'gyur ba dang / 'chang bar 'gyur ba dang / klog par 'gyur ba rnams kyang ngas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis dper na da ltar de bzhin du mthong ngo /gang dag spong bar 'gyur ba de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang dag mos par mi 'gyur ba dang / spong ba dang ske/ mi snyan pa brjod pa dang / sun 'byin pa de dag gi 'gro ba ci lta bu zhig tu 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis 'di dris pas ci zhig bya kha rog shigati /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 65—757

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bshad du gsol/ gang dag mos par mi 'gyur ba dang / yid ches par mi 'gyur ba de7dag kyang mos par 'gyur zhing rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' lastsal pa/ kun dga' bo mtshams med pa lnga dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba gang yin pa de de dag gi 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo 'di la ji snyam du sems/ gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad kyi srog bcad na de'i 'gro ba ci 'dra ba zhig tu 'gyur/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sdig pa can lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ni de'i 'gro ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo gang zhig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi mchod rten bshig ste7mes kyang btang na/ ci de gzhi dekyilas bsod nams ma yin pa mang du skyedasapar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mang lags so/ /de gzhibade las bsod nams ma lags pashemang du skyedasapar 'gyur te/ de ni mnyam7par mi bgyi'o⑩/ /blta bar mi bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ni de'i 'gro ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo gang zhig 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi tshul 'gag par byed na de'i 'gro ba ji lta bu zhig tu 'gyur/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sdig pa can lags te/ /de ni tshig tu brjod par sla ba ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ de ni de'i 'gro ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yang gang zhig sems can gzhan yang 65—758

zlog par bgyid na/ de'i 'gro ba ji lta bu zhig tu 'tshal bar bgyi②/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ②dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la ①yang dag par zhugs pa rnams kyi mig phyung na de'i 'gro ba ci 'dra ba zhig tu 'gyur/ gsol pa/bskal pa mang por dmus long du 'gyur zhing sems can dmyal ba pa'i zhugs kyis sreg pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba yang myong bar 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ngas khyod la bsgo'o0khyod kyis khong du chud par bya'o/ /gang gis sems can gcig cig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las bzlog na de'i 'gro ba ni de yin par shes par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la zhugs pa gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la0the tsom ni 'tshal la mi spong na de ji lta bu zhig tu 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo ji snyed du the tsom gyi sems bskyedashepa de tsam du sangs rgyas mnyes par byed parakemi 'gyur ro/ /de bskal pa de snyed du byang chub ring du byed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yang gang zhig mos shing rtogs la the tsom 'tshal bar gyur na de'i lus gang gis sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba ci tsam zhig tu 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo khyod kyis de'i lus dris pas ci zhig bya kha rog shig⑨ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi po 'di dag kyang skrag par 'gyur/ slad ma'i skye bo rnams kyis thos na yang skrag par 'gyur lags kyis bshad du gsol/ bcom 65—759

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de'i lus gang gis sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba ni dpag tshad khrir 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/gang des tshigatum bsrungs pa'i de'i lce ci 'dra ba zhig tu 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de'i〈lce ni dpag tshad stong yod par 'gyur te/ de la thong gshol sa ya phrag brgyas rmod par 'gyur/ lcags kyi thukhulum 'bar ba rab tu 'bar ba sa ya phrag brgya 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ci nas tshig 'di ma bsrungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po de dag dngangs shing spu zing zhes byed par gyur nas/ gdong nas mchi ma zag par ngu ba'i bzhin gyis de'i tshe sa la 'gyel te/ 'gyel nas kyang thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu tshig tu smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang gis de 'dra ba'i tshig smras pas lus de 'dra ba'i rnam pa de lta bu myong bar 'gyur ba de'i ched du bdag cag 'gyod tshangs 'tshal lo/ /de nas der sems can gzhan dag gcig gdong las mchi ma zag par ngu zhing tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis tshe 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu the tsom gang bskyedasnyepar 'gyur ba de dag bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gang dag mthong ba de dag kyang dpang du gsol te⑨ske/ bdag cag gis las kyi sgrib pa de de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar so sor bshags par 'tshal lo/ /so sor dor bar 'tshal lo/ /nongs pa la nongs par7 so sor bshags shing nongs pa la nongs par mthong bas/ de bzhin gshegasalgepa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag cagatsogi nongs pa yongs su gzung7du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal 65—760

pa/ rigs kyi bu dag khyed gang gi phyir nyes pa la nyes par mthong ste/ so sor 'chags pa dang / so sor 'dor ba legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu dag gang nyes pa la nyes par mthong nas so sor 'chags pa 'di ni 'phags pa'i chos 'dul ba la ni 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'di'i nang nas gang dag gis the tsom bskyed pa de dag kyang / bcom ldan 'dasatu'adi 'dra ba'i sems can dmyal bar mchikhubar 'gyur ram/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'di'i nang nas gang dag gis the tsom bskyed pa de dag gis kyang so sor bshags shing so sor bor bas de dag gisanyemyong bar 'gyur ba chung bar du'agyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das myong bar 'gyur ba ji tsam zhig tu chung b.rasnyi'agyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de dag 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro/ /spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang tshor ba grangs med dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni mdor bsdus te smras pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nga dang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med pa gzhan dag la yang ci nas so sor bshags pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mos bdag gi lus 'di lta bur 'gyur du 'ong ngo / /bdag gisatshor ba 'di lta bu myong bar 'gyur du 'ong ngo zhes chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa bskyed par bya'o/ /mos nas kyang som nyi med pa dang / the tsom med7par bya'o/ /gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su ma btang ba dang / 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da 65—761

ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yongs su ma btang ba dang / chos yongs su ma btang ba dang / dge 'dun yongs su ma btang ba dang / 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi tshul yongs su ma btang ba des chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos par bya/ gzungatubar bya/ kun chub par bya/ gdon⑧par bya/ bcang b.rasabya/ bklag0par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gisatshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i chos bstan pa mdzad pa niX/ gang gis dge 'dun yongs su ma btang ba zhes bgyi ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci la dgongs te de skad bka' stsalanya/ de bzhin gshegs pas dge 'dun du7yongs su bstan pa ni gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pas phyir mi ldog pa la dge 'dun du yongs su bstan to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa gang dag lags pa de dag ni phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la yang dag par gzhol57ba ma lags/ grangs su mchi ba yang ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang dag bsam pa thag pa nas byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ sems de yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la yang dag par gzhol ba'o/ /de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi grangs su 'gro ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams thabs mkhas pa dang ldan 65—762

te/ thabs mkhas pas don 'di yongs su bstan pa ngo mtshar7to/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i me tog man rākhur ba rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor te/ mngon par gtor nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyang thabs mkhas pa 'dis chos ston par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad ji ltar da ltasan nga bzhin du thabs mkhas pa 'dis chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i bu stong phrag mang pos bcom ldan 'das la lha'i me tog rnams kyis gtor te/ tshig 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad kyis7kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thob par gyur cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /slad ma'i skye bo ①rnams kyi ched du bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo gal te rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo rgya mcho'i dbus su son par gyur pa gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan na yang / des gdon mi za bar thos par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs su lags7kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang da7byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos te⑩/ g.yos/rab tu g.yos so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dzam bu'i klung gi gser 65—763

gyi pad ma chen po 'dabatum bye bsnyebargya stong du ma yod pa/ 'od kyis phyogs bcu kun du snang bar byed pa mngon du byung7ngo / /'od des kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang bar byas so/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed thams cad kyi spyan snga na/ 'dzam bu'i klungashegi gser gyi pad ma chen po 'dab ma brgya stong du ma yod pa 'od kyis phyogs bcu kun du snang bar byed pasamangon du byung ba mthong ngo / /de nas lha'i dbang po brgyashebyin khyim bdag gi cha byadagye kyis me tog rnam pa5)sna tshogs 'khor bzhi po de dag la byin te/ tshig 'di skad du khyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mchod pa'i phyir mngon par gtor cig /mngon par gtor cig ces smras so/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po de dag gis me tog de dag blangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la gtor ba dang /me tog de dag de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi dbu'i steng gi drang thad na gdugs su 'dug par mthong ngo / / de nas〈nye'akhor bzhi po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das〈nyegang gi slad du sa chen po g.yos pa 'di byung ba dang / bcom ldan 'das dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag gi spyan sngar 'di lta bu'i pad ma chen po 'di byung ba 'di su'i snga ltas lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ grogs po dag 'di ni chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la byin gyis rlob pa'i ltas te/ ltas 'dis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la byin gyis rlob par shes par gyis shig /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 65—764

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni byin gyis brlabs lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de de bzhin te/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlabs so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das nyag gcig gis byin gyis brlabs sam/'on te de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di dag gis kyang7byin gyis brlabs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis chos kyi7rnam grangs 'di byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyidu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de lta bas na khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'bras bu la mngon par zhen pa med pa zhes bya bar zung shigadu /'di 'bras bu sna tshogs dang bral ba zhes bya bar yang zung shigadu /'di dad pas rjes su 'brang ba dang / chos kyi rjorjes su 'brang ba dang / brgyad pa dang / rigs kyi sa dang / rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig⑦ /'di bdud slar btang ba bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig⑧ /'di de bzhin gshegs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das dang / sangs rgyas bstan7pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig⑩ /'di pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa zhes bya bar yang zung shigatso /de7ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo chos kyi rnam grangs 'dichal 65—765

mos sam/ 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed na pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgomanyepa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos sam/ 'dzin tam/ klog gam/ kun chub par bgyidakhupa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgomashepa ji ltar yongs su rdzogs par 'gyuradu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang gi tshe rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa de ni de'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la the tsom mi za ba de ni de'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la bzod cing 'dod pa de ni de'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la sems ma zhum pa de ni de'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la sems yeng yeng por mi 'gyur ba de ni de'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la rnam par mi rtog cing chos thams cad yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba de ni de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas nasnyichos kyi rnam grangs 'di pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa zhes bya bar zung shigadu /'di ni lasangs rgyas thams cad kyis mtshungs par bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig⑧ /'di phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo ye shes chen po bstan pa zhes bya bar yang zung shig⑨ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming yang mnyan par7bgyi na thog ma dang / bar mchadang / tha ma lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de de lta'o/ /kun 65—766

dga' bo de de lta'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming thos pa des 'khor ba las bskal pa du zhig bsnyil bar bgyis par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyisabaka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo ye shes chen po bstan pa zhes bya ba thos la/ thos nas kyang mos par 'gyur ba des 'khor ba las bskal pa stong bsnyil bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos nas byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'gyur ba de ji ltar blta bar bgyi/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos nas byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'gyur ba de nyid de'i bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa'o/ /de nas 'khor bzhi po de dag gi mdun du pad ma kha dog sna tshogs pa①/ kha dog du ma yod pa/kha dog dpag tu med②/ 'dabasnyem bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma yod pa so sor byung ngo / /de nas 'khor bzhi po de dag tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs teX/ rab tu dga' nas dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ pad ma de dag blangs nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor to/ /mngon par gtor nas kyang tshig 'di skad du bdag cag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di de ltar bstan par bgyi'o/ /de ltar rab tu dbye bar bgyi'o zhes smras so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum pa mdzad ma thag tu de nas sil snyan thams cad kyang ma dkrol0bar sgra byung ngo / /spos thams cad kyi ngad kyang langs so/ /lha brgya stong mang po dag gis kyang lha'i tsan 65—767

dan gyi phye ma dang / lha'i 'dzam bu'i klungatugi gser phyesadang / lha'i me tog man dā ra ba dang / lha'i na bza' rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni rgyu ma mchis/ rkyen ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ bcom ldan 'das 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'khor bzhi po 'di dag thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za gang dag chos kyi ②rnam grangs 'di thos pa dang /gang dag phyi ma'i dus na thos par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang ji ltar da lta na nga ston pa de bzhin du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di lhag chad med par ston par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / 'khor bzhi po de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang /lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten bcom ldan 'das kyis rjogasungs pa la yikhurangs te mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sekhorka// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi7na mi tra dang / dā na shī la dang / mu ne bar ma dang ske/ zhu7chen gyi lots+tsha bakheban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //65—768

༄ga /'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sa mārkadhi tsakra nā ma ma hā yalgen sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhugs te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun tshad med grangs med pa dang thabs cigasnyitu bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i 'khor sna tshogs pas bskor nas chos ston par gyur te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rab tu g.yos par gyurasheto/ /snang ba chen pos kyang thams cad gsalashebar 65—788

gyur te①/ de nas 'khor der byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'dug par gyur te/ stan las langs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo lakhusnyoms par zhugs pa ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa shin tu ngo mtshar lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod kyis yang dag pa'i mtha' shes sam/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis 'tshal lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal yang dag pa'i mtha' gang na 'dug /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa'i mtha' ni gang na ma mchis pa de na⑧mchis lags soX/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal gang na med pa de gang yin/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das yul thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal sgom pa gang yin/ bcom ldan 'das sgom pa ni sgom pa ma mchis pa'i don to/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos ji ltar ston par mdzad/ bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal nga0ni gzugs rnam par 'jig pa med pa dang / skye ba med par chos ston to/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rnam par 'jigashepa med pa dang ske/ skye ba med par chos ston to/ /'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug rnamasakyirnam par 'jig pa med pa dngasnye/ skye ba med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor7ro/ /ngas ni 'di ltar chos gang yang ma bshig /ma bskyed pa de ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyisatshwa )mkhyen bzhin du 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 65—789

'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal khyod kyis chos kyi dbyings shes sam/gsol pa/ gal te bdag gis dmigs na 'tshal lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal khyod kyis 'jig rten gang la spyod pa shes sam/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten nanyesgyu ma sprul pa'i mi gang kho nasal spyod pa de la spyod pas so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten zhes bgyi ba ②ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos gsan par ni bzhed kyi/ khyod spobs par gyis shig /gsol pa/ ci las brtsams te spobs par bgyid pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/'jam dpal khyod chos kyi dbyings las rtsoms shig /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang bdag gis chos kyi dbyings ma lags pa'i chos de bdag0gis yang dag par rjes su ma mthong lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams rab tu skrag par 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te ④yang dag pa'i mtha' skrag par gyur na/ de'i slad du mngon pa'i nga rgyal can⑧spag par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gnyis gcig cing dbyer med pa'i phyir ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal khyod ni rdo rje'i gzhi yin no/ /'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad mi phyed cing bsam gyis mi khyab pas na rdo rje'i gzhi lags so/ /de ci'i slad du rdo rje'i gzhi zhes bgyi na sems can ma mchis pa dang / dngos po ma mchis pa'i slad du rdo rje'i gzhi lags so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar lags pa'i7yang dag pa'i mtha' ni ma mchis pa lags te/ de lta bu'i mtha' gang 65—790

lags pa de ni tshur mchi ba dang / phar mchi ba ma mchis te/ bcom ldan 'das de lta bu'i mtha' can gyi don la gnas nas rang bzhin med pa'i don sgomanyepar byed do/ /dben pa sten par yang byed do/ /'du 'dzi rgyaspong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal khyod kyis chos bstan pa ni rab tu ngo mtshar to/ /'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i bu ngo mtshar mi che ste/ dgra bcom pa zag pa med pa ni chos ston pa'i snod ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar chos bstan⑧pa 'di ni so so'i skye bo'i chos la zhugs pa ma yin/ dgra bcom pa'i chos la zhugs pa ma yin/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos la zhugs pa ma yin / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos la zhugs pa ma yin pa'i phyir te/ 'di ni chos dmigs pa'i phyir yang zhugs pa ma yin no/ /'di ni gang du yang zhugs pa dang ldog pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /chos thams cad shin tu dben⑧pa'i phyir ro//smras pa/ 'jam dpal ci la bsams te smra/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/btsun pa shā ri'i bu dgra bcom pa nyid ni 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang /gti mug zad pa yin na de dag gang gi snod yinakhuzhing de gang ji lta bu zhig gi snod du 'gyur snyam ste/ de las bsams nas dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/chos bstan pa'i snod ma yin par kho bo de skad smra'o/ /smras pa/ btsun pa shā ri'i bu khyod 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba med pa'i chos yin par mos sam/ smras pa / 'jam dpal bdag mos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal legs so legs so//chos zab mo'i don la khyod rab tu mkhas par bsngags par gyur toni/ /bcom 65—791

ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / lha dang /mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zaratubacas pa'i 'jig rten yisherangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs casamiske 0bsdur mchan/788 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉mān/③〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉lha/ 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gis/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉thams gcig 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉thabs gcig ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉'gyur/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'argyu'irdo/ni〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsal/789 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉to/ ②〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 la/ ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ni/0〈〈li 〉〉lo ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉de/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'jigs/ ⑦〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉—rnams/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 dang / ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bskor/ ⑩〈〈co 〉〉kyi/79 ①〈〈khu 〉〉ni/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉so ba/ ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉la/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dag ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉 chos kyi dbyings ma lags pa'i/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉dag ⑦〈〈khu 〉〉de/ ⑧〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol〉〉kyang / ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ 4)〈〈g.yung 〉〉gar/791 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsgom/ ②〈〈li 〉〉'dzin/ ①〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bston/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉du'ang /⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉dbyin/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dri'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉lin/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sngags par gyur to/〈〈li 〉〉bsngags 'gyur to/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bsngags 'gyur ro/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉 par/792 ①〈〈li 〉〉bar/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉yid/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sto/ 0〈〈zhol 〉〉 rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī la dharma dang / ban+de rnam par mi rtog pas rgya las bsgyur ba/65wa 792

༄ga /'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya7pa ri ṇa tasatsakra nā0ma ma hā yā na sna0tra / bod skad du/ 'phags pa yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che rdo rje'i ri'i zom la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 'khor mang po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rin po che la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gang byang chub sems dpa' byang chub chen po don du gnyer bar 'dod pa dang /sems can thams cad sgrol bar 'dod cing byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa 'dzin par 'dod pa dang / byang chub chen por sems bskyed cing snying rje chen po dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rim gro ⑦dang bkur sti bya bar ⑧65—794

'dod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs yangs shing rgya che ba sogs7par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bsgrub par 'dod pa dang / thogs pasamed pa'i gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / mngon par shes pas rnam par rol par 'dod pa dang / nam mkha' la bang ba dang mdzod chen po bsgrub par 'dod pa dang / rang gi lag nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhin du gtongashezhing 'bul bar 'dod pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang / sa bcu la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang dag pa'i lam la bde bar gnas pa ma thob pas deng byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ bdag gi lus dang sems 'di dus thams cad dang / rnam pa thams cad du dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag lus 'bul gyis⑤/ mthu chen po mnga' ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / sa chen po la rab tu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dubadag bzhes su gsol/ bdag gi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po dang /brtson 'grus brtsams pa dang / sems kyi rgya bskyedasnyepa dang / rab tu zhi zhing dul ba dang / dbang dang / mngon par shes pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa myur du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /yang bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'khor ba na 'khor zhing bcing ba chen pos bcings par gyur pa/ btson765—795

ra na gnas pa/ yang dag pa'i lam dang bral ba/ nyon mongs pa'i dgra'i dbang du gyur pa/ mgon med pa/ skyabs med pa/ mig med pa/ rten med pa / gtso bo med pa/ 'drenanyepa med par gyur pa/ lam gol bar song ba/'khor ba lashegazhol ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po la rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ngan⑧'gro la phyogs pa/ lam ngan pa la bsten0pa/ lam ngan par lhung bar gyur pa/ rtag tu bshes gnyen ngan pas zin cing dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral ba/ yang dag pa dang yang dag pa ma yin pa dang / phan par 'gyur ba dang ske/ phan pa med pa dang / don yod pa dang don med pa la rmongs par gyur pa / dge ba'i chos dang bral zhing mi dge ba chen po bsgrubs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa rnams la rtag tu rgyab kyis phyogs pa/skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir cing mi bde ba chen po bsgrubs pa/'jigs pa med pa/ bag tsha ba med pa/ sems rtag tu g.yengs par gyur pa/sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / zhi zhing dben pa dang bsgrubasalgepa dang bag yod pa dang bral bar gyur pa/ gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang /sa bcu'i chos kyi bzod pa la bde bar gnas pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ⑧pa zab mo dang mnyam pa nyid las ring du gyur pa/ byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms tshad med pa bzhi mishesgrub pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang mi ldan par gyur pa dang ske/ chags pa med pa dang / thogs pa med pa'i ye shes chen po las ring du gyur pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu dge ba'i chos sgrub pa la bderwatebar gnas pa ma thob pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa 65—796

dang bral bar gyur pa dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa la mi gnas pa dang /bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid la spyod cing gzhol bar 'jug pa mi 'grub pa dang / bsod nams byed pa la g.yel zhing lta ba snyems pa dang the tsomanyegyi sgribakhupas byang chub kyi yan lag bdun mngon⑧par mi rtogs pa dang / de bzhin du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad mi sgrub pa dang / nyon mongs pa brgya stong tshad med pas zil gyis non cing sdug bsngal rnam pa mang pos sdug bsngal zhing yongs su mnar te/ rtag tu gdung ba bsam pa zhan ④pas khro zhing rtag tu g.yeng ba/ nyon mongs pa brgya stong la rgyun du gzhol bar gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po la gnas pa rnams kyis bdag gi skyabs mdzad par gsol/ bdag gi rten mdzad par gsol/bdag gi 'dren pa mdzad parasnyigasol/ bdag myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i lam dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /bdag myur du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa〈brgyad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos spobs pa thogs pa med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /gzungs dudang / rnam par grol ba'i yon tan dang / rdzu 'phrul dang /mngon par shes pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /yang bdag bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig /mchod pa rgya chen po byed pa'i dus su yang ⑨'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthu chen po mnga' ba thams cad dang / byang 65—797

chub sems dpa'i7tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ deng bdag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod pa dang / rim gro chen po bgyis te lus 'bul lo/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na ji snyed rgyan dang / yo byad bzang po thams cad rin po che'i gzhal med khang rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / rin po che'i rgyan thams cad dang / rin po che'i shing dang /rin po che'i ri dang / rin po che'i ba dan dang / rin po che'i dkyil 'khor dang ske/ rin po che'i dbyig rnam par bkram pa dang / rin po che'i gdugs dang ske/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / rin po che'i do shal gyi rgyan dang / mu tig gi dra ba dang / rin po che'i snod dang / rin po che'i phung po dang / rin po che'i 'od 'phro ba dang / rin po che'i gling dag na nor bu rin po che chen po rnam par dag pa'i mar me'i sdong bu dang / rin po che7dril bu'i sgra 'khrol ba lasanor bu rin po che 'od 'phro ba gser btso ma'i spar khab can gyi dom dom dupho long dpyangasalgepas yongs su khebs pa/ gser btso0ma'i me tog 'dzam bu'i⑧gser gyi ze ba can/ gser gyi shing ljon pas dkris pa/ gser gyi pho brang sna tshogs rin po che'i sprin chags pa/ rin po che'i thigs pa char du 'bab pa/rin po che rnam pa mang po'i mdzod kyi pho brang / lha rdzas kyi nor bus rtsig7ngos spras pa/ rin po che'i shing thams cad rig 'dzin chen po'i skyed mos tshal gyi ra ba yid du 'ong ba/ rin po che'i pho brang dang / gnas dang / shing dang /nags tshal la sogs pa thams cad kyang yid du 'ong ba de lta bu bdag po med pa 'dzin pa med pa thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yongs su bsngo zhing dbul7lo/ / 'dzam bu'i gling na sman bzang po ring du 65—798

'tsho bar byed pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa ji snyed yod pa dang / nor bu rin po che sems can thams cad kyi re'ub yongs su skongakheb dang / ma g.yos par rang bzhin gyis bda'akhuba'i zhal zas bzang po dang / spos kyi shing ljon pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang / tsan dan gyi shing dang / a ga ru dang / tsan dan dmar po dang / lo ma che zhing me tog rtag par bsung7gis gzi bar byed pa'i shing rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i lha rdzas kyi spos ma bzung ba yongs su ma bzung ba dang / dpag bsam gyi shing rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas 'byung ba nor bu rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la sogs pa dang / ri rab lhun po dang / ri ti seshedang /spos kyi ri dang / ri ma la ya dang / ri btang bzungasredang / ri ma ha la dang ske/ rdo rje'isheri la sogs te ri chen po rnam pa de dag gi rin po che'i zom sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i stegs dang / rdo ba rin po che dang / rin po che'i phug dang / rin po che'i pho brang dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / rin po che'i zhogs ma dang / rin po che'i lam srang mang po dang / nor bu rin po che'i ka ba mang po dang / rin po che'i sgron me'i 'khor lo mang po dang / be+e drur+ya〈spel sogs te/ nor bu'i rigs rnam pa mang po dang / ji tsam du gnam gyi steng na bdag po med pa'i lha'i pho brang dang lha'i nor hunyernam pa mang po yid du 'ong zhing blta bar 'os pa dang / lha'i rol mo'i yo byad rnam pa mang po rlung gi ngad kyis bskyod pa tsam gyis sgra snyan pa 'byin pa dang / nam mkha' la gnas pa'i pho brang nas rol mo'i sgra snyan pa〈nye'abyin pa dang / lha'i rol mo rnam pa mang po ma bskyod par sgra snyan paraca'abyin pa dang / lha'i bya sna tshogs nam mkha'i pho brang nas 65—799

snyan pa'i sgrasnyisna tshogs 'byin pa dang / rin po che'i sprin sna tshogs las sgra snyan pa chen po 'byung ba dang / lha'i nor bu rin po che dbyangs snyan⑧pa'i sgra sgrogs pa dang / gzhan yang lha'i dri'i shing dang / me tog gi shing mang po dang /phreng ba'i shing dang / byug pa mang po dang / bdug pa'i spos kyi shing dang /sgron ma'i shing dang / rgyal mtshan gyi shing dang / ba dan gyi shing dang / ②rin po che'i shing la sogs pa de dag thams cad ma bzung ba yongs su ma bzung ba de dag thams cad kun kyang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dbul 0lo/ /ji tsam du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag na mchod pa'i sprin chenapo me tog gi sprin dang ske/ spos kyi sprin dang / phreng ba'i sprin dang / bdug spos kyi sprin dang /byug spos kyisnyisprin dang / rin po che'i gdugs kyi sprin dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprin dang / rin po che'i ba dan gyi sprin dang / rin po che'i gos kyi sprin dang / rin po che'i rnam pa'i sprin dang / rin po che'i phung po'i sprin la sogs te/ rin po che chen po'i sprin rnam pa de dag dang / gzhan yang spos kyi 'bru mar gyis mar 6)me'i snod chen po bkang ba7stong gi 'jig rten gyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ mar me'i snying po ri rab kyi tshad tsam pa sgron mar byas te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams la mchod cing dbul lo/ /de bzhin du mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mchod pa'i bsod 6)nams dam pa ji tsam pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o(1)/ /gang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dge ba mang po brtsams te/ dmigs su med pa'i tshul gyis byang chub 65—800

tu yongs su bsngos pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bsod nams de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi snying por mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo chen po ni bskor/ bdud kyi sde rnams ni pham par byas nas mya ngan las 'da' bar gshegs par dgongs pa la sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir bskal ①pa chen po gcig tshang bar bzhugs par gsol zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyis bsod nams ci bsgrubs pa de dag thams cad la rjes su yi byarang ngo / /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sdig pa dang mi dge ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad bshags pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang yongs su bshags shing yongs su sbyong ngo ge/ /de bzhin du mchod pa dang bshags pa 56la sogs pa byas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mngon sum /du dmigs pa'i spyan sngar gsang sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /omadusam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ bhi ma na sa ra/ ma hā dzā bā rgyu9)/ gang gsang sngags de bzlas pas ci dang ci 'dod pa de thams cad 'grub cing lha'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mngon du 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa yid la byedatshwanye cing nyin mo yang 37rung mtshan mo yang 3)rung yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo chen po 'di klog cing 'don na/ de'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las 'byang tsho/nyezhing nyon mongs pa thams cad khad kyis sbyong bar 'gyur ba dang / bsod nams kyi 65—801
